jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Network Onboarding Specialist to join our Network & Clinical Qualityteam. This role would be responsible for overseeing day-to-day 1099 and W2 onboarding workflows, partnering with the Network Onboarding Manager to streamline processes, support provider onboarding and maintenance, and assist the clinical team with W2 initiatives and enrollment reporting. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, collaborative, and solutions-oriented, with a passion for identifying improvements, troubleshooting operational challenges, and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Onboarding Support
    • Oversee and support the day-to-day operations for both 1099 and W2 workflows.
    • Collaborate with Network Onboarding Manager to develop and implement streamlined workflows in the onboarding platforms (Fountain, Talkspace Admin/product, etc.).
    • Ensure efficient onboarding processes (smooth phase changes, contracting, etc.), guaranteeing smooth provider maintenance processes (providers' account changes, etc.).
    • Learn, document, and execute all requirements related to onboarding.
    • Support clinical team in W2 initiative to ensure smooth onboarding of new network clinicians through the flow.
  • Onboarding Improvement
    • Report on enrollment trends within the funnel.
    • Identify areas of improvement, bugs and product gaps, and operational bottlenecks.
    • Troubleshoot any bottlenecks and blockages in the flow/ reach out to stakeholders who can assist.
  • Team Collaboration
    • Be an active participant and problem solver in recurrent meetings.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • BA/BS degree preferred.
  • 1 - 2 years of customer-facing experience required.
  • Experience (or strong interest) in working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Attention to detail.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $64,000 and $75,000/yr. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: QA Lead / Quality Engineering Lead - AI-Native Quality Systems
jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyZenara Health is a technology-driven mental health care company dedicated to transforming access and quality of mental wellness services.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-driven mental health care company dedicated to transforming access and quality of mental wellness services. We combine AI-powered platforms with expert clinical care to deliver personalized, effective mental health solutions — connecting patients and providers through a seamless digital experience.

We're building multiple products across the clinical workflow — from AI-driven evaluations to care coordination — and moving fast. This is a startup, not a department.

About the Role

Read this carefully. If you're a manual tester looking for a comfortable QA role, stop here.

We're building AI-powered clinical software, and our quality function needs to operate at the same level of intelligence and autonomy as the products it tests. We don't need someone who writes test cases from Jira tickets. We need someone who designs quality systems.

Our QA function is ready to scale from strong foundations to systematic automation. You'll be the person who architects that scaling — building the test infrastructure, automation frameworks, and AI-augmented QA workflows that let quality grow without linear headcount.

The person we're looking for has probably managed a team of 3-8 QA testers at some point and had this thought: "Half this team could be replaced by good automation and smart test design." You're tired of babysitting manual testers. You want to build the machine instead of being the machine.

We're paying significantly above market for QA in India because we're not hiring a typical QA person. We're hiring someone who thinks about quality the way a systems architect thinks about infrastructure.

This Is Not a Traditional QA Role

This is a quality engineering role. You will:

  • - Architect test automation from zero — Playwright-based E2E, API, and integration test suites across multiple healthcare products
  • - Build AI-augmented QA — use Claude, Copilot, and AI tools to generate test cases, identify edge cases, and create self-healing test suites
  • - Integrate QA into AI-assisted development workflows — shift-left testing that catches defects at the source, not the gate
  • - Own the quality gate — if you don't trust it, it doesn't ship. You have release authority.
  • - Design regression automation that maintains coverage as multiple products evolve simultaneously
  • - Establish quality engineering culture — documentation, runbooks, test plans that aren't in anyone's head

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

Week 1-2: Audit all products. Map coverage gaps. Identify the highest regression risks. Pair with the current QA team to absorb domain knowledge and institutional context.

Month 1: Build the Playwright automation scaffold — CI-integrated, parallel execution, covering critical paths. Establish the QA runbook: how we test, when we test, what blocks a release.

Month 2-3: Attach AI-driven test generation to the framework. Build autonomous QA loops that feed back into development. Get to the point where coverage grows without linear human effort.

Ongoing: Own quality across everything. Context-switch between products in the same week. Pair with engineering on testability. Work directly with the founder and clinical team on healthcare-specific edge cases — billing, HIPAA compliance, clinical workflow validation.

What You'll Own (End-to-End)

1. Test Automation Architecture — Playwright (preferred) or Cypress E2E suites. API test automation (REST Assured, Postman-based, or custom). CI/CD pipeline integration. Parallel execution. Containerized test environments. Custom reporters.

2. Regression Automation — Systematic regression suites, versioned and updated every sprint. Not a spreadsheet. Not tribal knowledge. A living, automated safety net.

3. AI-Augmented Quality Engineering — Using AI tools to generate tests, create test data, identify edge cases from specs, and accelerate coverage. We're an AI-native company — our QA function must be AI-native too.

4. Healthcare Quality Assurance — HIPAA compliance testing, clinical workflow validation, medical billing edge cases, patient data privacy verification, audit trail testing.

5. Cross-Product Quality Ownership — Multiple healthcare SaaS products. One quality brain.

6. Release Certification — You define "release-ready." You block releases when quality is insufficient — with evidence. You raise risks early, clearly, and decisively.

Values & Vibe (Who You Are)

  • You think of QA as a system design problem, not a checklist.
  • You're excited by autonomous testing systems, AI-driven exploration, and replacing manual effort with intelligence. You design feedback loops, not just test suites.
  • You're uncomfortable with manually writing hundreds of brittle test cases, QA that reacts instead of anticipates, and automation that breaks every sprint.
  • You communicate like an engineer. Your bug reports tell a story: what happened, why it matters, how to reproduce, what the business impact is. Developers thank you for your bugs.
  • You've blocked releases before and you'd do it again. Quality isn't negotiable.
  • You don't wait to be asked. When you see a quality risk forming — in a spec, in a sprint, in a deployment — you surface it. Proactively. Loudly if needed.
  • You use AI tools in your daily work already. If you haven't figured out how Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot accelerates quality engineering by now, you're behind.

What Success Looks Like

  • - Playwright automation covers critical paths across all products
  • - Regression suite runs in CI — zero manual regression passes for standard releases
  • - No critical bugs reach production that were in scope of automated tests
  • - QA runbook exists and the team follows it
  • - You context-switch across multiple products in the same week without dropping quality
  • - Release cadence has increased because QA is no longer a bottleneck
  • - AI-assisted test generation is part of the daily workflow
  • - Quality risks surface early — before they become production incidents

Schedule

Evening IST hours with 4–8 hours of overlap to US Pacific (9am–5pm PT). You propose the schedule that works for you — we care about overlap, not clock-in time. Flexibility for critical releases or incident response.

Requirements

  • 4-8 years of experience in QA, SDET, or Quality Engineering, including a minimum of 2 years in roles such as QA Lead, QA Manager, SDET Lead, or Senior Quality Engineer, responsible for test strategy beyond mere execution.
  • Test automation architecture—experience in designing and building test frameworks from the ground up rather than merely writing scripts within existing frameworks.
  • Skilled in Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium—maintained advanced, production-level end-to-end test suites for over 2 years.
  • API testing—proficient in automated REST API testing using tools such as REST Assured, Postman automation, or custom solutions. Capable of creating programmatic test suites that include authentication, error handling, and edge case coverage.
  • JavaScript or TypeScript—ability to write, debug, and review test automation code competently.
  • CI/CD integration—experienced in linking tests into deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar tools, with a background in shift-left testing.
  • Git—familiarity with branching, pull requests, and conducting code reviews for test scripts.
  • Test planning & strategy—capable of developing test plans based on product requirements, prioritizing them by business risk, and knowing what not to test.
  • Docker/containerized test environments—ability to set up and maintain isolated test infrastructure.
  • Strong proficiency in English communication—focus on asynchronous communication with clear written bug reports, test documentation, and release readiness notifications, while proactively identifying risks.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience in managing or mentoring QA teams
  • Familiarity with healthcare SaaS or compliance testing under HIPAA
  • Expertise in performance testing using K6, JMeter, or Artillery
  • SQL and database-level data integrity testing experience
  • AI-assisted testing using LLMs for test generation, test data, and exploratory automation
  • Familiarity with React or Next.js
  • Experience with BDD/TDD methodologies

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in security testing (understanding OWASP basics)
  • Knowledge of FHIR/HL7 data validation
  • Experience in accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1)
  • Mobile/responsive web testing experience
  • Experience in data pipeline or ETL testing
  • Background in startup or high-growth environments
  • Previous roles where QA influenced architectural decisions

Benefits

  • Compensation ranging from ₹20–30 LPA depending on skills and experience
  • Fully remote work opportunity available across India
  • Equipment allowance provided
  • Direct communication with the founder and technical team

We are Bugcrowd. Since 2012, we’ve been empowering organizations to take back control and stay ahead of threat actors by uniting the collective ingenuity and expertise of our customers and trusted alliance of elite hackers, with our patented data and AI-powered Security Knowledge Platform™. Our network of hackers brings diverse expertise to uncover hidden weaknesses, adapting swiftly to evolving threats, even against zero-day exploits. With unmatched scalability and adaptability, our data and AI-driven CrowdMatch™ technology in our platform finds the perfect talent for your unique fight. We aim to create a new era of modern crowdsourced security that outpaces threat actors. Unleash the ingenuity of the hacker community with Bugcrowd, visit www.bugcrowd.com. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others.

Job Summary

At Bugcrowd, we handle application security assessment at an epic scale. As an Application Security Engineer (ASE) you will curate and manage the incoming security vulnerability submissions to some of the world’s biggest companies’ bug bounty programs. Here are just a few of the reasons why we are the best:

  • A tenure at Bugcrowd often means you have worked on not only one company’s security program but potentially on hundreds.
  • As an ASE at Bugcrowd you will be exposed to the Internet’s best security researchers and their cutting-edge security testing methodologies. Our ASEs quickly become technically fluent in obscure/complex XSS, SQLi, XXE, IDOR, SSTI, SSRF, and many other vulnerability types. There is no other organization that offers the learning opportunity that Bugcrowd does.
  • You will be exposed to things outside of your comfort zone. We routinely run security programs for cars, IoT devices, embedded systems, mobile applications, and more!
  • We have an awesome team and tons of perks. We’ve even been selected as one of “The 10 Coolest Security Startups Of 2016” by crn.com.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

An ASE is responsible for the ongoing triage and validation services of Bugcrowd managed programs. Under the direction of the Director of Technical Operations, you will take incoming submission data and curate it for validity, accuracy, and severity as well as communicate directly with Bugcrowd’s clients or researchers when additional information is required. ASEs also handle Incident Response – escalating and communicating about the highest severity bugs to clients. ASEs need to have strong knowledge of OWASP Top Ten type vulnerabilities. They also usually require a strong skill set in one scripting/development language, often to assist with the design or development of tooling for improving the triage/validation process. The ASE position is perfect for security professionals looking to take their skills to the next level.

Education, Experience, Skills, & Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree or previous security consulting experience
  • Published and demonstrated passion for security assessment research
  • High proficiency with Burp Suite (or any other interception proxy) and a working level of experience with other industry standard tools (nmap, sqlmap, anything included in Kali Linux)

  • Ability to complete tasks on time
  • Strong organization, influencing, and communication skills

jobs.description:
OEM & xPU Partnerships Lead

Remote - US

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we're helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud — managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an: OEM & xPU Partnerships Lead!

About the Role

Backblaze recently closed a landmark, $300M+ TCV NeoCloud win — proof that the flywheel works. But it stalls without validated reference architectures embedded at the silicon and systems layer.

This role owns getting B2 designed-in at leading GPU/xPU silicon providers and the OEM/ODM hardware tier, so that every GPU cluster configured for AI inference or training has B2 as the default object storage layer. At the same time, you'll build out the storage tiering motion from flash-tier storage platforms to object storage on HDD with Backblaze. You are the person who makes Backblaze the storage answer before a customer ever talks to a sales rep.

This is a build role: some relationships and reference architectures already exist, and a meaningful part of the program is still being created as you run it. You'll need to be technically credible enough to lead a silicon-level architecture conversation, and commercially sharp enough to run the sales and strategic relationship side of the partnership.

What You'll Own

Designed-In at the Silicon Layer

  • Establish and advance Backblaze B2 as a validated storage tier within leading GPU and AI data platform ecosystems — integrated, reference-architecture-certified.
  • Drive "design-in" motions with major xPU and accelerator vendors to close competitive gaps in reference architecture positioning.
  • Build relationships with emerging xPU vendors early enough to be designed into their validated stacks before competitive displacement occurs.

OEM & ODM Tier

  • Own the joint go-to-market with leading OEM/ODM hardware manufacturers — turning their hardware deployments into B2-integrated solutions sold as complete infrastructure.
  • Extend these relationships into the flash-tier storage space, building a clear tiering narrative from flash-tier storage platforms to object storage on HDD.
  • Structure OEM agreements and co-sell motions that create pull-through B2 ARR from hardware-first deals. Build the commercial model — referral, resell, or embedded — for each OEM tier.
  • Identify and close 2–3 new OEM/ODM partnerships per year that generate $10M+ in partner-influenced ARR within the first 6 months.

Turnkey Reference Architectures

  • Deliver 5+ published, co-branded reference architectures by end of FY2026 — pairing GPU compute configurations with B2 as the validated storage layer.
  • Work with the NeoCloud team and Developer Relations (Flamethrower) to produce technical validation content that serves both the partner and the end customer.
  • Ensure reference architectures are submitted to and accepted by Tier-1 analyst firms.

Channel Sales & Commercial Execution

  • Negotiate and structure commercial OEM terms — referral, resell, or embedded models — that convert designed-in positions into sourced, quota-bearing pipeline.
  • Carry and deliver against an OEM-sourced pipeline and bookings target, running this program with the discipline of a channel sales motion, not just technical alliance management.
  • Partner with Account Executives to convert OEM-designed ("powered by") positions into sourced pipeline and closed revenue.

Cross-Functional

  • Feed product roadmap gaps — cold storage tier, archive — to Product & Engineering.
  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering so every OEM co-development produces a publishable, reusable reference asset.

Goal Accountability

  • Contribute to the OEM-influenced bookings goal through designed-in positions and OEM-sourced pipeline.
  • Deliver two flagship reference architectures — one with a leading silicon/GPU platform, one with a leading OEM/ODM hardware partner — as co-marketed technical validation.
  • Convert designed-in positions at top target accounts into closed, OEM-sourced revenue.

The Right Fit

Required

  • 10+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, or OEM/ODM business development — preferably in cloud infrastructure, storage, or AI systems.
  • Existing relationships at major GPU/xPU silicon providers or leading server/storage OEMs — you know who owns the ecosystem programs and you can get a meeting.
  • Track record of quota-carrying sales or channel sales performance, with experience negotiating commercial OEM terms such as referral, resell, or embedded agreements.
  • Experience structuring and closing OEM agreements — referral, resell, embedded, or co-sell — with a track record of partner-influenced ARR.
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML infrastructure: you understand GPU cluster architecture, storage tiering, accelerator software stacks, and how storage fits into training and inference workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive reference architecture co-development — from whiteboard to published, co-branded technical validation.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce for partner pipeline tracking and forecasting.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience working inside or alongside a major GPU/xPU vendor's partner ecosystem program.
  • Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage in AI data pipeline contexts (training data ingestion, checkpoint storage, inference output).
  • Background at a cloud storage, IaaS, or AI infrastructure vendor — not a hyperscaler; we are explicitly the non-hyperscaler option.
  • Existing relationships at emerging xPU vendors is a significant differentiator.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You need a mature partner program handed to you — this is a build role. The reference architecture playbook exists for one flagship deal; you are extending it across the OEM tier.
  • You lead with slide decks instead of relationships — the first 90 days are relationship mapping and meeting cadences, not program documentation.

About the role:
The Sr. Manager, Revenue Strategy & Recovery owns Lingraphica's full payor revenue engine, end to end - from maximizing every dollar through contract negotiation and payor strategy on the front end, to billing, collections, cash posting, and reconciliation on the back end. This role sets our minimum allowable contract pricing and drives ASP performance through negotiation, then ensures that value is fully realized once a claim is submitted through the point cash lands and is applied correctly. The Sr. Manager directly manages the Reimbursement Manager, Cash Posting & Reconciliation Manager, and Payor Strategy Manager; sets strategy and standards for the department; and owns AR health and cash performance at a strategic level - bringing payor strategy and contracting together with billing, collections, and cash operations under a single, dedicated leader. The role reports directly to the Director, Operations.

Responsibilities: 

Payor Strategy & Contracting

  • Set and drive the strategy for payor access and expansion, prioritizing markets and payors that advance Lingraphica's growth plan.

  • Lead negotiation of payor contract terms and reimbursement rates, directly or through the Payor Strategy Manager, to strengthen Lingraphica's rate position.

  • Own payor policy tracking and payor analytics, translating payor trends and performance data into pricing, contracting, and access strategy.

  • Build and lead the Payor Strategy Manager, ensuring contracting has the staffing and analytical support to scale.

Revenue Cycle Operations – Billing and Collections

  • Oversee the Reimbursement Manager and billing/collections team to ensure timely, accurate claims submission and follow-up.

  • Own collections performance, aging, and denial-management workflows, identifying and resolving systemic issues at the root cause.

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Payor Readiness to ensure a clean handoff from funding/authorization into billing.

  • Drives cash flow performance across the revenue cycle, including preparation and ongoing management of the cash forecast to support accurate financial planning.

Cash Posting & Reconciliation

  • Oversee the Cash Posting & Reconciliation Manager to ensure cash received is accurately posted and reconciled against contracted rates.

  • Establish reconciliation processes that flag underpayments or rate discrepancies against negotiated contract terms, closing the loop back to payor strategy.

Strategy & Analytics

  • Build and report on KPIs spanning payor access, contract rates, billing/collections performance, and cash reconciliation accuracy.

  • Bring a data-driven business case to payor negotiations and prioritization decisions.

General

  • Maintains current, expert-level knowledge of payor reimbursement terms, billing regulations, and collections compliance requirements

  • May be required to perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, including direct experience with payor contracting or reimbursement rate negotiation with at least 5 years of management experience

  • Proven people-leadership experience managing managers and multi-team departments.

  • Strong knowledge of billing, collections, and cash reconciliation workflows in a healthcare or DME/HME environment.

  • Demonstrated experience building or owning a cash forecast or AR/revenue model

  • Track record of using data and analytics to inform payor and contracting strategy.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and cross-functional influence skills.

  • Ability and willingness to travel within the U.S. (including airline travel) is required up to 2 times per year for in-person team and all-company meetings

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in speech-generating devices, durable medical equipment, or related healthcare technology space.

  • Experience building or scaling a dedicated payor strategy or managed care department.

  • Familiarity with payor policy analytics and reimbursement modeling tools.

Work Environment & Physical Demands 

Work is performed remotely from a home office. The individual is expected to maintain a safe, productive workspace with reliable and secure internet access. This role requires the ability to operate a computer, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Accommodations 

At Lingraphica, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all employees. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to complete each essential duty and physical demand. The requirements listed above represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities required, as well as the physical demands associated with the role. We recognize that everyone’s needs are unique, and we are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities in performing the essential functions of the job.

If you require accommodation, please reach out to Human Resources at for assistance. We are here to help!

At Lingraphica, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The starting salary range for this position is $91,600 - 110,000 per year. Placement in the starting pay is based on factors such as experience, skills, education, and internal equity. jobs.description:
L'équipe Product s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

Nous recherchons une personne capable d'analyser les données d'usage, d'en tirer des recommandations concrètes pour les équipes de direction, puis de les transformer en actions et en automatisations à fort impact.

Tu es le cerveau de notre intelligence client. Tu détectes ce que nos données disent avant que les problèmes arrivent, tu construis les systèmes qui permettent d'agir dessus, et tu influences les décisions stratégiques de l'entreprise grâce à des insights actionnables.

Comment tu vas le faire ?

1. Détecter les risques et opportunités avant tout le monde

  • Construire des modèles de scoring de churn, d'engagement et d'expansion

  • Identifier les signaux faibles qui précèdent un churn ou une montée en valeur

  • Mettre en place des dashboards de priorisation client pour les équipes CS et Business

  • Formuler des recommandations actionnées, pas juste des constats

2. Construire le système d'intelligence client

  • Centraliser la connaissance client depuis toutes les sources : Mixpanel, CRM, etc.

  • Structurer une vue unifiée et fiable du comportement client, accessible à tous

  • Définir et maintenir les métriques clés qui reflètent la réalité du cycle de vie client

  • Construire des pipelines robustes de compréhension client

3. Automatiser les actions au bon moment

  • Concevoir et déployer des scénarios d'automation déclenchés par des signaux comportementaux réels

  • Créer des communications personnalisées et contextuelles selon le niveau d'engagement

  • Orchestrer des workflows multi-étapes couvrant l'onboarding, la réactivation, et l'expansion

  • Mesurer et optimiser en continu l'impact de chaque action

4. Influencer la stratégie de l'entreprise

  • Présenter des insights à fort impact au Comex et aux équipes dirigeantes

  • Traduire les signaux comportementaux en recommandations produit, marketing et business

  • Devenir la référence interne pour tout ce qui touche à la compréhension du client

  • Promouvoir une culture de décision basée sur la donnée dans toute l'organisation

Ce qu'on attend de toi en 90 jours

  • Cartographie complète des sources de données et des incohérences existantes

  • 2 dashboards de priorisation opérationnels pour les équipes CS et Business

  • 3 scénarios d'automation en production (onboarding, réengagement, alerte churn)

  • Un modèle de scoring de churn couvrant 80%+ de la base active

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de la team Product, composée de 5 personnes.

Tu travailleras également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Sales et Customer Success afin de concevoir et faire évoluer des produits qui répondent aux besoins de nos clients.

Profil recherché

🧠 Esprit analytique : tu sais extraire, analyser et transformer des données en recommandations concrètes.

⚙️ Culture de l'automatisation : tu conçois des workflows et des intégrations qui simplifient et accélèrent le travail.

🤖 À l'aise avec l'IA : tu utilises les outils d'IA au quotidien pour coder, analyser et gagner en efficacité.

🚀 Builder orienté action : tu préfères créer des solutions utiles plutôt que produire des analyses qui restent théoriques.

🎯 Autonome et force de proposition : tu prends des initiatives, priorises tes sujets et sais convaincre les bonnes personnes.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :60K-70K fixe

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto :carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle :couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation :dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être :participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.

Coworking :accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 6 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

jobs.title: Lead, Business Development & Licensing - Sureel AI
jobs.excerpt: A little bit about our teamSureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.
jobs.description:
A little bit about our team

Sureel AI is building the standards and infrastructure for AI rights, licensing, attribution, protection, and intelligence, starting in music and expanding across media.

We are building the infrastructure that enables creators and rights holders to control how their work is used by AI, protect their rights, understand its use and value, and participate in new AI licensing models. We also provide AI companies and digital platforms with the systems they need to access rights, permissions, attribution, guardrails, reporting, and licensing infrastructure programmatically.

Acquired by Warner Music Group, Sureel operates as an independent, federated company, combining startup speed with the reach of a global music company.

Our commercial relationships sit at the heart of what we're building: with the AI companies and digital service providers (DSPs) who integrate our attribution infrastructure into their platforms, and with the rights holders whose works and interests that infrastructure protects. As Director, Business Development & Licensing, you'll own the business function across both sides of that equation, working closely with senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners across the music, technology, and legal worlds. Your work will directly shape the commercial architecture of AI attribution at scale.

Your role

You will lead Sureel's business function, reporting to the CEO and two Co-Presidents. This is a senior, commercially focused role. When Sureel is negotiating with a service provider or a rights holder, you will own the business function of that negotiation.

You will also serve as Sureel's primary liaison with industry bodies such as DDEX and regulatory bodies such as WIPO where their activities relate to Sureel's business.

A key part of the role will be developing business models and modeling outcomes for charging clients, including DSPs and AI companies. A strong understanding of economics and music rights will be important.

Your objective is to structure agreements that increase adoption of Sureel's infrastructure, create repeatable commercial models, and establish frameworks that can scale across multiple rights holders, AI companies, and markets.

You will negotiate licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and the economic frameworks that determine how permissions through Sureel's technology translate into compensation. You will also oversee the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining what a commercially viable integration looks like and structuring the terms around it.

You'll work closely with Product and Client Relations. They will bring the product and partner perspectives, while you will lead the commercial structure and economics that support the business.

This is an opportunity to help define the business function of a company working in a new and evolving area, and to help shape how creators are compensated in the age of AI.

What you'll do:

  • Own the business function for Sureel's negotiations, whether with AI companies, DSPs, other digital service providers, or rights holders, leading commercial strategy, deal structure, and terms from first conversation through signature.

  • Negotiate the economics of platform integrations, including licensing models, revenue structures, payment flows, and frameworks that reflect the value of Sureel's technology alongside rights holders' catalog and distribution positions.

  • Develop the business use cases for integrating Sureel's infrastructure with AI companies and DSPs, defining commercial success and prioritizing opportunities based on enterprise value.

  • Develop licensing and economic frameworks for an emerging category, using relevant AI and rights-technology transactions to inform agreements that can work across different partners and markets.

  • Structure multi-stakeholder commercial arrangements among rights holders and industry participants, positioning Sureel's infrastructure as the mechanism for executing those agreements.

  • Partner with Client Relations on rights-holder relationships, owning the commercial terms and deal economics while they lead the broader relationship and delivery.

  • Work closely with Warner Music Group counterparts on commercial terms, licensing structures, and strategic priorities.

  • Provide market intelligence on emerging technologies, competitive developments, licensing innovation, and deal dynamics across the AI and DSP landscape.

  • Represent Sureel with industry and standards organizations, including DDEX, WIPO, and other initiatives shaping AI rights and licensing.

  • Develop pricing and packaging for Sureel's platform, including enterprise fees, API and usage-based pricing, transaction fees, revenue share, licensing administration, analytics, and hybrid structures.

  • Create repeatable commercial and licensing frameworks that can scale across partners rather than requiring every agreement to be built from scratch.

  • Help structure how Sureel infrastructure is used in commercial agreements, including rights, permissions, guardrails, attribution, reporting, and economic obligations between rights holders and AI companies.

  • Handle confidential and proprietary information, including deal terms, partner economics, and negotiations with discretion and integrity.

  • Help shape emerging industry standards and licensing frameworks so they can be implemented programmatically and work with Sureel's architecture.

Who you are:

  • You have deep experience structuring and negotiating commercial agreements in music, media, or technology, including licensing deals, platform integrations, revenue-share structures, or rights-technology transactions.

  • You've owned the business side of negotiations with platforms, DSPs, technology companies, or rights holders and carried complex deals from term sheet through signature.

  • You understand the economics of the music industry: how rights generate revenue, how licensing frameworks are built, and how value flows between platforms, intermediaries, and rights holders.

  • You're comfortable with data and financial detail. You can model a revenue structure, pressure-test assumptions, and explain the business logic clearly to technical teams and senior counterparties.

  • You can structure complex deals and find approaches that work for the different parties involved.

  • You build trust quickly and can represent leadership in high-stakes negotiations, make judgment calls on terms, and know when to escalate.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person and can stay calm in a fast-moving environment.

  • You understand how pricing, licensing structures, technical standards, and ecosystem incentives can support platform adoption and durable commercial outcomes.

  • You are interested in the music industry and enjoy working in a small, collaborative, startup-paced team.

We'd love it if you also had:

  • Direct experience negotiating with AI companies, DSPs, or other digital service providers on licensing, integration, or commercial partnership terms.

  • Experience working with artists, labels, publishers, or CMOs/PROs on the commercial side, or serving as a senior deal advisor to them.

  • Experience across deal structuring and licensing, business development, commercial strategy, or partnerships.

  • Involvement in industry licensing, standards, or policy initiatives shaping how AI and rights interact.

  • Experience working directly with C-level executives on commercial strategy, negotiation preparation, and translating senior conversations into agreements.

  • Experience developing commercial models for infrastructure, APIs, marketplaces, payments, rights technology, or other platforms where value is monetized across multiple layers of a transaction.

  • Curiosity about the music and entertainment landscape and AI's impact on creators.

Sureel AI is an independent, federated company within Warner Music Group. We're committed to building a diverse team and to fair recognition for creators everywhere.

jobs.title: Initial Closing Disclosure Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) Analyst plays a critical role in the mortgage loan process by preparing, reviewing, and verifying the accuracy of the Initial Closing Disclosures (ICD).
jobs.description:
The Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) Analyst plays a critical role in the mortgage loan process by preparing, reviewing, and verifying the accuracy of the Initial Closing Disclosures (ICD). This position ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies, ensuring borrowers receive accurate and timely disclosures of loan terms and costs. The ICD Analyst collaborates with internal teams such as loan processors, underwriters, and closing officers to resolve discrepancies and ensure smooth and timely loan closings.

Key Responsibilities

Preparation of Initial Closing Disclosures:
  • Generate and review Initial Closing Disclosure (ICD) documents for accuracy and completeness in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure that the ICD is sent to the borrower at least three business days prior to closing, adhering to TRID (TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure) regulations.
Data Review and Verification:
  • Review loan terms, fees, taxes, and other financial data to ensure they are accurately reflected in the ICD.
  • Cross-check all loan documentation to ensure alignment with underwriting conditions and customer information.
  • Identify and resolve any discrepancies in loan documentation prior to issuing the ICD.
Compliance and Regulatory Adherence:
  • Stay up to date with federal and state mortgage regulations (including TRID) to ensure all disclosures meet legal standards.
  • Maintain detailed records of all issued ICDs and monitor timelines to ensure compliance with the three-day disclosure rule.
Collaboration with Internal Teams:
  • Work closely with loan officers, underwriters, processors, and closing coordinators to ensure all necessary data is collected and accurately reflected in the ICD.
  • Communicate with the loan origination team to address any borrower questions or concerns regarding the closing disclosure.
Quality Assurance and Reporting:
  • Conduct quality control checks on all ICDs before submission to ensure there are no errors or omissions.
  • Report any issues or trends regarding ICD errors or compliance risks to management for further review.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems quickly.
  • Familiarity with loan documentation, including closing disclosures, loan estimates, and underwriting terms.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage workflow efficiently.

Benefits

  • Above market salary
  • HMO with free dependent
  • Paid leave incentives
  • Performance based Incentives
  • Quarterly Company Events
  • In-depth training for career growth

AcuityMD is a software and data platform that accelerates access to medical technologies. We help MedTech companies understand how their products are used, why customers vary, and identify opportunities for physicians to better serve their patients. Each year, the FDA approves ~6,000 new medical devices. Our solution helps MedTech companies get these products to physicians more effectively so they can improve patient care with the latest technology. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, and Ajax Health. We're a high-growth AI and Data company scaling rapidly.

In this role, you will drive strategic insight and operational rigor across the Commercial organization, while also building and scaling AcuityMD's Value Consulting function. You will do this by owning core GTM and RevOps strategy, leading high-impact cross-functional initiatives, and creating the methodology, tools, and playbooks that let every AE and CSM run credible, data-backed value conversations — while personally engaging on strategic deals, renewals, and EBRs where a deeper value case is needed.

Team Mission

Revenue Operations and Commercial Intelligence exists to increase the velocity of the Commercial organization at AcuityMD and drive excellence across the team through strategy, operations, and analysis. This role also owns the build-out of AcuityMD's Value Consulting function — sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, and Product — to ensure every commercial conversation is grounded in a clear, defensible articulation of AcuityMD's ROI. Together, these functions build and improve the processes, tools, and frameworks that enable the Commercial and Revenue teams to scale efficiently while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Build the value consulting capability from the ground up: value methodology, discovery frameworks, ROI and TCO models, executive business case templates, and self-serve tooling the field can run without you
  • Engage on strategic deals, renewals, and EBRs where a deeper, data-backed value case is needed
  • Consolidate and sharpen existing value tools (ROI calculators, value slide templates, the in-product Care Journeys ROI Calculator) into a single, scalable value framework
  • Build a benchmark library and value proof pack tying ROI outputs to validated customer success stories
  • Design and run enablement sessions to train AEs and CSMs on value-selling tools and methodology

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, private equity, corporate strategy or a similar analytical role

  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience building value/ROI frameworks, business cases, or economic value assessments for enterprise buyers
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to articulate complex topics clearly and effectively, including to CFOs and economic buyers

  • A track record of operating independently in a fast-paced, results-driven environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in a Go-To-Market Strategy, Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, or Value/Solutions Engineering role
  • Familiarity with SaaS business models and MedTech industry dynamics
  • You have stood up a value consulting, value engineering, or business value function before
  • MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative field
  • Passion for healthcare innovation and improving patient access to medical technologies

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base Salary Range: $175,000-$215,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

jobs.description:
Position Overview

Senior Counsel will work independently and collaboratively on complex legal matters for FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation and its affiliated global CDMO business, FUJIFILM Diosynth Biotechnologies, with locations in North Carolina, Texas, United Kingdom, and Denmark, to minimize legal risk and protect and maximize the company’s legal rights. The role serves as a principal legal advisor and recognized expert for FUJIFILM Diosynth Biotechnologies globally, providing sophisticated, business‑centric counsel on issues that materially impact current programs and future concepts. It applies extensive knowledge of commercial, regulatory, and intellectual property frameworks to resolve critical issues—often with limited information—balancing near‑term execution with long‑term strategic objectives and risk management. The Senior Counsel leads the application of best‑practice legal principles, guides the development of new ideas and templates, and shapes contracting standards that span multiple functions and geographies. Operating with wide latitude, the position builds formal networks with key decision makers and may act as an external spokesperson on legal and compliance matters relevant to the CDMO/Life Sciences sector.

Location: Remote, preferred on the East Coast.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. At Fujifilm you’ll have the opportunity to explore and grow your skills in new, exciting ways. Whether you’re shaping tomorrow’s tech or redefining today’s processes, we’ll provide a flexible work environment and dynamic culture where innovation thrives.

Our Americas HQ is nestled in Valhalla, New York, a charming town known for its excellent schools, beautiful parks, and easy access to the vibrancy of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex business critical commercial contracts (e.g., MSAs, SOWs, supply, development/manufacturing/services, quality agreements, NDAs) to align with business objectives and risk appetite.
  • Advises on and reports to senior management on legal and regulatory risks impacting CDMO/Life Sciences operations (e.g., GMP, pharmacovigilance interfaces, data privacy, competition), escalating appropriately, proposing risk-mitigation strategies and developing contractual language to minimize risk.
  • Acts as principal advisor and thought leader: creates formal networks with key internal and external decision makers; represents the Legal function in executive forums; may serve as external spokesperson on legal topics germane to the CDMO/Life Sciences sector.
  • Works with internal teams to respond to horizon scanning and develops long term legal strategies and frameworks that influence strategic goals and future products/services; guides development of new ideas and positions.
  • Partners with Commercial and Program teams on strategic, high value collaborations and bids; drives issue resolution to enable timely deal closure and sustainable, customer focused outcomes.
  • Manages a high volume, complex caseload autonomously, prioritizing based upon enterprise value and risk in the context of strategic goals; communicates progress and positions clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Provides guidance on non-contentious intellectual property (e.g., licensing frameworks, background/foreground IP, know how, freedom to operate issues) shapes IP allocation standards for platform deals to facilitate long term strategies
  • Designs, instigates and delivers legal training and playbooks; educates and leads stakeholders to elevate commercial acumen and compliance culture across multiple functions and regions
  • Optimizes legal processes, templates, and (contract lifecycle management) CLM/data insights; leads continuous improvement initiatives that enhance cycle time, quality, and consistency.
  • Engages and manages outside counsel (e.g., specialized regulatory, disputes, employment, real estate), ensuring value, quality, and timely delivery against budgets and guidelines ensuring internal goals are met
  • Supports dispute avoidance and resolution and provides input on corporate matters and transactions as needed, protecting the company’s legal rights and reputation.
  • Contributes to policy, compliance program rollout, and cross-group alignment (with UK, Denmark, US and global FUJIFILM Legal/Compliance), ensuring consistency of standards and precedents/ risk position.

Required Skills/Education

  • College degree and juris doctorate from accredited law school.
  • Admitted to at least one state bar in good standing. NC admission preferred.
  • 8-12 years of relevant experience in a corporate law firm and/or in-house legal department, in the CDMO, Life Science/Pharma, or health care field.
  • Professionally recognized as having extensive knowledge of commercial law, contracting theory/practice, and legal design; principal level advisor capable of resolving critical issues with limited information and high judgment.
  • Excellent negotiation and executive communication skills; adept at influencing senior leaders and shaping cross functional decisions.
  • Strong analytical, pragmatic, and customer focused problem solving; balances near term outcomes with long term strategic objectives.
  • Demonstrated work within matrixed/global environments.
  • Familiarity with compliance topics relevant to life sciences (e.g., data privacy/GDPR, competition, anti-bribery).
  • Familiarity with international contracting and multi-jurisdictional risk assessments.
  • Proficiency with modern legal technology (document management, e signature; facility with CLM and collaboration platforms).
  • Ability to travel 10-20% domestic and internationally.

Desired Skills

  • Academic honors are preferred.
  • Management Skills
  • Business acumen
  • Follow-Up
  • Negotiation and Leadership Skills
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Collaboration
  • Analytical Ability
  • Autonomy
  • Budget Conscious

Salary and Benefits:

  • $170,000 to $210,000 depending on experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401k
  • Paid Time Off

jobs.excerpt: FunctieomschrijvingAls Process Safety Engineer ondersteun je procesontwerpen en risicobeoordelingen met technische veiligheidsberekeningen.
jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Als Process Safety Engineer ondersteun je procesontwerpen en risicobeoordelingen met technische veiligheidsberekeningen. Je helpt mee verzekeren dat installaties voldoen aan geldende wetgeving en interne veiligheidsnormen. Daarbij pas je onder meer methodes toe voor vent sizing, gasdispersiestudies, explosiedrukberekeningen en thermische of kinetische analyses. Je levert daarnaast inhoudelijke input voor projecten, audits en veiligheidsstudies.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Uitvoeren van berekeningen voor drukontlasting, zoals relief valve sizing.
  • Analyseren van thermische risico’s, runaway reactions en warmtebalansen.
  • Opstellen van explosie- en brandscenarioanalyses, waaronder gasdispersiestudies, BLEVE, jet fire en pool fire.
  • Ondersteunen van HAZOP- en LOPA-studies met kwantitatieve berekeningen.
  • Interpreteren van procesdata en P&ID’s om veiligheidskritische parameters te bepalen.
  • Verzamelen en toepassen van gegevens uit literatuur, databanken en experimentele testen, bijvoorbeeld chemische reactiedata.
  • Schrijven van technische rapporten en formuleren van aanbevelingen op basis van berekeningsresultaten.
  • Samenwerken met procesingenieurs, HSE-experts, projectteams en externe gespecialiseerde partners.
  • Bijdragen aan evaluaties rond ATEX en impactanalyses in het kader van procesveiligheid.
  • Gebruikmaken van tools zoals Excel en relevante simulatietoepassingen voor technische calculaties en veiligheidsanalyses.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je behaalde een master in chemische technologie, procestechnologie, veiligheidstechniek of een gelijkwaardige technische richting.
  • Je hebt minstens 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring in procesveiligheid of in een technische berekeningsrol binnen een industriële omgeving.
  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van relevante normen en richtlijnen binnen procesveiligheid en HSE.
  • Je hebt ervaring met tools zoals DWSIM, Aspen Plus, Phast, CFD-software of Excel-gebaseerde calculaties.
  • Je werkt analytisch, nauwkeurig en met een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
  • Je beschikt over goede technische schrijfvaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.
  • Je bent een kritische denker met een gestructureerde aanpak.
  • Kennis van ATEX en ATEX impact assessments is vereist.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. As part of Gartner’s Assurance Practice, you will join a dynamic team focused on advising Chief Audit Executives and their teams. This role includes both writing and speaking about best practices in audit planning and risk coverage. The Director Analyst of Internal Audit will also lead internal insight discussions among fellow analysts and collaborate with analysts across Gartner’s Assurance Practice.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task
