jobs.description:
The Role:

We’re looking for a Customer Success & Support Lead to help own the customer experience across customer success, support, and escalations.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable building strong customer relationships, coordinating across internal teams, and digging into technical issues when something goes wrong. You’ll be a trusted partner to our customers while also helping our team understand what customers are experiencing, where problems are coming from, and how we can improve.

You won’t be expected to be a software engineer, but you should be technically curious and comfortable investigating issues beyond the surface level. You should be able to reproduce problems and ask the right technical questions, and work effectively with engineering to identify root causes.

We’re looking for someone who is calm under pressure, strong with people, highly accountable, and willing to jump in wherever needed to make customers successful.

Responsibilities:

  • Own customer relationships. Build trusted relationships with customers, understand their goals, and help them get meaningful value from the product.

  • Drive customer success. Proactively identify risks, adoption challenges, and opportunities to help customers use the product more effectively.

  • Support customers hands-on. Help respond to customer questions and issues, particularly when they require more context, coordination, or investigation.

  • Lead escalations. Take ownership of high-priority or sensitive customer issues, keep customers informed, coordinate internal teams, and drive issues through resolution.

  • Investigate technical issues. Reproduce problems, gather relevant information, inspect system behavior, and help narrow down root causes before or alongside engineering involvement.

  • Translate between customers and engineering. Turn customer-reported problems into clear, actionable technical context and explain technical issues back to customers in an understandable way.

  • Coordinate across teams. Work closely with engineering, product, sales, and other customer-facing teams to make sure customer needs are understood and addressed.

  • Identify patterns. Look across support tickets, escalations, and customer conversations to identify recurring issues, product gaps, or opportunities for improvement.

  • Improve customer operations. Help build better processes for support, escalation management, onboarding, communication, documentation, and customer follow-up.

  • Advocate for customers. Bring customer feedback into product and engineering discussions while balancing individual requests with broader product priorities.

  • Create clarity during incidents. Communicate clearly and consistently when issues arise, setting expectations with both customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Help scale the function. Establish best practices and help raise the bar for how we support, communicate with, and retain customers.

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience in customer success, technical account management, customer support, solutions engineering, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

  • Bonus: experience working with Healthcare SaaS.

  • A strong track record of building trusted relationships with customers.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with a wide range of personalities, from end users to executives to engineers.

  • Experience managing customer escalations and high-pressure situations with empathy, urgency, and good judgment.

  • Ability to take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to resolution.

  • Strong technical curiosity and comfort troubleshooting software issues.

  • Ability to understand concepts such as APIs, integrations, authentication, application logs, data flows, and basic system architecture.

  • Experience reproducing customer issues and gathering enough technical context to help engineering diagnose a problem.

  • Ability to distinguish between symptoms and underlying root causes rather than simply forwarding issues to engineering.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customers, issues, and priorities simultaneously.

  • Good judgment around when to solve an issue directly, when to escalate, and how to communicate throughout the process.

  • A collaborative mindset and a willingness to jump in wherever the customer experience needs help.

Technical Comfort:

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable getting technical.

That might include:

  • Helping debug and configure application settings to help a user.

  • Helping debug and configure computer-level settings to help a user (e.g. microphone settings).

  • Reading basic event logs or error messages.

  • Investigating integrations and data flows between systems.

  • Running basic queries in analytics tools when appropriate.

  • Reproducing bugs and documenting clear reproduction steps.

  • Understanding enough about our architecture to know where a problem may be occurring.

  • Partnering closely with engineers during debugging and incident response.

  • Bonus: Using browser developer tools to understand an issue.

The goal is not for you to fix every technical problem yourself. The goal is for you to meaningfully investigate issues, improve the quality of escalations, and help customers get to answers faster

Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

IT Project Manager, Facilities and Real Estate Specialist

Any location in Canada (Remote)

Position Summary

Thales is looking for an IT Project Manager, Facilities and Real Estate Specialist to be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of IT projects and initiatives, with a primary focus on Real Estate and Facilities-related efforts, including site openings and closures, renovations, workplace modernization, infrastructure enablement, and smart building technologies.

This role partners closely with internal stakeholders—including Real Estate, Corporate Security, Procurement, and IT functional teams—as well as external partners such as general contractors, subcontractors, telecom providers, and IT vendors to ensure seamless integration of technology into physical working environments.

In this position, while supporting a broader IT project portfolio, you will also be required to have deep experience in facilities-driven programs and serves as a subject matter expert for IT delivery of services in the context of various physical facility use cases including but not limited to new site fit up, renovations, as is moves, carve in and carve outs of business units. Success in this position depends on good working knowledge of site build & IT fit up processes, strong cross-functional coordination, effective vendor management, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards, governance, and financial objectives.

Tier 1 - Referral Bonus Payout - $2,500

Regulatory Compliance Requirements:

This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information controlled under the Canadian Export Control List, the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, the Canadian Industrial Security Program, the US International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or the US Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access including eligibility to the Canadian Controlled Goods Program and able to obtain a Canadian Enhanced Reliability security clearance.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Lead full lifecycle delivery (initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, closure) of IT projects, with emphasis on Real Estate and Facilities initiatives (e.g., site builds, moves, upgrades); elicit & manage IT requirements (includes Business Stakeholder & Corporate IT requirements); define the project’s WBS and IT Work Packages; develop and manage detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, risk plans, and dependencies for both facilities and non-facilities projects; ensure alignment with enterprise PMO methodologies and governance standards.
  • Serve as the IT lead for site-related initiatives, including office openings, consolidations, and closures; consult with Real Estate on Site Design Layout to ensure IT infrastructure standards are met; coordinate IT infrastructure deployment (network, AV, end-user computing, security systems, IoT/smart building tech) in alignment with construction and facilities timelines; partner with Facilities, Real Estate, Corporate Security, and external contractors to ensure seamless IT readiness at each site.
  • Prepare and deliver IT readiness requirement for IT to execute its work package tasks; prepare and deliver artifacts to support the Real Estate project gating process. This can include cost estimations from multiple IT services, Rough Order of Magnitude estimations of IT cost for budgetary purposes; review architectural diagrams such as low voltage plans; work with IT infrastructure team and Telecom providers to establish site connectivity.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, Facilities teams, and third-party vendors; manage vendor deliverables, contracts, and performance related to IT build-outs and infrastructure delivery; provide clear and consistent communication to leadership, including status updates, risks, and escalation paths.
  • Manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking (CapEx/OpEx alignment); provide & support cost estimation for IT activities related to facility initiatives and ensure efficient use of resources; track and report on key project KPIs (schedule adherence, cost variance, delivery quality); identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, particularly those related to physical site dependencies; ensure adherence to IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements; maintain proper documentation for audits and governance reviews.
  • Contribute to standard playbooks for IT site deployments and facility integrations; drive lessons learned and process improvements across Real Estate-related project delivery; support adoption of standardized tools (e.g., ServiceNow, project portfolio tools, collaboration platforms).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Business, or related field; 8-10+ years of IT project management experience, with a focus on the delivery of IT infrastructure equipment and capabilities to either internal/external stakeholders or customers; demonstrated experience managing Real Estate / Facilities-related IT projects (e.g., office builds, relocations, or major renovations).
  • Working knowledge of IT infrastructure domains (networking, end-user computing, AV, security systems); strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid).
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs involving Facilities, Construction, and IT teams; proven ability to manage budgets, vendors, and multiple concurrent projects.
  • Experience with project management and portfolio tools (e.g., ServiceNow PPM, MS Project, Jira, or equivalent. Primavera is a nice to have); proficiency in collaboration and reporting tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification (or actively pursuing).
  • Ability to travel to site locations as required; strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future.

If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!

Special Position Requirements

  • Schedule: Standard hours Monday through Friday from 8am to 5pm ET or 9am to 6pm ET but there are times where after hours and/or weekend work is necessary to support critical path real-estate tasks such as final site turn up.
  • Travel: Can be expected up to 20% if there are multiple real estate projects actively being executed. This includes travel to the United States.

Why Join Us?

Say HI and learn more about working at Thales click here.

Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 24 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:

• Company paid Extended Health, Dental, HSA, Life, AD&D, Short-term Disability, Cancer Care Program, travel insurance, Employee Assistance Plan and Well-Being program.

• Retirement Savings Plans (RRSP, DCPP, TFSA) with a company contribution and a match to a DCPP, with no vesting period.

• Company paid holidays, vacation days, and paid sick leave.

• Voluntary Life, AD&D, Critical Illness, Long-Term Disability.

• Employee Discounts on home, auto, and gym membership.

Thales is an equal opportunity employer which values diversity and inclusivity in the workplace. Thales is committed to providing accommodations in all parts of the interview process. Applicants selected for an interview who require accommodation are asked to advise accordingly upon the invitation for an interview. We will work with you to meet your needs. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

jobs.excerpt: ENGINEERING LEADOwn the technical vision for your systems.
jobs.description:
ENGINEERING LEAD

Own the technical vision for your systems. Keep them sound as everything ships.

The Role

As an Engineering Lead at Counterpart, you are the architect and tech lead for a domain: the claims system, the underwriting platform, the infrastructure layer, or another area where the systems are tightly coupled and need one person keeping them honest. You know how your systems work, how they should evolve, and where they break. You own the technical vision for them.

During planning, you partner with a Technical Product Manager to break initiatives into projects and write the high-level technical requirements for each. Before you lock an approach, you check with the other Engineering Leads: is anyone solving something similar, and should we solve it once? During execution, you run the technical review that gates each project, then step back and let the project team build. You come back in when an architectural question surfaces.

Together with the other Engineering Leads, you set and maintain Counterpart's technical standards. You are also an engineer. You build, and you can be called on to lead a project yourself.

People management is optional in this role, not the default. Some Engineering Leads manage a few engineers; most do not. Either way, you lead primarily through the technical vision, the standards, and the quality of your own work, not through the org chart.

YOU WILL

Own the Technical Vision for Your Systems

  • Know where each system in your domain is going, how they depend on each other, and where the boundaries and data contracts need to be explicit.
  • Hold the line on architecture. Catch redundant systems before they get built. Push for reuse and consolidation. Say no when the easier path creates long-term sprawl.
  • Check with the other Engineering Leads before locking a technical approach: is anyone solving something similar, does this create or break an assumption in another domain? Lightweight, peer-to-peer. Natural collaboration over process.
  • Make deliberate calls on technical debt within your domain. Know when to accumulate it, when to pay it down, and when to refactor. Communicate the trade-offs to your Technical Product Manager and the VP of Engineering.
  • Own the context architecture for your domain. Keep documentation, design patterns, and domain knowledge up to date so engineers can operate your systems without relying on tribal knowledge.

Plan the Work

  • Partner with your Technical Product Manager during planning. Combined, you turn business problems into initiatives and projects. You write the high-level technical requirements for each project: the system approach, the scalability, security, and integration considerations that determine whether the plan is real.
  • Roll projects up to a rough t-shirt size (multi-month or single month) with your Technical Product Manager. For multi-month projects, define what is achievable within one month.
  • Advise the VP of Engineering on Project Lead assignments. You know which engineers can carry which projects.

Review Through Reviews

  • Run the technical review for each funded project in your domain. The Project Lead plays back the rounded-out requirements and approach. You confirm the approach fits your systems, follows the standards, and does not create problems the project team cannot see. Then development begins.
  • When a project touches more than one domain, bring the other domain's Engineering Lead into the technical review. One review, all affected leads present.
  • Answer architectural questions when the project team hits them mid-build. Otherwise, stay out of the day-to-day.

Set and Maintain Technical Standards

  • Produce and maintain Counterpart's shared technical standards with the other Engineering Leads. Keep them current, specific, and enforceable.
  • Enforce the standards within your domain. When work drifts from the agreed patterns, catch it early and course-correct.
  • Contribute to decisions on AI tooling and development practices. The Engineering Leads collectively decide how AI tools are used across the engineering organization.

Build

  • Write code and build systems when the work requires your depth. You do not delegate everything. You pick up the hardest problems in your domain.
  • Take the Project Lead hat when a project calls for it. Then you operate as any Project Lead does: round out requirements, run the reviews, break out tickets, delegate, check in with stakeholders, and iterate.
  • Stay at the frontier of AI development. Evaluate emerging frameworks, tools, and practices against Counterpart's systems. Share findings with the other Engineering Leads.
  • Review production incidents in your domain. Identify root causes indicating architectural gaps. Fix the architecture, not just the symptom.

Mentor

  • Mentor engineers working in your domain. Turn reviews and architectural questions into teaching moments. Raise the bar on how engineers think about system design.
  • Coach Project Leads through hard technical decisions. Help them see the trade-offs, then let them own the execution.

YOU HAVE

  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating complex software systems. You have built systems that lasted and maintained systems you inherited.
  • The ability to operate as both architect and individual contributor. You know which the situation calls for and you do not default to one.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing technical work from other engineers. You turn reviews into decisions, not debates. You can say no with clear reasoning and say yes with conviction.
  • Proficiency with Python, Django, Amazon Web Services (AWS), React, and PostgreSQL.
  • Proficiency developing with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) and the drive to stay ahead of how AI development practices are evolving.
  • Experience setting technical direction across teams without being the manager. You influence through architecture, reviews, and the quality of your own work.
  • Domain curiosity about insurance. You learn the business context your systems support, not just the systems themselves.
  • The ability to communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business. You translate technical complexity without losing meaning.
  • Low ego and high Emotional Quotient (EQ). You influence without authority, take feedback well, and leave your ego out of technical decisions.
  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.

Our estimated pay range for this role is $190,000 to $240,000. Base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to, market data, location, internal equitability, and experience.

We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone. We are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported, and connected at work—regardless of who they are or where they come from. We value and celebrate our differences and believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

jobs.description:
Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Media & Growth | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Digital Marketing / Performance Marketing Manager to plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven digital campaigns that generate leads, customers, and measurable revenue.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who understands how to turn advertising budgets into business results. You’ll manage paid campaigns, analyze performance, improve conversion efficiency, and continuously test audiences, creatives, messaging, and channels.

You’ll be accountable for metrics such as CPL, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and revenue impact — not just clicks and impressions.

What You’ll Own

Paid Media & Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns
  • Manage paid media across platforms such as:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Other relevant performance marketing channels
  • Monitor campaign budgets, pacing, and overall performance
  • Adjust targeting, bids, budgets, and campaign structures based on results
  • Ensure campaigns remain aligned with lead generation and revenue goals

Performance Analysis & Optimization

  • Track and analyze key performance metrics, including:
    • Cost per Lead (CPL)
    • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Conversion Rate
    • Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Identify underperforming campaigns and diagnose potential causes
  • Make data-driven decisions to improve campaign efficiency
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance trends

Audience, Keyword & Market Research

  • Conduct audience and customer research to improve targeting
  • Perform keyword research for paid search campaigns
  • Identify new audience segments and targeting opportunities
  • Monitor competitor activity and relevant market trends
  • Translate research into actionable campaign opportunities

Creative & Landing Page Collaboration

  • Collaborate on campaign messaging, offers, and creative direction
  • Work with designers, copywriters, or internal stakeholders on advertising assets
  • Support landing page optimization to improve conversion rates
  • Provide performance insights that help improve:
    • Ad copy
    • Creative concepts
    • Calls to action
    • Offers
    • Landing pages

Conversion Tracking & Attribution

  • Monitor conversion tracking across campaigns and digital channels
  • Work with analytics and tracking tools to understand the customer journey
  • Ensure campaign performance is measured accurately
  • Analyze attribution and identify which campaigns, channels, and audiences drive results
  • Troubleshoot tracking inconsistencies when required

Testing & Growth

  • Build structured testing plans across:
    • Audiences
    • Creatives
    • Messaging
    • Offers
    • Landing pages
    • Channels
  • Run A/B tests and analyze results
  • Scale winning campaigns while reducing inefficient spend
  • Identify new opportunities to improve acquisition performance

Reporting & Insights

  • Create regular campaign performance reports
  • Communicate results clearly to leadership and stakeholders
  • Highlight performance trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Translate campaign data into clear recommendations and next steps
  • Maintain visibility into advertising spend and business impact

Requirements

  • 2+ years of digital marketing or performance marketing experience
  • Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns
  • Experience with one or more platforms such as:
    • Google Ads
    • Meta Ads
    • LinkedIn Ads
    • Similar paid acquisition platforms
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, CAC, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rates
  • Experience managing advertising budgets
  • Comfortable analyzing campaign data and making optimization decisions
  • Strong understanding of audience targeting and campaign testing
  • Strong communication and reporting skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Analytics and digital tracking tools
  • Experience with conversion tracking and attribution
  • Experience optimizing landing pages and conversion funnels
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms
  • Experience managing campaigns across multiple paid channels
  • B2B, SaaS, e-commerce, agency, or lead-generation marketing experience

Tools & Platforms

Google Ads | Meta Ads | LinkedIn Ads | Google Analytics | Conversion Tracking & Attribution Tools | CRM & Marketing Platforms | Google Sheets / Excel

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Think in terms of revenue and acquisition efficiency, not vanity metrics
  • Are comfortable owning campaign performance
  • Enjoy analyzing data and turning it into action
  • Know how to balance creative experimentation with performance analysis
  • Proactively identify ways to improve CPL, CAC, ROAS, and conversion rates
  • Test systematically instead of relying on assumptions
  • Can clearly explain campaign performance to stakeholders

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may start by reviewing campaign spend, CPL, CAC, ROAS, and conversion performance across active channels.

You’ll optimize campaigns, research new audiences or keywords, review creative performance, collaborate on landing pages and messaging, verify conversion tracking, and launch new tests.

You’ll also prepare performance reports and identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns or improve underperforming ones.

In short: you turn paid media budgets into measurable leads, customers, and revenue through continuous testing and optimization.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Cost per Lead (CPL)
  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Cost per Acquisition (CPA)
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
  • Lead and customer conversion rates
  • Advertising budget efficiency
  • Qualified leads and customers generated
  • Revenue attributed to marketing campaigns
  • Performance improvement from ongoing testing

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Performance Marketing / Campaign Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have hands-on experience with paid advertising, campaign optimization, performance analytics, and digital growth and know how to turn marketing spend into measurable business results, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations.
jobs.description:
Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change.

At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission.

We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 12 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding.

Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem.

Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, the Medical Director, Clinical Informatics will be responsible for supporting delivery of content that forms the clinical knowledge base of Availity’s clinical decision support tools. Specifically, the Medical Director will provide input and oversight for the interpretation of external clinical content (e.g., medical policies, clinical guidelines, and reimbursement policies) the construction and maintenance of AI–enabled attestation trees reflecting applicable clinical content, and clinical validation of the platform overall. The Medical Director will also be responsible for supporting development of additional use cases, supporting customer interactions and engaging in cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Clinical Informatics peers.

The role requires an in-depth knowledge of utilization management principles, the purpose and function of medical necessity guidelines, and prior authorization adjudication practices. This person will work in a team environment and will be expected to perform complex tasks while collaborating with colleagues with clinical and engineering/programming backgrounds.

The successful candidate will display experience in learning, using and optimizing use of a variety of technology and tooling in supporting day-to-day tasks. The candidate will also be detail oriented with strong analytic reasoning skills, demonstrate excellent communication and organizational skills while remaining open-minded, embracing change and the spirit of innovation.

Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position.

Location: Remote, US

Why you want to work on this team:

  • Work on a team that is shaping Availity’s AI-powered clinical capabilities during a period of growth and transformation.
  • Join a highly collaborative team that sits at the intersection of healthcare, clinical operations, and AI, helping shape solutions that can impact millions of healthcare transactions across the industry.

To be qualified for this position you have:

  • MD/DO with at least 8 years of clinical experience.
  • 5 plus years of experience in the healthcare revenue cycle roles including utilization management, prior authorization, and claims appeals/denials, within a payer, provider or healthcare technology environment.
  • Prior experience working in healthcare information technology and with cross-functional teams.

You will set yourself apart with:

  • Deep working knowledge of the healthcare insurance industry and relevant state and federal regulations.
  • Experience working or interacting with payer medical policy teams including serving on medical policy committees.
  • Exceptional critical thinking and reasoning skills.
  • Ability to synthesize complex, abstract problems and collaborate effectively with team members with diverse skillsets to create solutions.
  • Self-motivated and a quick learner with an ability to multi-task.
  • Passionate about fixing a broken system.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing oversight and input to the extended clinical team throughout the product development process from the point of initial review of medical policy through the release of AI-enabled attestation trees into production. This entails developing a working knowledge of a domain-specific programming language and use of development tools to assign coded medical constructs to attestation trees to facilitate automation of their responses.
  • Guiding clinical oversight for teams responsible for building and maintaining clinical content attestation questions, decision pathways, and recommendation logic that accurately reflect medical policy or other clinical guidelines requirements.
  • Timely support of all assigned tasks related to the delivery of clinical decision support tools, including decision tree creation, clinical concept labeling, and clinical performance validation.
  • Reviewing audit findings, customer feedback, and implementation observations to identify opportunities for decision tree improvement and providing input to enhance validity and accuracy of the AI outputs, including identification of additional medical terms that should be added to the existing vocabulary of coded concepts.
  • Contributing thought leadership, clinical design, and operational support for innovation initiatives (e.g., alpha/beta customer support) and other product enhancement efforts and feature development.
  • Advising on clinical guidance and support to Product, Engineering and customer-facing teams (e.g., implementation, sales and account teams) regarding decision tree behavior, policy/guidelines interpretation, and clinical workflow considerations.
  • Occasionally serving as clinical liaison to the medical policy and utilization management teams at current customers, including serving as a non-voting member of their medical policy committees.

Availity culture and benefits:

  • Availity is a certified “Great Place to Work”! Culture is important to us and there are many ways for you to make your mark here!
  • We have several Culture teams, a Young Professionals Group, and various ways to engage with fellow Availity associates – if you’re near Jacksonville, we have lots of pop up lunches where lunch is provided for everyone when we can see meetings are taking place and we’ve got teams in the office.
  • Availity is a culture of continuous learning. We have many resources and experts in our tech stack and in our industry that can help get you there too!
  • Don’t feel like wearing business attire? Cool, you can wear jeans – we are a casual place.
  • We offer a competitive salary, bonus structure, generous HSA company contribution, healthcare, vision, dental benefits and a 401k match program that you can take advantage of on day one!
  • We offer unlimited PTO for salaried associates + 9 paid holidays. Hourly associates start at 19 days of PTO and go up from there with all the same holiday benefits.
  • Interested in wellness? We allow our associates to reimburse up to $250/year for gym memberships, participation in racing events, weight management programs, etc.
  • Interested in furthering your education? We offer education reimbursement!
  • Availity offers Paid Parental Leave for both moms and dads, both birth parents and adoptive parents.
  • Want to work for an organization that gives back to the community? You’re at the right place! Availity partners with various organizations, both locally and nationally, to raise awareness, funds and morale as our staff members volunteer their time and funds to engage the organizations campaign.

Next steps:

After you apply, you will receive text/email messages thanking you for applying and then you will continue to receive more text/email messages alerting you as to where you are in the recruitment process.

Interview process:

  • Recruiter Video Pre-Screen
  • Video Interview with Clinical Panel
  • Video Interview with Technology Panel
  • Video Interview with Product Panel
  • Video Interview with Chief Medical Officer

Video Camera Usage:

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a Project Manager based in Mexico to join our team in a fully remote capacity.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the BPO environment, takes ownership, communicates confidently with clients, and can keep people, processes, and priorities moving in the right direction.

You will be responsible for supporting the successful day-to-day delivery of assigned BPO projects, working closely with clients, internal teams, and leadership to ensure expectations are met and performance remains on track.

Client Success is a key part of this role. We are looking for someone who understands that successful project delivery is not just about hitting KPIs. It's also about building trust with clients, communicating proactively, resolving issues quickly, and making sure clients feel supported throughout the relationship.

You will report directly to our Senior Client Success Manager / Mexico Head of Operations, working closely with them to manage project priorities, operational performance, and client needs.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day management and delivery of assigned BPO projects.
  • Work closely with clients to understand their needs, expectations, priorities, and concerns.
  • Build and maintain strong, professional client relationships.
  • Proactively identify and address issues that could impact client satisfaction or project performance.
  • Monitor project and operational KPIs to ensure teams are meeting expectations.
  • Coordinate with Team Leads and internal teams to address performance, quality, productivity, attendance, and service-delivery concerns.
  • Manage operational escalations and ensure issues are followed through to resolution.
  • Communicate project updates, challenges, risks, and action plans clearly to leadership and clients when appropriate.
  • Track action items, deadlines, deliverables, and follow-ups to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Review performance data and identify trends, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support coaching, accountability, and performance improvement efforts across assigned teams.
  • Help ensure client processes, requirements, and expectations are consistently followed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, efficiency, and the overall client experience.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to solve problems and keep projects moving forward.
  • Provide regular visibility into project health, performance, and potential risks.
  • Take ownership of problems and work proactively toward practical solutions.

﻿What We Offer

  • Fully Remote / Work From Home
  • Independent Contractor position
  • Compensation based on relevant experience and qualifications
  • The opportunity to work closely with senior leadership
  • A role with meaningful ownership and responsibility
  • The opportunity to contribute directly to project performance and Client Success
  • A collaborative, international working environment

﻿Technical Requirements (Essential)

To be considered, candidates must meet all technical requirements below:

  • Windows 11 PC/laptop
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Stable, reliable fibre internet with a wired connection
  • Backup power solution
  • Microsoft Teams / Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not move forward in the process.

﻿Hiring Process

To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.

Our process includes:

  1. English Resume Review
  2. Pre-Screen Questionnaire
  3. One-Way Video Interview
  4. Live Interview

﻿Please Note:

  • ﻿This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • ﻿All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for the position.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

BPO experience is essential. We are looking for someone who understands the pace, expectations, and operational demands of a Business Process Outsourcing environment.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven experience working in a BPO environment.
  • Previous experience managing BPO projects, programs, accounts, teams, or operational initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of KPIs, performance metrics, and operational targets.
  • Experience working directly with clients or supporting Client Success.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and escalation-management skills.
  • The ability to communicate professionally and confidently with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working with Team Leads, supervisors, agents, or other operational teams.
  • Strong follow-through and accountability.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and keep projects on track.
  • A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership without needing constant direction.
  • The ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment.

What Will Make You Stand Out

We'd especially like to hear from candidates who have:

  • Managed BPO projects or accounts supporting US-based clients.
  • Served as a primary or secondary client-facing contact.
  • Experience managing client escalations and sensitive situations.
  • Experience monitoring and improving operational KPIs.
  • Coordinated multiple teams or departments to achieve project goals.
  • Experience with project tracking, reporting, action plans, and deliverables.
  • Experience supporting performance improvement initiatives.
  • A strong understanding of how employee performance, operational results, and client satisfaction are connected.
  • Experience managing remote teams or projects.
  • A track record of identifying problems early and taking action before they become larger issues.

jobs.description:
Overview

HR Acuity is looking for a Lead UX Designer to set the design vision for our Product organization and lead a team of talented designers and researchers. You'll shape how our design system evolves, stay hands-on with the highest-impact work, and make sure every product experience reflects a deep understanding of the ER professionals, managers, and employees we build for.

This is a remote opportunity - must be US based

About HR Acuity®At HR Acuity®, we empower our team to #BeBold — embracing innovation and new challenges. We give you the tools to #WorkSmarter and foster the collaboration that makes us #BetterTogether. If you're excited to be part of our growth story, we'd love to chat.About Us: HR Acuity® is the leading provider of employee relations case management and investigation software. We help organizations standardize how workplace issues are reported, documented, and investigated, and our data-driven approach helps clients and partners build trusted, inclusive cultures where employees feel safe.This is an #All-In Zone. We're a fast-growing, innovative company led by a female founder and CEO, and being all-in is the norm here. From the top down, we bring our best every day — fueled by passion for our mission and culture — and we look for teammates who want to do the same.At the same time, we're deeply committed to an inclusive, diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued and respected. We believe in creating an environment where everyone can show up as their authentic self and thrive. If this sounds like you, keep reading.Click here to learn more about our values and benefits

Please note that for this position, we are only accepting direct applications. Submissions from agencies will not be considered.

The Opportunity

What You'll Do

  • Set and communicate the overall UX design strategy for the product, aligning it with the company vision and product roadmap
  • Maintain HR Acuity's Design System in tight collaboration with engineering — components, patterns, tokens, guidelines, and documentation — and drive its adoption across design and engineering
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of three UX Designers and one UX Researcher, setting clear expectations, giving thoughtful feedback, and supporting their development
  • Stay hands-on: personally design wireframes, mockups, interaction specs, and functional prototypes for high-impact and complex work
  • Deeply understand the needs of our customers — their ER professionals, managers, and employees — and translate those needs into user-centric designs
  • Partner with the UX Researcher to plan and act on concept and usability testing, turning customer feedback into design decisions
  • Establish and uphold UX standards, review the team's work, and ensure consistency and quality across every product offering
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to develop new products and features, from early concept through delivery
  • Present design work and rationale to stakeholders and leadership, using day-in-the-life stories to bring the experience to life
  • Balance short-term fixes with the long-term design vision, making pragmatic trade-offs without losing sight of the roadmap
  • Champion accessibility and inclusive design across the product, and own the relationship with our accessibility vendor
  • Keep current with competitor products, design tooling, and industry trends, including emerging AI-assisted design capabilities

What Success Looks Like

  • The Design System is consistently adopted across design and engineering, reducing rework and speeding up delivery
  • Your design team is growing in skill and confidence, with clear goals and regular, constructive feedback
  • Usability testing and research findings are routinely shaping product decisions, not just validating them after the fact
  • Product and Engineering leaders see UX as a strategic partner in early-stage planning, not a downstream reviewer
  • Accessibility is built into the design process by default, not addressed as an afterthought
  • Stakeholders can clearly see the connection between design decisions and customer outcomes, thanks to how you present and tell the story of the work

Qualifications

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of UX or product design experience, including 2+ years leading, mentoring, or managing designers, ideally in a B2B SaaS platform environment
  • Proven experience building, deploying, and maintaining a design system at scale, and driving its adoption across cross-functional teams
  • Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including hands-on experience with Figma's AI tools and a point of view on how AI can accelerate the design workflow
  • Demonstrable experience designing for complex workflows in B2B or B2C SaaS products, across web, native, and mobile-first approaches
  • Strong command of user-centric design strategy, UX principles, interaction design, and usability techniques
  • Experience partnering with UX research — or running research yourself — to inform and validate design decisions
  • A track record of setting design direction and standards in an agile, fast-moving environment
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and data-presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels
  • Strong attention to detail paired with the judgment to know when to prioritize speed
  • A collaborative, humble leadership style that lifts up the people around you
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, dynamic environment
  • A creative problem-solver who brings a clear point of view and a bias toward shipping

What We Offer

  • Real ownership of a growing Design System and the chance to shape how design and engineering work together
  • A seat at the table — you'll help set product strategy alongside Product Management and Engineering leadership, not just execute on it
  • A small, talented team to lead and grow, with the mentorship and autonomy to build your own leadership style
  • Meaningful work: your team's designs directly shape how HR professionals handle some of the hardest moments in the workplace
  • The flexibility of a fully remote role, with a collaborative team culture that doesn't depend on being in one place
  • Modern tooling and the latitude to bring AI-assisted design workflows into how the team works

Perks and Benefits

Compensation: The pay range for this position is expected to be between $136,200 to $179,000 however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized, non-discriminatory factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus. OTE between 154,000 to 199,000. Additionally, full-time employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) retirement plan, life and disability insurance coverages, and other benefits the Company may offer from time to time.

Benefits:

  • Stay healthy and happy with our comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans.
    • You can also choose from FSA or HSA options to suit your needs.
  • Save for your future with our 401K plan that matches your contributions.
  • Enjoy paid leave for various life events, such as sickness, disability, or parenthood.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays* to catch up on work, personal development, or an afternoon off.

Perks:

  • Take a break from work with our unlimited PTO policy to refresh and recharge.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week, half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays*, and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Earn extra cash by referring qualified candidates to join our team.
  • Access professional and personal support through our employee assistance program.
  • Work from anywhere with our remote work environment that fosters collaboration and creativity. *
  • Join a fun and energetic team that values your suggestions and new ideas.
  • Receive a competitive salary and meaningful opportunities for growth.

Learning and Development

  • Onboarding: Learn the basics of your role, the company culture, and the expectations from your manager and team. Get familiar with the tools, systems, and processes that you will use in your daily work. Receive feedback and guidance from your mentor and peers.
  • Manager training: Develop the skills and competencies to lead, motivate, and empower your team. Learn how to communicate effectively, delegate tasks, set goals, provide feedback, and resolve conflicts. Enhance your emotional intelligence, coaching, and mentoring abilities.
  • Leadership training: Grow your leadership potential and influence within the organization. Learn how to inspire and align others with the company vision, mission, and values. Strengthen your strategic thinking, decision making, and problem-solving skills. Expand your network and collaboration with other leaders across functions and levels.
  • Industry training: Stay updated on the latest trends, best practices, and innovations in the Employee Relations industry. Gain insights from experts and thought leaders in the field. Apply your learning to improve your performance, quality, and efficiency.

* Based upon business needs

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

US, East Coast Preferred

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard's security organization sits at the intersection of proactive, long-term initiatives and reactive, business-critical work. As we've grown, managing that balance, anticipating the downstream impact of changing priorities, and giving leadership a clear view of our security risk and exposure have become increasingly important, and increasingly complex.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to bring structure and visibility to this space.

You'll operate horizontally across the security organization, partnering with Product Security, Cyber Resiliency, and Governance & Trust. While you'll be closely embedded with those teams in your day-to-day work, you'll also help coordinate priorities, dependencies, and execution across the broader security organization.

Your impact will extend well beyond security. Because security intersects with nearly every function at Chainguard — including engineering, product, legal, finance, sales, and marketing — you'll build the systems, processes, and relationships that enable effective collaboration across the company.

This is a senior, strategic role with substantial room to grow. You won't inherit a fully defined playbook; you'll help create it. You'll establish the processes, dashboards, and prioritization mechanisms that give the security organization greater clarity and leverage, and over time, expand that impact into broader company-wide programs and operating processes.

What you’ll do:

  • Own workflow, project tracking, and dependency management across the three security teams, making it clear what’s on track, what’s at risk, and what downstream impact changes may have.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that give company leadership a clear, durable view of security risk, exposure, and program health.
  • Partner closely with your primary security team on day-to-day execution while supporting the other two teams as priorities and capacity allow.
  • Make and communicate prioritization decisions when demand exceeds the security organization’s capacity — including finding alternatives and helping stakeholders understand trade-offs, rather than simply saying no.
  • Design and implement lightweight processes that help security teams operate more effectively without creating unnecessary overhead for engineers.
  • Work directly with product, engineering, and other partner teams to establish clear, effective ways of working with security.
  • As the role grows, extend your impact beyond security by helping shape broader company processes, including how Chainguard approaches planning, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations roles
  • Meaningful experience in a broad, cross-functional operations or program management role, supporting many stakeholders across an organization rather than working within a single, self-contained team.
  • Security experience is a plus, but not required. More important is the ability to operate effectively in a horizontal role with a large and diverse stakeholder group.
  • A track record of building processes and exercising sound judgment in ambiguous environments, rather than defaulting to standard frameworks or playbooks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to act as a strategic and consultative partner across functions.
  • Experience managing competing priorities and communicating trade-offs, including difficult prioritization decisions, clearly and thoughtfully.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, scaling environment where processes are still being built and refined.

Why this role:

Security work at Chainguard doesn’t follow a predictable schedule. Proactive initiatives and reactive, business-critical needs are constantly competing for the same time and attention. This role exists to bring structure to that tension — helping the security organization make deliberate choices about where to focus and how to respond when priorities inevitably shift.

At the same time, company leadership needs a clearer, more consistent view of our security posture, risk, and exposure than we currently have a dedicated mechanism to provide. You’ll build that reporting infrastructure and make it durable as the organization grows.

And because security intersects with nearly every part of the business, you’ll have an unusually broad view of how Chainguard operates. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to take what you learn in security and apply it to larger, org-wide programs and processes — helping shape not just how security works, but how Chainguard works as a company.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

Language

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

jobs.excerpt: About Menlo Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
jobs.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
You’ll work on the perception and learning stack that lets Asimov do things in the real world.

What You'll Do

  • Design and train perception and representation models for whole body control

  • Contribute to our world model research (SSL, predictive representations)

  • Evaluate models against actual robot performance

  • Work across the locomotion, autonomy, and hardware teams to ship behaviors that hold up outside the lab

  • Open-source what we can and help set the bar for how whole-body control is done in the open

  • Track and apply ideas from the broader AI literature pool

What We Look For

  • Computer vision foundations: solid grounding in computer vision, working with real (not just curated) visual data

  • Representation learning: hands-on experience with self-supervised methods, e.g. contrastive learning, masked prediction, JEPA-style objectives, embeddings/encoders

  • ML/LLM breadth: comfortable reading and applying ideas across LLMs and general ML, not siloed to robotics

  • Has trained models before: real end-to-end experience, e.g. data pipelines, training runs, debugging, evaluation, not just papers

  • Sim-to-real experience: has taken a model from simulation onto a physical robot and dealt with the gap firsthand.

  • Fluency in Python or C++, and comfort living in a simulator (IsaacSim, MuJoCo, or similar)

Nice to Have

  • Published or open-source work in locomanipulation, whole-body control, or sim-to-real transfer

  • Experience with contact-rich or bimanual manipulation

  • Familiarity with humanoid platforms and real-time control on embedded hardware

  • Background in imitation learning, teleoperation, or large-scale robot data collection

Why Join Menlo
You will be part of a tight-knit team teaching a humanoid to do real physical work, not demos. You will have genuine ownership of the full stack of technologies that decides what Asimov can do in the world, and you will see your work run on real robots in weeks, not years. If you want locomanipulation to mean something beyond a benchmark, this is the place to build it.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Requirements

Als unser neuer Graphic Designer (all genders) übernimmst du vom ersten Tag an eigenständig die Entwicklung von Creatives über digitale Kanäle, Social Media, CRM, E-Commerce, Retail und Print hinweg - inklusive Packaging und Displays. Was du mitbringst:

  • Design-Grundlagen: Verständnis grundlegender Print- und Digital-Design-Anforderungen.

  • Markenkonsistenz: Die Fähigkeit, eine bestehende Brand Identity konsistent über verschiedene Formate hinweg anzuwenden.

  • Sprachen: Professionelle Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Detailgenauigkeit: Hoher Anspruch an Qualität und Liebe zum Detail.

  • Flexibilität und eine Hands-on-Mentalität.

jobs.description:
LOCATION

Remote Work-at-Home

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are looking for motivated Remote Call Center Sales Representatives to join our growing team. If you have a passion for sales, enjoy working remotely, and are driven by results, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your career in a supportive and rewarding environment.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make outbound calls to prospective customers and follow up on leads.
  • Present and sell company products and services to new and existing customers.
  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
  • Maintain a high level of product knowledge to effectively address customer needs.
  • Record all sales activities and customer interactions in the CRM system.
  • Provide feedback to management on customer trends and market conditions.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Must be 18 years or older
  • High School Diploma/GED
  • 1-2 years of sales experience, preferably in a call center or remote setting.
  • Strong persuasive and negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated with a results-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

All MCI Locations

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Director of Company Operations - East Division is accountable for driving consistent, high-quality execution and business performance across all regions by enabling, coaching, and aligning Regional Directors around shared priorities, expectations, and outcomes. This role creates the leadership structure and operating discipline necessary for Regional Directors to effectively lead their markets, develop their teams, and deliver sustainable results.

Core Responsibilities:

Regional Performance Outcomes

  • Own regional performance across growth, retention, service stability, operational execution, and overall business health.
  • Maintain focus on the highest-priority business outcomes and ensure Regional Directors understand and consistently reinforce the behaviors and leading indicators that drive those results.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across regions, ensuring Regional Directors know what they own, how success is measured, and where intervention is required.
  • Identify trends, performance gaps, and emerging risks across regions and coach Regional Directors to develop and execute effective action plans.
  • Ensure sustained performance improvement by addressing root causes, reinforcing effective operating behaviors, and holding leaders accountable for follow-through and results.

Regional Director Leadership & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary leader, coach, and mentor to Regional Directors, providing the guidance, challenge, and support needed to lead their regions effectively.
  • Build leadership capability and business acumen, strengthening Regional Directors’ critical thinking, decision-making, prioritization, and ownership of key business metrics and outcomes.
  • Create consistency in leadership expectations and practices across regions while allowing Regional Directors the autonomy to lead effectively within their markets.

Execution Discipline & Operating Cadence

  • Establish and protect a clear, simple, and repeatable leadership cadence that creates consistency, visibility, and accountability across all regions.
  • Keep Regional Directors and their teams focused on the highest-impact business drivers, ensuring time and resources are directed toward the priorities and behaviors that most directly influence performance and growth.
  • Minimize organizational noise and competing priorities by helping leaders distinguish between what is urgent and what is truly important to business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Identify and resolve systemic handoff issues, friction points, and breakdowns that negatively impact the customer experience, COB experience, or business performance.
  • Partner closely with functional VPs and enterprise leaders to surface and address constraints that cannot be resolved at the regional level.
  • Bring a solutions-oriented, enterprise mindset to cross-functional challenges, focusing conversations on root causes, practical solutions, and measurable progress rather than functional ownership or blame.

Risk Identification & Escalation

  • Proactively identify early warning signs across business performance, talent, service delivery, customer experience, and operational execution before they become material issues.
  • Ensure Regional Directors develop strong risk awareness, recognizing emerging issues early and taking appropriate action within their scope of ownership.
  • Escalate material risks with clarity and urgency, providing relevant context, business impact, actions already taken, and a clear recommendation for resolution.
  • Identify patterns and systemic risks across regions, distinguishing isolated issues from broader trends that may require enterprise-level action.
  • Drive issues through resolution, maintaining appropriate visibility and accountability until material risks are mitigated or resolved.

Qualifications, Skills, & Attributes:

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in a service-based business environment; franchise or multi-unit operations experience strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen with the ability to interpret profit and loss (P&L) statements, identify performance trends, and implement operational improvements to drive business results.
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on operational leadership in the field with strategic planning and executive-level communication.
  • Experience developing and presenting business strategies, operational insights, and performance recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a track record of driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple locations and functions.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% throughout the assigned region to company-operated branch offices, with regular travel to the corporate headquarters in Atlanta, GA.
WHO WE ARE:

Empower Brands was founded in 2022 as a product of the integration of Lynx Franchising and Outdoor Living Brands. Empower encompasses ten industry-leading brands across commercial and residential services: JAN-PRO, FRSTeam, Archadeck Outdoor Living, Outdoor Lighting Perspectives (OLP), Conserva Irrigation, Koala Insulation, Wallaby Windows, Superior Fence and Rail, Bumble Roofing and Canopy Lawn Care. Empower is dedicated to providing its customers with the highest quality products and services in the commercial and home services industry while simultaneously delivering its franchise owners committed personal support, tools and empowerment to pursue their own success. Empower Brands is a portfolio company of MidOcean Partners, a leading private equity firm with an excellent track record investing in successful, growth-focused franchise businesses. For more about Empower Brands, visit the company’s new website at .

The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” relationship.

Empower Brands is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day.
