jobs.excerpt: About Jade BiosciencesJade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases.
jobs.description:
About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an undisclosed antibody candidate, both currently in preclinical development. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit  and follow the Company on LinkedIn.  

Role Overview

Jade Biosciences is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President, Medical Affairs to build and lead the Company’s medical affairs function as our differentiated pipeline advances through late-stage development and toward commercialization. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this individual will define and execute the medical affairs strategy across Jade’s portfolio, with an initial emphasis on JADE101 in IgA nephropathy. The successful candidate will serve as a scientific and clinical thought partner to internal teams and external stakeholders, translating rigorous target biology and clinical data into compelling medical and scientific engagement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for a physician (MD) who combines deep therapeutic-area expertise — ideally in nephrology and/or immunology/rheumatology — with a proven track record of building medical affairs capabilities in the biopharmaceutical industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Medical Strategy & Leadership
  • Develop and execute an integrated medical affairs strategy aligned with clinical development and corporate objectives across Jade’s pipeline (JADE101, JADE201, JADE301).
  • Serve as a key scientific partner to the Chief Medical Officer, clinical development, regulatory, and clinical operations.
  • Scientific & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with key opinion leaders, investigators, patient advocacy groups, and professional societies in nephrology and immunology/rheumatology.
  • Lead advisory boards, scientific exchange, and congress strategy to inform development and generate insights.
  • Represent Jade externally as a credible medical and scientific voice.
  • Evidence Generation & Communication
  • Direct medical affairs evidence-generation activities, including real-world evidence, investigator-sponsored studies, and publication strategy.
  • Oversee the development of high-quality, scientifically accurate medical communications, publications, and medical information resources.
  • Ensure launch readiness of the medical organization in preparation for JADE101 and subsequent programs.
  • Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Ensure all medical affairs activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry codes.
  • Partner cross-functionally with clinical operations, regulatory, biometrics, and commercial teams to support integrated program strategy.

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • MD required (board certification and/or relevant post-graduate clinical training strongly preferred).
  • 10+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience, with progressive leadership responsibility in medical affairs and/or clinical development.
  • Demonstrated success building or leading medical affairs functions, including field medical teams, in a clinical-stage or commercial organization.
  • Proven ability to engage credibly with key opinion leaders, investigators, and external scientific stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of the regulatory, compliance, and legal frameworks governing medical affairs activities.
  • Excellent scientific communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Renal (nephrology) experience — e.g., IgA nephropathy or other glomerular diseases — is a strong plus.
  • Immunology / rheumatology experience and familiarity with B-cell– and autoantibody-driven autoimmune diseases is a strong plus.
  • Experience supporting late-stage development and/or product launch in a rare or specialty autoimmune indication.
  • Familiarity with biologics/monoclonal antibody therapeutics and biomarker-driven development.

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

The final salary offered will depend on several factors, which may include, but not limited to, relevant years of experience, educational background, and geography.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led.
jobs.description:
Description

MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed.

The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack.

That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust.

mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide, including at Fortune 500 companies.

The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Contribute Rust code that creates, manages, reconfigures and adapts cloud resources.
  • Use AI smartly to deliver high quality code, faster.
  • Collaborate closely with our small, world-class engineering team on architecture, new feature design and infrastructure.
  • Engage directly with users to gather requirements, develop solutions, and debug issues.

Requirements

At least 3 years of professional software development experience.

  • Of which at least one year of writing production-grade Rust.
  • Based between UTC-5 and UTC+4
  • Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments.
  • Comfort working async in a remote-first startup environment.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native environments (Docker, containers, Kubernetes) beyond the basics.
  • Familiarity with backend infrastructure tooling like datastores, message brokers, GitOps tools, etc.
  • Good communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building developer tools.
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or other components that interact with the Kubernetes API.
  • DevOps or Platform experience.

Why Join MetalBear

  • Work on hard, meaningful problems at the intersection of local development and cloud infrastructure.
  • Be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work directly impacts thousands of developers and some of the world’s biggest companies.
  • Remote-first, async-friendly, and low on meetings.
  • Competitive salary, meaningful stock options, and a culture that values focus and autonomy.

Horace Mann is seeking a knowledgeable and collaborative Supervisor, Product Compliance to provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance for our Product Compliance team supporting Supplemental and Group insurance products.

In this role, you'll balance people leadership with hands-on compliance expertise—overseeing workflow and quality, coordinating regulatory filings, researching evolving requirements, and partnering across the organization to help ensure our products and related materials remain compliant.

The ideal candidate is an organized and thoughtful leader who enjoys developing others, solving regulatory challenges, and building strong partnerships across Product Development, Legal, Compliance, Claims, Marketing, and Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Supervise the daily workflow and activities of assigned Product Compliance team members.
  • Assign and prioritize work, monitor deadlines, and ensure established service and performance expectations are achieved.
  • Train, coach, and develop team members to strengthen technical knowledge, regulatory expertise, and overall performance.
  • Monitor workload, productivity, quality, and technical proficiency across the team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve training, processes, resources, and controls and provide recommendations to management.

Product Compliance & Quality Oversight

  • Review product compliance work for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to established procedures and quality standards.
  • Serve as the first level of technical escalation for routine and moderately complex product compliance matters.
  • Research, interpret, and apply statutes, regulations, bulletins, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Support compliance reviews of:
    • Policy forms and certificates
    • Endorsements
    • Disclosures
    • Marketing materials
    • Other product-related documentation
  • Exercise sound judgment in resolving compliance matters and escalate significant or complex issues to management as appropriate.

Regulatory Filings & DOI Coordination

  • Coordinate product filing activities from preparation through regulatory approval.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of filings to applicable regulatory authorities.
  • Monitor regulatory correspondence, objections, approvals, and outstanding requirements.
  • Ensure regulatory documentation is complete, accurate, and appropriately maintained.
  • Coordinate timely follow-up on outstanding filing requirements and regulatory inquiries.
  • Support responses to Department of Insurance (DOI) inquiries and requests.

New Products & Regulatory Change

  • Support compliance activities associated with new product development and product changes.
  • Monitor and support implementation of new or revised regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain and support applicable compliance calendars and regulatory deadlines.
  • Partner with business areas to implement updated procedures, requirements, and controls resulting from regulatory or product changes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Product Development, Claims, Enterprise Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Operations, and other business partners to complete product compliance initiatives.
  • Provide clear compliance guidance to business partners and help translate regulatory requirements into actionable business practices.
  • Build effective relationships across the organization to support timely product development, implementation, and ongoing compliance.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Experience in product compliance, regulatory compliance, product filings, product development, or a related insurance discipline.
  • Working knowledge of insurance regulations, regulatory research, product documentation, and Department of Insurance filing processes.
  • Knowledge of Supplemental and Group insurance products or related insurance products.
  • Prior supervisory, team-lead, coaching, or comparable leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate workloads, monitor quality and deadlines, and provide technical guidance to team members.
  • Ability to research, interpret, and apply regulatory requirements and identify appropriate solutions to routine compliance matters.
  • Sound judgment with the ability to recognize when complex or significant matters require escalation.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Previous experience coordinating insurance product filings and responding to regulatory inquiries.
  • Experience supporting new product development or significant product changes.

Skills & Competencies

  • People leadership, coaching, and development
  • Insurance product compliance and regulatory knowledge
  • Regulatory research and interpretation
  • Product filings and documentation
  • Quality assurance and attention to detail
  • Sound judgment and problem-solving
  • Workload management and prioritization
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration and relationship building
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and regulatory deadlines

Pay Range:

  • $76,600.00 - $106,450.00 annually + bonus.

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow. And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth: We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs. Senior Software Engineer (AI-Native) — Healthcare Platform

Location: Remote across India (US Pacific overlap 4-8hrs daily)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Lead Engineer / Founder-CEO

Compensation: ₹20–40 LPA (higher for exceptional candidates — prove it)

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-focused mental healthcare company committed to improving access to and the quality of mental wellness services. By integrating AI-driven platforms with expert clinical care, we offer personalized and effective mental health solutions, connecting patients with providers through an efficient digital platform. We are rapidly developing multiple products throughout the clinical workflow, from AI-driven assessments to care coordination. As a startup, we operate like a dynamic team rather than a conventional department.

About the Role

Please read carefully: if you're the type of developer who waits for Jira tickets and inquires “what should I build next?” you can stop reading here. Our Lead Engineer serves as the technical backbone of the company, overseeing the billing subsystem, FHIR/EHR integration, product frontend, claims lifecycle, and clinical workflow architecture. He is remarkably talented, but he can only do so much alone. We need a counterpart to him. This is not a role for someone who merely "assists" or "supports." We are looking for an individual who can collaborate with him, quickly absorb his expertise, and take full ownership of entire subsystems within 90 days. You will initially focus on understanding the most intricate and essential components of our platform before stepping into a shared leadership role over the architecture and contributing to new product development. The progression is as follows: apprentice (month 1) → co-owner (month 2) → owner (month 3) → architect (month 4+).

This is not a junior-to-mid role with a senior title. We are seeking someone who has experience delivering complex systems, thinks architecturally rather than just in terms of code, and uses AI tools so skillfully that they can release features at two to three times the speed of a typical developer. If you do not already use Claude Code or GitHub Copilot daily, you may not be able to keep up with your future colleague.

As the founder-CEO is a physician, you'll learn about healthcare organically, including billing codes, clinical workflows, and HIPAA regulations. What we cannot teach you is the engineering intuition: knowing when to refactor versus when to ship, designing systems that can be maintained by other engineers, and having the initiative to take ownership of results without requiring supervision.

Requirements

Requirements

Required

  • 4-8 years in full-stack software engineering — experience with shipping production SaaS applications, not agency websites or internal tools.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript — it’s not just that you've used it; you think in TypeScript. Concepts like generics, utility types, strict mode, and discriminated unions come naturally to you.
  • Experience with React + Next.js — working on production applications rather than tutorial projects, with knowledge in SSR, API routes, dynamic routing, and performance optimization.
  • Node.js backend skills — familiarity with REST APIs, authentication, middleware, error handling, and background job management.
  • Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL experience — including schema design, migrations, query optimization, and relation modeling.
  • Mastery of Git — understanding branching strategies, maintaining a clean commit history, managing PR workflows, and rebasing. Your git log should serve as documentation.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development — daily engagement with tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or their equivalents, and the ability to explain how AI has influenced your development process, beyond simply stating that you use it for autocomplete.
  • Self-motivated work style — you thrive in environments where tasks are not assigned, identifying what needs to be built and executing on it.
  • Strong English communication skills — with an async-first approach, including the ability to produce clear written documentation, PR descriptions, and technical decision records.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with healthcare SaaS (e.g., billing, EHR, clinical workflows, HIPAA compliance).
  • Familiarity with FHIR/HL7 standards.
  • Knowledge of Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket real-time architecture.
  • Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS security (e.g., RBAC, row-level security, tenant isolation).
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage).
  • A quick learner when it comes to complex domain knowledge from subject matter experts.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of behavioral health or medical billing.
  • Experience with AI/ML pipeline integration.
  • Familiarity with startup environments — comfortable with ambiguity, rapid pivots, and taking on varied roles.
  • Experience working in a very small engineering team.
  • Familiarity with medical billing codes (CPT, ICD-10).

Schedule

In practice, this means working approximately 2pm–12am IST (or similar). Your mornings are your own. Deep coding sessions take place in the afternoon, and you will have overlap with the US team in the evening. If you have evening commitments that conflict with this schedule, this role may not be suitable for you. We emphasize the importance of uninterrupted focus time — you propose your own schedule. We prioritize output and collaboration over strict timekeeping. You will need to maintain 4–8 hours of daily overlap with the US Pacific time zone (9am–5pm PT).

Benefits

Benefits

  • Salary range of ₹20–40 LPA based on skills and experience
  • Fully remote work available within India
  • Equipment allowance
  • Budget for learning—covering tools, courses, and conferences
  • Direct communication with the Lead Engineer and Founder-CEO—no intermediaries involved
  • Encouraged use of AI tools to enhance productivity—utilize whatever makes your work more efficient
  • Opportunity to manage a key subsystem in a healthcare organization from the outset—no waiting for years to demonstrate your value

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an ambitious Junior Account Executive who is eager to develop their full-cycle sales skills and grow their career within a supportive, high-performing sales team at bids&tenders.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an ambitious Junior Account Executive who is eager to develop their full-cycle sales skills and grow their career within a supportive, high-performing sales team at bids&tenders.

This role is the natural next step for a top-performing SDR — or an early-career sales professional — ready to own a full, if smaller-scale, sales cycle. You'll manage a defined book of smaller municipal, school board, and public-sector accounts end-to-end, with close mentorship from a Senior AE and Sales Manager, while building the skills and track record to grow into a full-cycle Account Executive.

This is an new vacancy in our organization.

About Valsoft

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft has grown to a global portfolio of 118+ companies, acquiring and developing vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries. A key tenet of Valsoft's philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that molds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management.

About bids&tenders

We are an established digital procurement software platform within the Valsoft portfolio and a recognized leader in public-sector procurement across North America. bids&tenders is deeply embedded within government procurement environments, supporting agencies at every level of the public sector as they manage the full lifecycle of their procurement activities. Public buyers and suppliers rely on our platform daily for sourcing, submissions, evaluations, awards, contract management, and supplier performance.

Originally created over 15 years ago to address a critical gap - giving suppliers a clear and accessible way to view and respond to procurement opportunities - bids&tenders has steadily evolved in partnership with procurement professionals. We were early pioneers in eBidding, and over time we've expanded the platform to include modern evaluation tools, contract management workflows, supplier performance capabilities, and a streamlined experience for both buyers and suppliers.

Role Description

The Junior AE owns a full — but scoped — sales cycle for smaller, lower-complexity public-sector accounts, from a qualified handoff through close. The role is designed as a structured ramp: shorter sales cycles, simpler deal structures, and a smaller territory than a full-cycle AE, with hands-on coaching to build toward independent quota ownership.

Reports to: Senior AE / Sales Manager

Primary Goal: Close a consistent volume of public-sector deals while developing full-cycle selling skills.

Core Responsibilities

Pipeline Management

• Take ownership of qualified meetings and marketing/SDR-sourced leads for a defined segment of smaller accounts.

• Maintain and progress a personal pipeline within HubSpot, with accurate staging and forecasting.

Full-Cycle Sales Execution (Scoped)

• Run discovery calls, tailored product demonstrations, and value conversations with smaller municipal and public-sector prospects.

• Manage pricing, negotiation, and contracting for lower-complexity deals, with Senior AE support on multi-stakeholder or higher-value opportunities.

• Prepare straightforward RFP/RFI responses in partnership with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with SDRs on handoff quality, lead context, and follow-up.

• Work with Implementation and Account Management to ensure a smooth new-customer transition.

• Shadow and be shadowed by Senior AEs to build full-cycle selling capability.

Territory & Forecasting

• Maintain accurate CRM data, activity logs, and forecasts for an assigned account segment.

• Prioritize opportunities based on procurement timelines and revenue potential.

Market & Product Expertise

• Build working knowledge of public-sector procurement practices and the bids&tenders platform.

• Develop clear, confident demo and value-proposition delivery.

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured based on:

  • Achievement of assigned revenue and new business growth targets.
  • Conversion of qualified opportunities into closed business.
  • Development and management of a healthy sales pipeline.
  • Effectiveness of prospecting, discovery, and customer engagement activities.
  • Sales cycle efficiency and progression of opportunities through the funnel.
  • Accuracy of sales forecasting and CRM data management.
  • Responsiveness to customer inquiries and internal handoffs.
  • Customer satisfaction during the transition from sales to implementation and onboarding.

What Success Looks Like — 30/60/90

First 30 Days — Foundation

• Build product and platform knowledge (demo certification, call recordings).

• Learn the assigned account segment and procurement cycle patterns.

• Shadow Senior AE discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.

• Reach full CRM and forecasting proficiency in HubSpot.

Days 31–60 — Production

• Run discovery calls and demos independently.

• Build a qualified pipeline within the assigned segment.

• Close first deals with Senior AE support on structuring and negotiation.

• Give consistent, structured feedback to SDRs on handoff quality.

Days 61–90 — Optimization

• Manage the full cycle independently for standard deals.

• Hit quarterly quota attainment for the assigned segment.

• Escalate only higher-complexity, multi-stakeholder deals to Senior AE.

• Begin building toward a broader territory and full AE scope.

Requirements

• 1–3 years of experience in a closing sales role (SDR-to-AE promotion candidates welcome), or a demonstrated track record as an SDR/BDR meeting or exceeding quota.

• Comfortable running a shorter, simpler full sales cycle from discovery through close.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain a software workflow clearly to non-technical buyers.

• Coachable, organized, and self-motivated, with a genuine interest in growing into a full-cycle AE role.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) and sales enablement tools.

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, public administration, or related field preferred.

• Must be legally authorized to work in Canada (role is Canada-focused).

Growth Path

This role is a structured bridge between SDR and full-cycle Account Executive. Consistent quota attainment, independent full-cycle execution, and strong forecast accuracy over 2–3 quarters are the primary path to promotion into a full Account Executive role, which carries a larger territory, and higher-complexity deals.

Benefits

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary with commission structure and a clear path to full AE compensation.

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Structured mentorship from a Senior AE and Sales Manager

• Ongoing professional development, enablement, and training

• The opportunity to grow into a full-cycle AE role within a rapidly growing software company

• A supportive, collaborative, and mission-aligned team environment

Salary Range: The compensation range for this role is $55,000 to $70,000 CAD plus commission.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

  • High-ownership SEO role where your work is measured against real revenue impact, not vanity metrics

What You'll Work On

Technical SEO Audits and Implementation

  • Conduct comprehensive technical audits covering crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, and page speed
  • Identify and resolve issues affecting organic visibility including redirect chains, duplicate content, canonicalization, and structured data errors
  • Implement and optimize schema markup for products, reviews, FAQs, and AI answer engines
  • Audit on-page fundamentals including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, and image optimization
  • Prioritize fixes by revenue impact and translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations

E-Commerce SEO

  • Optimize category pages, product pages, and collection structures for organic search performance and conversion
  • Develop keyword strategies aligned with buyer intent across the full e-commerce funnel
  • Support site migrations, platform changes, and redesigns with a clear SEO preservation plan
  • Collaborate with development and design teams to ensure SEO requirements are implemented correctly

AI Answer Engine Optimization

  • Develop strategies to get clients cited and recommended in AI-generated responses across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude
  • Structure content with clear definitional formats, comparison frameworks, and direct-answer layouts that AI models surface
  • Monitor AI platform presence and citation rates and adjust content strategy based on findings
  • Stay ahead of how AI search behavior is evolving and bring proactive recommendations to the team

Content Strategy and Production Support

  • Build and manage content calendars targeting non-brand organic keywords and AI-answer queries
  • Brief or write content that ranks, earns citations, and supports the buyer journey from awareness through conversion
  • Identify content gaps across client sites and prioritize based on traffic potential, competition, and revenue opportunity

Reporting and Analytics

  • Report on organic traffic, keyword rankings, CTR, Core Web Vitals, AI citation presence, and revenue contribution
  • Connect SEO performance to bottom-line outcomes using available analytics data
  • Translate data into clear insights and prioritized next steps for both internal teams and clients

What You Bring

  • Proven experience managing technical SEO for e-commerce websites that generate organic traffic and revenue
  • Strong technical SEO skills including the ability to run a full audit, identify root causes, and implement fixes
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce site architecture including category hierarchies, faceted navigation, product page optimization, and pagination
  • Familiarity with how AI answer engines work and what it takes to get content cited and surfaced
  • Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent
  • Analytically rigorous with the ability to connect SEO work directly to revenue outcomes
  • Comfortable working independently across multiple client accounts without losing quality or missing deadlines
  • Strong written communication skills for client-facing reporting and internal documentation

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Shopify, BigCommerce, or similar e-commerce platforms at a technical level
  • Familiarity with AI visibility tools such as Scrunch AI, Profound, or similar platforms
  • Background in performance marketing or growth analytics alongside SEO
  • Experience supporting site migrations or platform transitions with zero organic traffic loss
  • Prior agency experience managing SEO across multiple e-commerce client accounts simultaneously

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A link to 2 to 3 examples of SEO work you owned including the URL, the target keyword or initiative, and the measurable outcome
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through one technical SEO or AIO win you are proud of, and explaining how you connected it to a business outcome

Only candidates who submit both work examples and a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you can drive organic traffic, earn AI citations, and connect every SEO initiative to bottom-line impact for e-commerce brands, this role gives you the analytical environment and the direct client impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release alongside product, design, backend, and QA.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You prefer strict role boundaries and don't want to occasionally cross into a SQL query, a backend endpoint, or the API layer to unblock yourself.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Recruiting Support Specialist (Part-time)

Position Overview
KeenLogic is seeking a Recruiting Support Contractor to assist our internal recruiting team with candidate screening and documentation management. This is a part-time position averaging approximately 20 hours per week, with hours varying based on recruiting volume and business needs.

This role supports KeenLogic’s internal recruiting team by conducting scheduled candidate screening calls and managing candidate follow-up through the documentation process. Responsibilities include reviewing candidate qualifications, capturing detailed screening notes, collecting required materials, editing and formatting documents, and ensuring completed candidate files are accurate, organized, and ready for submission.

The ideal candidate is professional, organized, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with candidates while managing multiple follow-ups and documentation deadlines.

Qualifications
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable conducting professional candidate screening calls.
  • Strong attention to detail and document review skills.
  • Ability to professionally edit and format Microsoft Word documents.
  • Strong organization and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple candidates and documentation deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to follow established screening guides, templates, and recruiting processes.
  • Recruiting coordination, HR, staffing, or administrative experience preferred.
  • ClickUp experience preferred.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct Scheduled Candidate Screening Calls
  • Conduct candidate screening calls that have already been scheduled and assigned by the KeenLogic recruiting team.
  • Review the job description, candidate resume, and provided screening questions prior to each call.
  • Discuss the opportunity with candidates and confirm their qualifications, relevant experience, availability, compensation expectations, certifications, clearance status, and other position-specific requirements.
  • Take detailed and organized notes during each screening to provide a clear summary of the candidate and flag any concerns or questions requiring Recruiting Manager review.
Candidate Documentation & Follow-Up
  • Send candidates the required documentation and instructions following their screening call.
  • Clearly communicate document requirements and applicable deadlines.
  • Follow up with candidates until all required documentation has been received.
  • Review returned documents for completeness and identify missing information.
  • Communicate with candidates to obtain corrections or additional information when necessary.
  • Escalate candidate questions or issues requiring Recruiting Manager involvement.
Document Editing & Formatting
  • Edit and format candidate resumes according to KeenLogic and client requirements.
  • Review resumes for required information, including employment dates, relevant experience, education, certifications, and other role-specific requirements.
  • Review Letters of Commitment/Availability, reference documents, forms, and other required candidate materials for completeness.
  • Correct formatting, spacing, headers, fonts, and general presentation while maintaining the accuracy of candidate-provided information.
  • Ensure candidate documentation is complete, consistent, and submission-ready.
File & Documentation Management
  • Save finalized documents using established KeenLogic naming conventions.
  • Upload and organize completed candidate documentation in the appropriate SharePoint folders.
  • Ensure the correct and most current versions of candidate documents are filed.
  • Update applicable recruiting trackers to reflect screening completion, outstanding documents, and documentation status.
  • Maintain organized candidate records so the recruiting team can quickly access submission-ready materials.
Success in This Role
A successful contractor will be able to take an assigned candidate from scheduled screening through completed documentation with limited day-to-day oversight.

For each assigned candidate, the expected workflow is:
Scheduled Screening → Conduct Call → Complete Screening Notes → Send Required Documents → Follow Up → Review/Edit Documents → Obtain Corrections → Finalize Documents → File in SharePoint → Update Recruiting Team

The goal of this position is to provide dependable execution and follow-through so the internal recruiting team can focus on candidate identification, pipeline development, client communication, and recruiting strategy.

jobs.excerpt: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do.
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

The Computer System Validation (CSV) Specialist is responsible for implementing Innomar’s CSV strategy and leading validation activities for computerized systems, including hardware and software, that support GxP-impacting business processes. This role ensures ongoing compliance with PIC/S Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Responsibilities include prioritizing, executing, maintaining, and coordinating CSV activities; evaluating software applications against design specifications and user requirements; and serving as a liaison between IT, operational business units, QA, and external partners, where applicable. The CSV Specialist also supports software and application testing and ensures project expectations are clearly defined and met in accordance with company policies and procedures. This position reports to the QA Testing & Validation Team Lead or Manager.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Implement Innomar’s CSV strategy and lead validation efforts for GxP-impacting computerized systems, ensuring compliance with PIC/S Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements is established and maintained.
  • Review and/or develop validation strategies and associated documentation in alignment with Innomar’s CSV Policy, CSV procedures, and Validation Master Plan to support compliance and business objectives.
  • Prepare validation documentation packages for CSV projects, including Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices, Risk Assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, test cases, Validation Summary Reports, change controls, and SOPs.
  • Evaluate changes in validated computerized systems using a risk-based approach and assign appropriate levels of validation requirements.
  • Design, create, execute, and review risk-based test cases, including functional, integration, challenge, regression, and other applicable tests, and prepare test data to support validation activities.
  • Provide guidance and support to validation team members, operational business units, IT, and third-party vendors in developing validation deliverables, including User Requirements Specifications, Part 11/Annex 11 assessments, Functional Requirements Specifications, and design specifications.
  • Obtain and review unit test documentation from IT development teams or vendors, where applicable, to confirm code released to the test environment has been adequately unit-tested prior to QA validation activities.
  • Manage defects, deviations, and incidents identified during validation projects, including:
    • Log deviations and incidents identified during IQ, OQ, and PQ activities.
    • Organize defect, deviation, and incident triage meetings with required stakeholders to determine resolution plans.
    • Maintain and update defect, deviation, and incident logs with appropriate status through project closure and filing.
  • Coordinate validation and qualification documentation review, approval, execution, and post-execution review activities.
  • Maintain and archive CSV documentation to support effective retrieval when required.
  • Coordinate with IT, QA, and applicable business units to train validation project team members on testing and validation policies, practices, and tools, including formal training materials, one-on-one coaching, and classroom training where needed.
  • Provide quality guidance and assessments to ensure validated systems are maintained and changed in accordance with current corporate and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct QA audits of IT and validation processes as scheduled.
  • Review and provide input to CSV-related Standard Operating Procedures and policies, where required, and ensure adherence to internal SOPs and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Keep current with relevant industry and regulatory guidelines.
  • Comply with all appropriate policies, procedures and safety rules and regulations.

This job profile description is a standardized, non-contractual reference description and global reference tool provided for organizational consistency and talent architecture purposes across Cencora. It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment. Actual duties and responsibilities may vary based on business needs, local requirements, and operational practices. Where a team member's role is governed by an employment agreement, local terms and conditions, prior job description or collective bargaining agreement, those documents shall prevail in case of any inconsistency. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Requires a minimum of three (3) years of hands-on experience validating GxP computerized systems and working with software development methodologies, preferably in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device industry. Experience in a matrixed environment and collaborating with external vendors is preferred. A college or university degree in computer science, information technology, information security, engineering, software programming, or a related discipline is required.

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires formal training in the field of computer sciences (e.g. IT, information security, engineering, software programming, etc.), business administration or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four-year Bachelor’s Degree program, technical vocational training, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of CSV processes and regulatory requirements, including ISPE GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, PIC/S, ICH, and GxP guidelines.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing is a must.
  • Demonstrated understanding of quality assurance and quality systems principles (training documentation, change control, validation, vendor management and audits).
  • Experience auditing IT processes and validated computerized systems is required.
  • Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills; leadership and relationship building skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills; attention to detail.
  • Ability to resolve system issues effectively and efficiently.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Practical understanding of project management principles and methodologies.
  • Experience in creation and review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) is desirable.
  • Experience in using automated enterprise testing tools is an asset to support and assist company’s testing initiatives.
  • Experience with testing and validation tools such as Kneat PVP, qTest, JIRA, HP ALM, or equivalent platforms is an asset.
  • Working knowledge of relevant technologies, testing tools, automation platforms, Microsoft Copilot, or other AI-enabled tools is an asset.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. La persona liderará el diseño y despliegue de soluciones de infraestructura, redes y seguridad en un entorno corporativo de alta exigencia.

Será responsable de definir arquitecturas end-to-end combinando tecnologías Cisco, Microsoft y otros fabricantes, presentarlas directamente al cliente y coordinar su ejecución junto a los partners tecnológicos involucrados.

No es un rol de gestión pura ni de ejecución técnica aislada: se busca un perfil capaz de conectar visión técnica, cliente y delivery real.

Skills

  • SASE (Secure Access Service Edge): modelo que junta la red y la seguridad en un mismo servicio en la nube, para que cualquier usuario se conecte de forma segura desde donde esté, sin pasar por una oficina física.
  • SSE (Security Service Edge): la parte de seguridad del modelo SASE (sin la parte de red pura): filtrado web, protección de acceso a aplicaciones y control de datos, todo desde la nube.
  • Arquitectura de seguridad perimetral: diseño de las "murallas" que protegen la red de una empresa frente a accesos externos no autorizados (firewalls, control de tráfico entrante/saliente).
  • Acceso seguro: soluciones para que empleados, proveedores o dispositivos entren a los sistemas de la empresa de forma controlada y verificada (VPN, autenticación multifactor, acceso remoto seguro).
  • Redes y seguridad en entornos Cisco: manejo de los equipos y software de red más usados en empresas grandes (switches, routers, firewalls Cisco).
  • Microsoft Azure: la nube de Microsoft, donde las empresas alojan servidores, aplicaciones y datos.
  • Windows Server: sistema operativo con el que se gestionan los servidores internos de una empresa (usuarios, archivos, aplicaciones).
  • AD/Entra ID: el directorio donde se guardan los usuarios de una empresa y sus permisos de acceso; Entra ID es la versión en la nube de Active Directory.
  • Intune: herramienta de Microsoft para gestionar y proteger de forma remota los dispositivos (portátiles, móviles) de los empleados.

Must-haves

  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en arquitectura de seguridad perimetral y acceso seguro.
  • Experiencia sólida en diseño y despliegue de soluciones en cliente final. El rol implica presentar y ejecutar soluciones con un cliente real de alta exigencia, no trabajo aislado de laboratorio.
  • Conocimientos en redes y/o seguridad, especialmente en entornos Cisco.
  • Background técnico en entornos Microsoft (Azure, Windows Server, AD/Entra ID, Intune). Las arquitecturas combinan Cisco y Microsoft; sin este conocimiento solo se cubriría la mitad de la solución.
  • Nivel alto de comunicación, planificación y orientación a resultados. El rol implica presentar arquitecturas directamente al cliente y coordinar su ejecución; es el puente entre la técnica y el negocio.
  • Visión estratégica y de negocio. Se espera conectar decisiones técnicas con el impacto en el negocio del cliente, especialmente en un entorno bancario donde la seguridad es crítica.
  • Nivel alto de inglés. El trabajo directo con fabricantes internacionales (Cisco, Microsoft) requiere manejarse con fluidez en inglés.

Nice-to-haves

  • Certificaciones Cisco (CCNP/CCIE), VMware (VCP), Veeam (VMCE), CISSP/CISM, PMP/PRINCE2 e ITIL. Validan formalmente el conocimiento técnico y de gestión, aunque no son excluyentes.
  • Manejo de MS Project, Jira/Azure Boards, IT Glue o IT Portal. Reduce el tiempo de adaptación a las herramientas internas de planificación y documentación.
  • Experiencia en entornos corporativos complejos o áreas de seguridad estratégica. Aporta contexto valioso para un proyecto de esta envergadura, aunque no es un requisito de entrada.

jobs.description:
Head of Engineering — Agentic AI Healthcare SaaS | Zenara Health

Role Title: Head of Engineering

Location: Remote across India (~6 hours overlap with US Pacific time)

Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder-CEO

Compensation: Well above market for Indian startups at this level. We pay for the caliber we're hiring.

About the Company

Zenara Health builds GenAI-powered clinical decision support and workflow tools for mental health clinics. We integrate AI-driven platforms with professional clinical care to offer personalized and effective mental health solutions — from AI-enhanced evaluations to care coordination — creating a seamless digital experience for both patients and providers.

We are an AI-native organization. That's not a marketing label. Our engineering model is fundamentally built around AI agents participating in the software development lifecycle. We are a startup, not a department.

About the Role

Pay close attention here. If you are an engineering manager who primarily conducts standups and writes status reports, this role may not suit you.

We are transitioning from the product stage to the commercial stage — multiple products, real customers, sensitive clinical data. Our engineers are already delivering, and now we need cohesive engineering leadership to transform exceptional individual contributions into collective organizational success.

What makes this role different from every other Head of Engineering posting: Our engineering team is small by design. A handful of high-caliber engineers orchestrate AI agents that handle significant portions of the SDLC — from code generation to testing to documentation. Your job is not to manage 20 engineers writing code. Your job is to design, implement, and continuously refine the human-agent engineering model — including maker-checker workflows, quality gates for AI-generated output, and escalation protocols that ensure AI speed doesn't come at the cost of AI sloppiness.

This is a relatively new way of working. Very few people have deep experience running agentic SDLC at scale. We're not looking for someone who's done this exact job before — we're looking for someone with the raw intellectual horsepower to figure it out. High learning

velocity, first-principles thinking, and comfort with ambiguity matter more than years on a resume.

You will report directly to the founder-CEO, take ownership of results, and shape the engineering organization. This is the technical co-leader seat — ultimately becoming the person the founder relies on to own all of engineering.

What You Will Own (Everything)

1. Delivery Outcomes

You will oversee delivery for all products — scope management, release cadence, quality controls, and stakeholder alignment. If something is delayed, it's your responsibility. If a product ships smoothly, you can claim that success. You'll shield engineers from scope changes and give the CEO predictable delivery rather than last-minute heroics.

2. Agentic SDLC & AI Governance (The Differentiator)

This is the core of what makes this role unique. You will own the design and execution of our agentic software development lifecycle:

· Human-agent workflow design: Define how AI agents participate in coding, testing, code review, and documentation — and where human engineers must intervene.

· Maker-checker patterns: Build quality gates that catch AI sloppiness. Every AI-generated artifact needs a human verification step calibrated to the risk level — a UI tweak needs a different checkpoint than a database migration.

· Agent orchestration: Determine which agents we use, how they're configured, what guardrails they operate within, and how engineers supervise their output.

· AI tool governance: Define approved tools, IP protection policies, and ensure AI accelerates development without introducing risk — especially given the sensitivity of clinical/PHI data.

· Continuous refinement: This model is new. You'll measure what's working, what's failing, and iterate. The playbook doesn't exist yet — you'll write it.

If you don't have a strong, opinionated perspective on how AI agents should participate in the engineering process — beyond "we use Copilot" — this role is not for you.

3. Engineering Team

You will directly manage the engineering team — hiring, performance, coaching, feedback, conflict resolution, and retention. The team is small and high-leverage; every person matters disproportionately. You'll set the culture and performance bar. Difficult conversations happen early. Engineers will want to work with you because you are fair, direct, and invested in their growth.

4. System Architecture

You own the architecture across the full stack: web applications, APIs, infrastructure, and AI integrations. You'll make trade-off calls — speed vs. rigor, refactor vs. ship, infrastructure vs. features. You should be capable of reviewing code, debugging production issues, and challenging architectural decisions with substance. In a clinical data environment, architectural choices carry compliance and safety implications — you'll factor those in.

5. CI/CD and Release Engineering

You will build the release pipeline — CI/CD, environments, quality checkpoints, deployment automation. Chaotic releases end. You'll create a system that lets the team (and their agents) ship confidently and on a predictable cadence.

6. Security and Compliance Posture

You own engineering security: access controls, secrets management, audit trails, and SDLC security. Healthcare data — especially mental health data — demands this. You'll also ensure AI-generated code and agent workflows meet audit and compliance requirements. Enforce rigor without bureaucracy.

7. Hiring & Team Building

You will build the engineering team — define roles, maintain hiring standards, run technical interviews, and make hiring calls. You're building the organization that takes the company from startup to scale. Given our agentic model, you'll also need to think differently about team composition: fewer engineers, higher caliber, optimized for agent supervision rather than raw code output.

Your First 90 Days

Week 1-2: Immerse yourself. Meet each engineer individually. Understand every product, deployment, and pain point. Map the current human-agent workflows — what's working, what's brittle. Identify delivery risks and the single biggest bottleneck. Build trust through listening, not announcements.

Month 1: Establish a regular delivery cadence. Define the release process and quality standards. Create communication rhythms (standups, retros, planning). Audit the current agentic workflows — identify where AI output lacks sufficient human review. Begin surfacing risks early and reliably, relieving the CEO from delivery oversight.

Month 2-3: Standardize CI/CD across all products. Implement maker-checker quality gates for AI-generated code. Design the AI governance framework — approved tools, IP protection, PHI safeguards for agent workflows. Initiate architecture assessment with a clear roadmap (not a rewrite). Begin hiring to fill gaps. Build the engineering runbook. Establish feedback and coaching routines.

Ongoing: Own engineering completely. Ship reliably. Refine the agentic SDLC continuously. Grow the team. Raise the performance bar. Make the CEO confident that engineering is in expert hands.

Who You Are

First-principles thinker. You reason from fundamentals, not pattern-match from past jobs. When faced with a problem nobody has solved before — like designing quality gates for agent-generated clinical software — you figure it out.

High learning velocity. The agentic SDLC is new territory. You may not have done this exact thing before, but you learn fast enough that it doesn't matter. You've repeatedly moved into unfamiliar domains and become effective quickly.

Ownership-oriented. You view engineering leadership as outcome ownership, not task management. You step into chaotic delivery environments and create order — through clarity and accountability, not excessive process.

Startup-proven. Your experience includes startups, not exclusively large enterprises. You've shipped real products to real users under real deadlines. You know the difference between building something and delivering it.

Technically credible. You can write, review code, debug production issues, understand systems architecture at scale

Direct and fair. You give feedback that develops engineers. You handle conflict promptly. Your teams trust you because you're honest, consistent, and keep them focused.

This role demands someone who can operate in uncharted territory — designing human-agent engineering workflows, making architectural calls with clinical data constraints, and building an engineering org model that doesn't have an established playbook. À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

  • 220 collaborateurs, dont 45 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).

Requirements

Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

About Circadia Health

Circadia Health is a growth-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:

  • Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical-grade accuracy

  • Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance

  • Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000+ post-acute patients daily across skilled-nursing, home-health, and home-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

About the Role
Circadia Health is expanding its clinical delivery infrastructure and is establishing physician-owned professional corporations (PCs) in multiple states, supported by a management services organization (MSO). We are seeking experienced physicians to serve as the owner and President of one or more affiliated medical groups. This is a governance and clinical leadership role — not a full-time clinical position — with responsibility for clinical oversight, regulatory compliance, and professional supervision of an NP-led care model serving skilled nursing and home health patients.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as sole (or majority) shareholder, director, and President of one or more state-specific professional corporations
  • Provide clinical governance: approve clinical protocols, quality standards, and scope-of-practice policies for NP-delivered care (remote patient monitoring, chronic care coordination, transitional care)
  • Execute and maintain collaborative practice / supervision agreements with nurse practitioners as required by state law
  • Oversee credentialing, peer review, and clinical quality committees
  • Serve as (or designate) Medical Director for applicable programs; sign off on clinical policies, standing orders, and care pathways
  • Maintain Medicare enrollment for the PC and reassignment of billing rights consistent with program requirements
  • Partner with the MSO on compliant operations — while retaining exclusive authority over all clinical decisions, consistent with corporate practice of medicine (CPOM) requirements
  • Participate in periodic governance meetings, audits, and payer/regulatory inquiries as needed

Qualifications

  • MD or DO with active, unrestricted medical license; willingness to obtain licensure in additional target states (licensure support and costs covered)
  • Active, unrestricted DEA registration
  • Board certification (Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Geriatrics, or Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation preferred)
  • Current Medicare enrollment (or eligibility) with no revocations, opt-outs, or payment suspensions
  • Clean compliance profile: no OIG/SAM exclusions, no state board discipline, no material malpractice history
  • Experience supervising NPs and/or serving as Medical Director in post-acute, SNF, home health, telehealth, or value-based care settings
  • Comfort with friendly-PC arrangements, including stock transfer restriction / succession agreements and MSO management structures

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience as a PC owner for a telehealth, RPM, or digital health company
  • Multi-state licensure (especially CA, TX, NY, NJ, OH, and other CPOM-strict states) or IMLC participation
  • SNFist / post-acute medical director background; familiarity with PDPM, RPM/CCM billing (99453/99454/99457/99458), and CMS Conditions of Participation
  • Experience with quality programs, UM/peer review, and payer credentialing
Estimated time commitment: 10+ hours/month, scaling with number of states/entities
