jobs.description:
Healthcare Billing & Patient Care Coordinator

Position Type: Part-Time with Full-Time Opportunity

Schedule:

  • Monday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EDT, with a 1-hour unpaid break
  • Wednesday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM EDT
  • Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EDT, with a 1-hour unpaid break

Current Weekly Hours: 20 hours per week

Salary: $5–$7 per hour, depending on experience


Workplace: Remote

About the Practice

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare practice focused on providing highly personalized and patient-centered care. The practice places a strong emphasis on creating a supportive, compassionate experience for patients while maintaining efficient clinical and administrative workflows.

Because the practice works closely with patients throughout their care journey, the ideal candidate will understand that successful healthcare administration involves more than completing paperwork—it also requires empathy, accuracy, responsiveness, and proactive coordination.


We are seeking an experienced and compassionate Healthcare Billing & Patient Care Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based healthcare practice. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong medical billing and prior authorization expertise with excellent patient communication and healthcare administrative skills.

The role supports both healthcare administration and patient coordination, including prior authorizations, insurance verification, billing, patient intake, scheduling, and follow-ups. The ideal candidate combines strong billing and insurance knowledge with a warm, trauma-informed approach to patient care. This is a part-time role with an opportunity to transition to full-time between November and January.

Key Responsibilities

Prior Authorizations & Medical Billing

  • Manage prior authorizations (PAs) on a rolling basis to help ensure patients receive timely access to services.
  • Review patient charts and relevant documentation to identify and complete required prior authorizations.
  • Handle weekly medical billing, ensuring services and information are accurately reviewed before submission.
  • Verify billing information and submit claims through the appropriate clearinghouse.
  • Assist with denied claims, investigate issues, and support appropriate follow-up and resolution.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of authorization and billing activities.

Insurance Verification & Claims Support

  • Conduct accurate and timely insurance eligibility and benefits verification.
  • Work primarily with Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) insurance processes.
  • Review coverage information and identify potential authorization, eligibility, or billing issues before services are provided.
  • Assist with insurance-related patient inquiries when appropriate.
  • Apply knowledge of U.S. healthcare insurance requirements and workflows to minimize billing delays and denials.
  • Rhode Island healthcare experience or knowledge is an advantage but not required.

Patient Screening & Intake Coordination

  • Respond to new patient inquiries and conduct initial screenings.
  • Review patient information to help determine whether prospective patients meet the practice's intake criteria.
  • Schedule qualified patients for new patient intake appointments.
  • Coordinate consultations for individuals who require additional assessment before moving forward.
  • Ensure patient information and intake documentation are complete and accurately entered into the appropriate system.

Patient Follow-Up & Care Coordination

  • Conduct outbound follow-up calls to maintain appropriate contact with patients throughout their care journey.
  • Communicate with patients using a warm, compassionate, and trauma-informed approach.
  • Assist with appointment scheduling, rescheduling, inquiries, and post-treatment follow-ups.
  • Help ensure patients understand next steps and receive timely communication from the practice.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when discussing sensitive patient information.

Virtual Reception & Administrative Support

  • Answer incoming patient calls professionally and compassionately.
  • Monitor and manage voicemail messages and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Coordinate schedules and maintain accurate patient records.
  • Support day-to-day administrative workflows to keep the practice organized and responsive.
  • Identify inefficiencies or gaps in existing healthcare administrative processes and proactively recommend improvements based on previous experience.

Typical Day

A typical day may include reviewing patient charts for prior authorization requirements and new patient intakes, verifying insurance coverage, reviewing and submitting billing through the clearinghouse, managing scheduling, and responding to patient inquiries.

Phone volume is relatively manageable, with approximately four calls per week currently focused primarily on appointment booking and patient inquiries. This allows the role to maintain a strong focus on billing, prior authorizations, insurance, and administrative workflows.

Systems & Tools

Experience with the following is helpful, although direct experience with every platform is not required:

  • PracticeQ – EHR/practice management
  • Office Ally – Medical billing and clearinghouse
  • Availity – Insurance eligibility, authorization, and payer workflows

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Strong previous experience with U.S. healthcare billing and insurance workflows is required.
  • Hands-on experience processing prior authorizations is required.
  • Strong knowledge of insurance verification, eligibility, benefits, claims, and denied claims.
  • Familiarity with Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS) processes is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based healthcare practices in a remote or virtual capacity is preferred.
  • Experience with behavioral health or mental health practices is a strong advantage.
  • Rhode Island healthcare or insurance experience is helpful but not required.
  • Experience using PracticeQ, Office Ally, Availity, or similar EHR, billing, clearinghouse, and insurance platforms is preferred.
  • A medical degree or active clinical license is not required for this position.

What We're Looking For

Our strongest candidates will bring expertise in three key areas:

  1. Prior Authorizations & Billing – You can confidently manage PAs, insurance verification, billing submissions, and claims-related issues with minimal supervision.
  2. Healthcare Workflows – You understand how the administrative side of a U.S. healthcare practice operates and can identify opportunities to make processes more efficient.
  3. Patient Management – You are comfortable handling patient intake, scheduling, inquiries, follow-ups, and post-treatment communication with professionalism and empathy.

You should also:

  • Have a trauma-informed, compassionate approach when communicating with patients.
  • Be comfortable speaking with individuals who may be dealing with sensitive or difficult circumstances.
  • Be proactive rather than waiting for every task to be assigned.
  • Be capable of using your previous healthcare administrative experience to recommend better workflows or solutions when appropriate.
  • Demonstrate excellent attention to detail, especially when working with insurance, billing, authorizations, and patient records.
  • Be organized and capable of managing multiple administrative priorities independently.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be highly proficient in spoken and written English, with clear and professional communication skills.
  • Must have relevant U.S. healthcare administrative experience.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance background check before onboarding.
  • Must be available for virtual video meetings with the camera on when required.
  • Must maintain patient confidentiality and follow appropriate healthcare privacy and security practices.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.description:
Our Vision & Mission

We believe in a world where everyone, regardless of their country’s wealth or frontiers, enjoys access to medicines and healthcare when they need it. We work tirelessly to provide access to medicinces to those in LMIC's.

Who We Are:Accelerating access to medicines for all

Imagine a world where critical medicines are within reach, affordable, and synonymous with quality, no matter where you are. Axmed is building the digital infrastructure that is transforming access to medicines and health products across growth markets.

About the Position:

We have a bold ambition that will impact the lives of billions of patients. We are looking for an exceptional communications leader to make sure the world knows it and convince the relevant stakeholders to join our mission. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a builder and operator. This role comes with significant autonomy, direct access, and an equal high bar for ownership and impact. You will have the mandate to shape how Axmed shows up in the world. You will own our communications strategy, creative ambition, narrative, brand presence, thought leadership, and external visibility.

This is a sleeves-up, hands-on, high-energy role. We expect roughly 70–80% of this role to be hands-on execution, supported by strong strategic judgment and ruthless prioritisation. You will set the strategy and personally bring much of it to life: writing, editing, publishing, building decks, shaping campaigns, developing executive content, briefing agencies and partners, improving our digital presence, testing new formats and channels, using data to understand what works, and continuously shipping.

The mandate is simple: make Axmed impossible to ignore among the audiences that matter to our mission and growth.

The Person We’re Looking For:

You are passionate about what you do and an unusually strong communicator and exceptionally skilled storyteller who combines strategic judgment with very high execution capacity.

You can zoom out far enough to shape a company narrative and zoom in close enough to obsess over a headline, slide, caption, sentence, or call to action.

You thrive in fast-paced, tech-first environments and are comfortable operating without a large team, large budget, or elaborate process. Faced with ambiguity, you create clarity. You would rather test a strong idea, learn from the response and improve it than spend weeks perfecting a communications plan nobody sees. You have worked in healthcare before and are intellectually curious enough to become genuinely expert in the subjects Axmed has a right to lead on.

You should bring:

  • Extreme ownership, pace, curiosity, resourcefulness, and attention to detail.

  • Exceptional writing, editing, messaging, and storytelling ability.

  • A strong instinct for what makes an idea interesting, credible, distinctive, and shareable.

  • Experience building communications, brand, content, or thought leadership in a fast-moving startup.

  • The ability to translate technical or complex subject matter into communication that senior stakeholders can quickly understand.

  • Experience working directly with CEOs or senior executives on thought leadership and external positioning.

  • Strong digital and social instincts and an understanding of how content actually travels.

  • Comfort with communications analytics and using evidence to improve performance.

  • High proficiency with modern AI tools and a desire to build agentic and automated ways of working.

  • Experience in global health, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, technology, marketplaces , or another complex multi-stakeholder environment would be highly valuable.

What Success Looks Like:

  • The right people know Axmed and why it matters. We build awareness and recognition as a leading global health procurement infrastructure player.

  • Axmed has a distinctive voice. Our narrative is clear, memorable and associated with the issues we want to lead.

  • Our ideas travel. We earn media coverage, partner amplification, speaking opportunities and engagement from influential stakeholders.

  • Our leaders are influential voices. Their perspectives earn attention, invitations and opportunities from the right audiences.

  • Major moments break through. Launches, partnerships, market entries, fundraising and other milestones reach and influence priority audiences.

  • Communications drives growth. Our work generates partner, commercial, platform, investor and donor opportunities.

  • We achieve disproportionate output. AI, automation and strong systems enable greater speed and quality than our team size would suggest.

  • We know what works. Data guides which narratives, formats, channels, audiences and campaigns we invest in.

What you'll Own:

1. Narrative, Positioning & Brand

Own and continuously sharpen Axmed's overarching narrative and positioning.

You will:

  • Define and evolve the story of Axmed: what we believe, what we are building, why it matters, and why Axmed is uniquely positioned to deliver it.

  • Translate Axmed's value proposition for different audiences, including procurers, governments, donors, suppliers, pharmaceutical manufacturers, investors, and ecosystem partners.

  • Protect the quality and coherence of the Axmed brand across external and high-value internal touchpoints.

2. Content, Thought Leadership & Distribution

Build and run Axmed's external communications engine.

You will:

  • Own the end-to-end editorial and content strategy across Axmed's owned channels.

  • Own the right mix of owned, earned, paid and partner distribution to get Axmed’s ideas and company moments in front of the audiences that matter.

  • Personally create and edit high-quality content including articles, social posts, executive communications, case studies, presentations, reports, launch materials, partner stories, video concepts, and other formats.

  • Identify the ideas, insights, data, customer stories, and market developments Axmed has a right to speak about and turn them into compelling content.

  • Own Axmed's social media presence and execution across priority platforms.

  • Experiment continuously with formats, hooks, channels, and distribution strategies to expand reach and engagement.

  • Use partner channels, leadership networks, ecosystem platforms, events, and collaborators to extend Axmed's reach beyond our owned audience.

  • Be data centric and track communications performance and continuously improve what we create, where we distribute it, and how we communicate.

3. CEO & Leadership Communications

Turn Axmed's leadership into a strategic communications asset.

You will:

  • Build a distinctive and credible external voice for Axmed's CEO and other priority leaders.

  • Translate leadership ideas, experiences, and points of view into high-quality social content, articles, presentations, talking points, interviews, and other communications.

  • Proactively identify moments where Axmed's leaders should have a point of view rather than waiting for content requests.

  • Develop a repeatable executive communications cadence rather than treating thought leadership as a series of one-off posts.

4. Campaigns, Launches & Ecosystem Moments

Make important Axmed moments land.

You will:

  • Design and execute integrated communications around product launches, market entries, strategic partnerships, fundraising announcements, company milestones, and major commercial initiatives.

  • Build communications plans that connect narrative, content, social, partner channels, leadership voices, events, and earned opportunities.

  • Shape Axmed's participation in high-value conferences, panels, roundtables, and ecosystem moments.

  • Work with external agencies and partners where useful while remaining accountable for the thinking, quality, speed, and final output.

  • Lead end-to-end PR campaigns

5. Commercial Enablement

Ensure our communications make it easier for Axmed to win.

You will:

  • Work closely with Commercial to translate Axmed's proposition into excellent customer- and partner-facing materials.

  • Create and continuously improve pitch decks, one-pagers, partner briefs, case studies, leave-behinds, presentations, and other high-value collateral.

  • Build modular content and messaging that teams can quickly adapt for different markets, audiences, and use cases.

  • Ensure communications is involved early in product launches, market entries, partnerships, and strategic initiatives rather than brought in at the end to "make it look good."

  • Surface stories, proof points, customer insights, and evidence from across the business that strengthen Axmed's external narrative

6. Build an AI-Native Communications Function

Use AI and automation to give Axmed disproportionate communications leverage.

You will:

  • Build AI-enabled workflows and agents that accelerate research, monitoring, content development, repurposing, distribution, analytics, and communications operations.

  • Establish systems that help Axmed identify relevant conversations, ecosystem developments, partner activity, emerging narratives, and content opportunities quickly.

  • Help establish responsible ways for teams across Axmed to use AI while maintaining accuracy, judgment, confidentiality, and a distinctive human voice.

What is in it for you?

At Axmed, we believe in creating a supportive and rewarding environment where our team can thrive. Here’s what we offer:

  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Monthly wellness allowance: Prioritize your health and well-being with extra support.

  • Paid parental leave: Time off to bond with your new family member without any added stress.

  • Flexible working hours: Enjoy the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits your lifestyle.

  • Annual off-site retreats: Connect with the team and build lasting relationships during our company retreats.

  • Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the world and join our distributed team.

LOCATION

Remote Work-at-Home

POSITION OVERVIEW

REMOTE CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE

Looking for opportunities to work for a rapidly growing company? We are looking for call center representatives to support inbound and outbound customer service and sales projects for a wide variety of clients. In this role, you will handle inbound inquiries, troubleshoot basic technical issues, and provide customers with quality product and services. Candidates should have excellent communication skills, willing to learn on the job, and be highly reliable.

There are a wide variety of project openings available representing some of the most recognizable brands in the world. Schedules vary by site and program; however, we can usually find something that works for everyone.

This is an entry-level position that offers on the job paid training. While prior contact center experience isn’t required, experience in customer service, tech support, inside sales or back-office support is a plus.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
  • Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers
  • Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
  • Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa's Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI's subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines. Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

POSITION OVERVIEW

REMOTE CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE

Looking for opportunities to work for a rapidly growing company? We are looking for call center representatives to support inbound and outbound customer service and sales projects for a wide variety of clients. In this role, you will handle inbound inquiries, troubleshoot basic technical issues, and provide customers with quality product and services. Candidates should have excellent communication skills, willing to learn on the job, and be highly reliable.

There are a wide variety of project openings available representing some of the most recognizable brands in the world. Schedules vary by site and program; however, we can usually find something that works for everyone.

This is an entry-level position that offers on the job paid training. While prior contact center experience isn’t required, experience in customer service, tech support, inside sales or back-office support is a plus.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $4,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Software Engineer with a unique blend of accounting experience who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

Sezzle Technical Stack:

  • Golang backend, React / React Native front-end
  • Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS
  • Gitlab CI/CD deployments
  • Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
  • Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Work as an integrated team member developing new features.
  • Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
  • Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
  • Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
  • Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

What We Look For:

  • Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
  • Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
  • Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with backend API development.
  • Experience with relational database storage and retrieval.
  • Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

  • Assist in configuring and customizing tools to meet specific client needs.
  • Develop and execute test plans to ensure solutions meet specified requirements and quality standards.

  • Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements, present solutions, and obtain stakeholder buy-in.
  • Prepare and deliver presentations and reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
Process Improvement and Optimization:
  • Identify opportunities to enhance client business processes through the effective use of FSM solutions.
  • Recommend best practices and innovative solutions to improve field service operations and efficiency.
  • Monitor solution performance and suggest enhancements based on data analysis and client feedback.
Testing
  • Hands on experience writing detailed user stories, test cases and executing tests. Should have an eye for details and be familiar with arduous test cases.

  • Experience guiding new users through individual and collaborative UAT sessions.
  • Should be familiar with navigating difficult conversations with users when bugs are uncovered or business needs are deprioritized for the scope of the project.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a focus on Enterprise Field Service Management and mobile workforce solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, and solution implementation.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL to access, retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, MS SharePoint, Process design tools (Vizio, Signavio, etc.) and similar PMO tools.
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and field service management (REQUIRED)
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and propose effective solutions.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Familiarity with business integration requirements across technology stack (ERP, CRM, CIS, BI, Datawarehouse, etc.)

jobs.excerpt: Monstercat, now part of Create Music Group, is one of electronic music's most influential independent record labels, leading the movement towards artist sustainability.
jobs.description:
Monstercat, now part of Create Music Group, is one of electronic music's most influential independent record labels, leading the movement towards artist sustainability. Founded in Waterloo, Canada in 2011, Monstercat has since expanded its global footprint with staff in Vancouver, Los Angeles, and Toronto. Championing a roster of world-renowned artists including Marshmello, Alan Walker, Kaskade, Koven, DIESEL (aka Shaquille O’Neal), WHIPPED CREAM, Monstercat celebrated over 20 Billion streams in 2023 with five releases a week across its Uncaged, Instinct, and Silk brands. The label has topped radio and streaming charts worldwide, offering a diverse range of genres across bass, dance, pop, house, chill, electronic, and more. Beyond recorded music, Monstercat channels the undeniable power of its brand into live events, ecommerce, gaming partnerships, digital collectibles, and sync deals. Backed by passionate employees, driven artists, and the dedication of fans worldwide, Monstercat proves that independent labels have the ability to reshape and reimagine the music industry landscape.

Job Summary

Monstercat is building a high-velocity content engine across unbranded culture pages on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — channels designed to reach new audiences organically through trending, genre-relevant content.

The Content Producer owns this channel network end-to-end: creating content at volume, identifying and launching new channels where opportunity exists, and acting as a key executional partner to the digital marketing team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes internet culture, moves fast, and can turn ideas into polished clips the same day.

This position is a fixed-term contract through June 30, 2027, with the possibility of conversion to a full-time role contingent on business needs.

Responsibilities

Content Production

  • Create and publish short-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) at high volume across multiple culture page accounts
  • Edit clips, trailers, and highlight packages using tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or equivalent
  • Source and repurpose catalog audio and video assets to fit trending formats quickly
  • Maintain a consistent posting cadence across all active channels with minimal direction
  • Support content output across frontline releases

Channel Strategy & Growth

  • Proactively monitor TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube for emerging trends, formats, and niche communities relevant to Monstercat genres
  • Identify and pitch new channel opportunities — propose concepts, target audiences, and content formats before being asked
  • Launch and manage new unbranded culture pages from zero, including handle setup, visual identity, and early posting strategy
  • Track channel performance and iterate on content direction based on retention, reach, and growth data

Digital Marketing Support

  • Respond to ad hoc content requests from the Digital Marketing Manager with quick turnaround
  • Support release windows by creating timely, on-format content that amplifies new drops across culture channels
  • Coordinate with the Creator Network team to share formats, assets, and posting strategies
  • Feed performance insights back to the broader marketing team to inform campaign decisions
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 2+ years creating short-form video content professionally or with a demonstrable track record of growth
  • Proficiency with at least one editing tool — CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or equivalent
  • Deep familiarity with TikTok and Instagram as platforms: how the algorithms work, what drives retention, what formats are trending
  • Ability to produce polished, publish-ready content independently — no hand-holding on execution
  • Strong taste and an intuitive sense of what resonates in electronic music, dance, and internet culture spaces
  • Self-starter mentality: you spot the opportunity and act on it before being asked

Nice to Have

  • Experience running unbranded or niche content pages (culture pages, fan pages, genre accounts)
  • Familiarity with Monstercat or dance music broadly.
  • Experience with AI-assisted content tools (e.g. auto-captioning, generative B-roll, voiceover tools)
  • Understanding of Spotify streaming metrics and how social content drives algorithmic performance
  • Basic knowledge of Meta Business Manager or TikTok Business Center for managing multiple accounts

Pay Scale

  • $60,000 - 70,000 (CAD) per year
  • The final compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

As a Web Developer supporting the VA's National Training and Support Program (NTSP) Quality and Data Informatics initiative, you will design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites that serve VA staff, stakeholders, and Veterans across the federal healthcare ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring digital content is accessible, compliant, and performant in alignment with VA standards and federal regulations. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, self-directed web developer who thrives in a structured federal contracting environment and takes pride in delivering inclusive, Section 508-compliant digital experiences that support the VA mission.

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, modernize, and maintain SharePoint, Internet, and Intranet websites in support of NTSP program operations and VA stakeholder needs. Conduct comprehensive website assessments and develop management plans, design templates, and visual mockups to guide site development and continuous improvement. Establish and maintain website user groups and access permissions, ensuring appropriate role-based controls and governance in alignment with VA security policies. Perform website coding and prepare digital content for posting in full compliance with Section 508 accessibility standards, the VA Style Guide, and applicable copyright and release documentation requirements. Monitor and report on website performance across accessibility, quality assurance, and search engine optimization (SEO) dimensions, implementing improvements as needed. Support the structured transition of website maintenance responsibilities to Government personnel at task order conclusion, including documentation, knowledge transfer sessions, and handoff materials.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum of 4 years of relevant web development experience, including design, development, and maintenance of SharePoint and web-based platforms (a BA/BS degree may be substituted with 7 total years of relevant experience). BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Web Development, or a related field required; 3 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of degree. Prior experience working with federal agencies, VA programs, or other government healthcare clients strongly preferred; familiarity with VA digital standards and federal web governance frameworks is a plus. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and successfully complete a VA background investigation as required for system access. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Demonstrated proficiency with Section 508 accessibility standards, web content management best practices, and the ability to produce compliant, VA Style Guide–aligned digital content.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform tools including Power Automate and PowerApps for workflow automation and low-code application development in a federal environment. • Proficiency with data and reporting tools such as SQL, Power BI, SSMS, Azure Data Studio, TOAD, SSIS, and/or SSRS to support data-informed web and informatics solutions. • Familiarity with Python scripting for automation, data processing, or web-related tasks within a VA or federal healthcare context. • Prior experience supporting knowledge transfer and website transition activities at the conclusion of a federal task order or contract period of performance. • Understanding of VA or federal health informatics data standards and how web platforms support quality and data-driven program reporting.

Description

TripleTen es una plataforma que empodera a las personas, independientemente de su experiencia previa, para embarcarse en el emocionante y crucial camino de dominar profesiones tecnológicas. Nuestra misión es asegurar que cada estudiante tenga la oportunidad de dominar una profesión tecnológica, encontrar su propósito y convertirse en un valioso contribuidor en la industria tech. Estamos buscando expertos deCiberseguridad apasionados por la seguridad informática, con experiencia práctica y vocación para guiar a principiantes mientras construyen una base sólida en este campo clave. Este rol requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en ciberseguridad, habilidades de comunicación claras y empatía para apoyar e inspirar a estudiantes que están dando sus primeros pasos en esta área.

﻿¿Te gustaría ayudar a construir el futuro de otras personas a través de la educación tecnológica?

➡️ Te pedimos amablemente que envíes tu CV en inglés.

What you will do

Como experto en proyectos, liderarás a una cohorte de estudiantes a lo largo de nuestro programa de Cybersecurity, compartiendo tu experiencia e inspirándolos con tu conocimiento de la industria. Apoyarás a los estudiantes respondiendo sus preguntas y brindándoles orientación práctica de las siguientes maneras:

  • Impartiendo webinars quincenales enfocados en proyectos, guiando a los estudiantes en la aplicación práctica de conceptos de ciberseguridad y en escenarios reales.
  • Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).

  • Respondiendo preguntas relacionadas con los proyectos en Discord, ayudando a los estudiantes a resolver problemas y profundizar su comprensión de las prácticas de ciberseguridad.
  • Actuando como el experto y mentor de referencia, acompañando a los estudiantes mientras desarrollan sus proyectos y fortalecen sus habilidades en ciberseguridad.

Requerimos al menos 3 años de experiencia práctica en ciberseguridad, con conocimientos en las siguientes áreas:

• Network & Architecture: comprensión de redes planas vs. segmentadas, DMZ y estrategias para reducir la superficie de ataque y el blast radius.

• Authentication & Access Abuse: conocimiento de riesgos relacionados con accesos privilegiados, uso de RDP y exportaciones sospechosas de datos.

• Incident Analysis: capacidad para investigar eventos como intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión, restablecimientos de contraseña y actividad sospechosa en cuentas utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.

• Log Analysis: experiencia analizando logs de sistemas y seguridad para detectar anomalías o comportamientos sospechosos.

• Paciencia y empatía al apoyar a estudiantes que están iniciando en ciberseguridad.

• Nivel de inglés B1.

﻿Ventajas adicionales:

• Experiencia previa enseñando o mentoreando.

• Experiencia guiando a principiantes en temas técnicos con explicaciones paso a paso.

Capacitación en técnicas de mentoría y comunicación.

Overview

JOB TITLE: Cloud Engineer II (Linux)

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: DHS ICE - OSDSS

POSITION INFORMATION: Full time

LOCATION: Remote

POSITION TIMING: Candidate must obtain a DHS Public Trust clearance, which typically takes 4 to 6+ weeks to process. Clearance must be fully granted before starting on the program.

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, 3 weeks' Paid Time Off

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer II with strong Linux administration and DevOps experience to support cloud-based IT infrastructure for DHS/ICE in a secure, mission-driven environment. This role analyzes functional business and technical requirements, implements specifications, and identifies and resolves problems within existing systems while supporting the design, implementation, and enhancement of new and existing systems. The Cloud Engineer II participates in continuous analysis for performance, process, and security improvements, and contributes to the development and build of next-generation IT systems.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience supporting and securing cloud-based systems in AWS and Azure, administering UNIX/Linux systems at scale, and developing with DevOps tools such as Ansible. This role is responsible for understanding the needs of the customer and the realities of FedRAMP-available IT products, and for translating those needs into requirements that can be implemented by the architecture and engineering team using COTS products. Experience with system engineering in one or more areas — including computer languages, operating systems, or DevOps — is essential.

If you are passionate about secure cloud infrastructure and enjoy working in a collaborative, high-performance team environment, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage cloud-based IT system infrastructure and processes.
  • Provide second-level problem diagnosis and resolution of issues.
  • Support the implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of customer IT systems.
  • Operate master consoles to monitor the performance of networks and computer systems.
  • Coordinate computer network access and use.
  • Coordinate with other engineering groups to ensure proper network operation and subnets.
  • Perform Linux administration support activities.
  • Develop, code, test, and debug new Ansible Playbooks and recipes, or enhancements to existing software.
  • Analyze system scans and remediate findings and POA&Ms.
  • Coordinate configuration changes, installs, and upgrades with application owners — including planning, scheduling, status reporting, and adherence to company change control procedures.
  • Lead third-party team coordination, communication, and audit review of installed environments and processes.
  • Create and maintain support documentation and written procedures for routine and non-routine tasks.
  • Supervise junior staff, as assigned.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in installation, configuration, and administration of UNIX/Linux based systems in a large environment.
  • Experience supporting and securing cloud-based systems in AWS and Azure.
  • Experience with implementation and configuration of Kion.
  • Experience requesting and installing secure certificates, enabling Global Security using LDAP registry, and setting up SSO using SPNEGO and SAML.
  • Good UNIX shell scripting skills, with exposure to emerging DevOps tools such as Ansible.
  • Ability to evaluate new products and technologies and provide recommendations to enhance the current environment.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills, including analyzing log and trace files, opening service requests, collecting documentation, working with vendors, and driving problem resolution.
  • Strong knowledge of security standards and hardening requirements such as DHS 4300A, DoD STIG, and FISMA requirements.
  • Able to work and interact with others in a structured team environment.
  • Ability to work with all levels of staff within and outside of IT and outside the organization.
  • Self-starter able to work independently but comfortable working in a team environment; requires limited supervision and strong time management skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including a demonstrated ability to communicate technical issues to a nontechnical audience.
  • Independent problem solver with strong troubleshooting, decision-making, and analytical skills.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail, with strong organizational skills.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to handle competing work demands; dependable and flexible when necessary.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust clearance.

DESIRED:

  • Certifications in AWS, Azure, Ansible, or other DevOps stack technologies.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Candidate must be able to function in general office environment.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Full-Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern web applications across frontend and backend systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone comfortable working across the full development lifecycle — from building user-facing applications and backend services to designing APIs, working with databases, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting cloud deployments.

You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering stakeholders while using modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools to ship reliable, scalable software.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack Application Development

  • Develop and maintain frontend and backend applications
  • Build scalable, reliable, and maintainable application features
  • Translate product and technical requirements into working software
  • Write clean, well-structured, and reusable code
  • Improve existing applications as requirements evolve

Frontend Development

  • Build responsive and user-friendly web interfaces
  • Work with modern frontend frameworks and component-based architectures
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services
  • Troubleshoot frontend performance and functionality issues
  • Collaborate with product and design stakeholders on implementation

Backend, APIs & Integrations

  • Develop and maintain backend services and application logic
  • Build APIs and integrations with third-party systems
  • Design reliable data flows between applications and external platforms
  • Troubleshoot integration and backend issues
  • Ensure systems remain scalable and maintainable

Databases & Data Models

  • Design and work with application databases and data models
  • Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
  • Maintain data integrity and application reliability
  • Support database queries, application logic, and performance improvements

Testing, Debugging & Code Quality

  • Troubleshoot bugs and production issues
  • Implement testing and development best practices
  • Participate in technical planning and code reviews
  • Improve application reliability and maintainability
  • Help identify technical issues before they affect users

Cloud, Deployment & Development Workflows

  • Work with cloud infrastructure and deployment workflows
  • Support application releases and production deployments
  • Use Git and version-control best practices
  • Contribute to reliable development and deployment processes

AI-Assisted Software Development

  • Use modern AI development tools to improve engineering productivity
  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to coding, debugging, research, and development
  • Evaluate new AI development capabilities where they can improve execution
  • Maintain strong engineering judgment while using AI-assisted tools

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong experience with at least one modern frontend framework
  • Backend development experience using a modern programming language and/or framework
  • Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases
  • Hands-on experience building or integrating APIs
  • Strong Git and version-control experience
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment workflows
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience building production-grade full-stack applications
  • Experience with third-party API integrations
  • Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD workflows
  • Experience working with cloud-native applications
  • Experience collaborating directly with product and design teams

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy building across both frontend and backend systems
  • Take ownership of features from development through deployment
  • Write code with scalability and maintainability in mind
  • Can independently troubleshoot technical problems
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Your day may include developing frontend features, building backend services, integrating APIs, working with databases, reviewing code, and troubleshooting application issues.

You may also participate in technical planning, collaborate with product and design stakeholders, support deployments, and use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding and problem-solving.

In short: you build, improve, and maintain reliable web applications across the full technology stack.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean, maintainable, and scalable code
  • Stable frontend and backend systems
  • Reliable API and third-party integrations

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator with over 100 years of healthcare industry experience and around 50,000 employees globally.

We enable clinicians to make faster, more informed decisions through intelligent devices, data analytics,applications,and services, supported by our Edison intelligence platform. Weoperateat the center of an ecosystem working toward precision health -digitizing healthcare, helping drive productivity and improving outcomes for patients, providers, healthsystemsand researchers around the world.

The Service Sourcing Leader will be responsible for developing and executing regional sourcing strategies across Service Sourcing categories, including LSI, Field Service, Mechanical Installation, services, accessories, and related third-party support.
This role will focus on optimizing cost, quality, delivery, compliance, and supplier performance while supporting business growth, service operations, customer needs, and public bid strategies across LATAM. The leader will work closely with regional stakeholders, global sourcing teams, operations, quality, finance, legal, compliance, and commercial teams to ensure sourcing strategies are aligned with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and customer commitments.
The role requires strong strategic sourcing experience, practical problem-solving skills, supplier management discipline, and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and business priorities.

Whatyou’lldo:

  • Support Sales, Operations, and Commercial teams with sourcing strategies for public bids, customer opportunities, urgent business needs, and service delivery commitments.
  • Develop and execute regional sourcing and category strategies for
    Service Sourcing across Latin America, including local source item (LSI), Field Service, Mechanical Installation, services, accessories, and third-party service labor.
  • Lead supplier selection, negotiation, contracting, onboarding, and supplier transition activities across the region.
  • Drive cost reduction initiatives through competitive bidding, market analysis, supplier negotiations, value engineering, demand management, and process simplification.
  • Manage supplier relationships and performance, including quality, delivery, cost, lead time, compliance, and service responsiveness.
  • Identify supplier performance gaps and lead corrective action plans with clear ownership, timeline, evidence, and follow-up discipline.
  • Coordinate with global sourcing leaders to ensure Latin America strategies are aligned with global category direction while addressing local market and customer requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Quality, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Commercial, and Business teams across the region.

  • Identify and mitigate sourcing and supply chain risks, including financial, regulatory, operational, geopolitical, logistical, and supplier dependency risks.
  • Ensure sourcing execution is compliant with GE HealthCare policies, quality systems, regulatory requirements, and applicable local laws.
  • Support supplier audits, qualification, documentation, and compliance reviews when required by business or regulatory needs.
  • Monitor, report, and present sourcing performance, savings, supplier risks, key initiatives, and action plans to regional and global leadership.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization, simplification, and digitalization opportunities within the LATAM Service Sourcing process.

What you need to have:

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to use data to support recommendations.

jobs.description:
The Client Support Analyst acts as the initial point of contact for clients seeking assistance and oversees the initial triage, troubleshooting, escalation, and resolution of customer issues.
This role involves engaging with clients to address inquiries regarding products and implemented solutions, as well as troubleshooting and resolving issues while upholding high standards of customer service. Candidates must possess strong communication skills, and a curious solution-oriented mindset, ensuring that clients feel valued and respected. Moreover, Client Support Analysts are expected to be familiar with Linux systems, the basics of SQL, and Python or Perl scripting.
In addition to basic technical expertise, maintaining strong relationships with clients is crucial for fostering client loyalty and promoting product adoption. Successful candidates must demonstrate excellent time management, relationship-building, and organizational skills.
Hours:8:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide excellent customer service to BlueMatrix clients, teammates, and cross-functional peers through consistent and thoughtful behavior aligned with BlueMatrix’s values.
  • Respond to client inquiries submitted via BlueMatrix’s support portal, email, and phone.
  • Identify, evaluate, and diagnose basic technical issues reported by clients related to the BlueMatrix’s software solutions.
  • Prioritize a support activity based on customer impact and manage time effectively to meet client needs.
  • Collaborate with peers to efficiently deliver issue resolution.
  • Route complex issues to higher level resources for resolution, as required.
  • Gather and document client issue information, log customer communications, and maintain records of issue resolutions within the BlueMatrix’s ticketing system.
  • Author, edit, and actively contribute to the improvement of knowledge base articles, FAQs, and functional documentation related to the BlueMatrix’s proprietary software.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ year of experience in technical support or a client-facing role within a technology environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and phone communication skills, with the ability to listen actively, convey empathy, and maintain a professional tone during live customer interactions.
  • Clear and concise written communication skills, including the ability to document case history, summarize technical findings, and escalate issues effectively for internal teams.
  • Diligent attention to detail in capturing key technical and client information throughout the support process to ensure accurate and consistent issue handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client issues simultaneously while effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable using support ticketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Ability to be consistently productive while working remotely, with access to a quiet work area with a reliable high speed internet connection.
  • Good understanding of:
    - Linux (navigating, file structure, basic commands, connecting to databases)
    - SQL (writing and executing basic queries)
    - Python and/or Perl scripting (debugging and applying minor updates)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Basic understanding of systems and applications and aptitude to learn quickly.
  • Patient and empathetic demeanor in high-pressure situations.
  • Follows structured troubleshooting and escalates when needed.
  • Strong documentation habits and detail orientation.
  • Aware of data privacy and handles sensitive data responsibly.
  • Adapts to product changes and evolving client needs.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Introductory exposure to:
    - Git and version control
    - Kibana or similar dashboards to view application logs
    - HTML/CSS structure as it relates to UI issues
    - Cybersecurity principles (e.g., phishing, data handling)
    - Basic understanding of web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge)
    - Excel (formulas, sorting, filters)

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. The expectation of this role is to be able to meet these requirements in a home or work office setting.

WHAT WE DO

BlueMatrix develops one-of-a-kind web applications for the authoring, distribution, and analysis of investment research, and for internal knowledge management and digital communications. Our mission is to streamline the publishing process on a global scale.

WHY WORK WITH US

The BlueMatrix team is made up of ambitious and passionate people who have turned technology development and client service into an art. Many have dedicated the majority of their career to growing the BlueMatrix brand and helping shape the investment research marketplace.
With locations in New York City, Durham, London, Edinburgh, and Timisoara, Romania, we collaborate across the globe for a unique perspective on the impact of technology in our industry.

jobs.title: Teamleiter CRM / E-Mail Marketing (d/w/m)
jobs.excerpt: Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt.
jobs.description:
Wir wachsen schneller, als unsere Betreuungsstruktur mitkommt. Aktuell hängen zu viele Entscheidungen an zu wenigen Köpfen — und unsere Account Manager:innen brauchen jemanden, der sie führt, nicht nur jemanden, der über ihnen steht.

Deshalb bauen wir die Ebene der Key Account Manager aus. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Team und ein eigenes Kundenportfolio — und gestaltest mit, wie Betreuung bei MAILODY in Zukunft funktioniert.

Wir sagen offen dazu: Diese Rolle ist gerade die anspruchsvollste im Unternehmen. Du bekommst Druck von oben (Wachstumsziele) und von unten (ein Team, das sich erst einspielt). Wir wissen das, wir lassen dich damit nicht allein — aber wir tun auch nicht so, als wäre es bequem.

Aufgaben

Führung

  • Du führst 3–5 Account Manager:innen fachlich und disziplinarisch.
  • Du führst wöchentliche 1:1s nach klarer Struktur (Fortschritt / Probleme / Pläne) und verantwortest die Gesundheit deines Teams.
  • Du entwickelst deine Leute aktiv weiter — Schulungen, Feedback, strukturierte Einarbeitung.

Kunden

  • Du verantwortest Entwicklung und Ergebnis deines eigenen Kundenportfolios (Richtwert 6–8 Accounts, ausschließlich unsere anspruchsvollsten Kunden). Das Tagesgeschäft liegt bei deinen AMs.
  • Du bist geschätzter Ansprechpartner auf der Senior-Entscheiderebene deiner Kunden und platzierst Themen aktiv in Kunden-Calls.
  • Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, entscheidest die Gegenmaßnahmen für dein Team und drehst gefährdete Accounts zurück in Wachstum.

Fachlichkeit & Prozesse

  • Du bist die fachliche Rückfallebene deines Teams — Klaviyo- und CRM-Architektur beherrschst du in der Breite.
  • Du coachst deine AMs fachlich und baust ihre Fähigkeiten auf, statt nur Fragen zu beantworten.
  • Du ownst einen unternehmensweiten Prozess rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden (z. B. Onboarding oder Offboarding).
  • Du stimmst Standards mit den anderen Key Account Managern ab und teilst Learnings aktiv.

Qualifikation

  1. Mindestens 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM; davon idealerweise ein Teil in einer Agentur oder im E-Commerce.
  2. Tiefe Praxis in Klaviyo oder einem vergleichbaren System (Braze, Emarsys, Bloomreach, Salesforce Marketing Cloud). Du hast komplexe Set-ups selbst gebaut, nicht nur begleitet.
  3. Erste Führungs- oder Mentoring-Erfahrung— du hast schon einmal Verantwortung für die Arbeit anderer getragen. Das muss nicht disziplinarisch gewesen sein.
  4. Sicherheit im Kundenkontakt auf Entscheiderebene— du hast schon mit Geschäftsführung oder Marketingleitung auf Augenhöhe gesprochen.
  5. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, schriftlich wie mündlich.
  6. Wohnsitz in Deutschland(steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlich zwingend).

Und was wir uns wünschen, aber nicht voraussetzen: Du gibst Feedback direkt und nimmst es genauso an. Du fragst nach dem Warum hinter den Zahlen eines Kunden. Du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand einen Prozess gibt.

Das ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … du Führung als Beförderung siehst und nicht als eigenes Handwerk, das man lernen muss.
  • … du Dinge lieber selbst machst, als sie abzugeben und jemanden dabei besser zu machen.
  • … du eine fertige Struktur erwartest. Wir bauen sie gerade — mit dir.
  • … du unangenehme Gespräche aufschiebst. Ein Teil dieser Rolle besteht daraus.
  • … du im Homeoffice Struktur von außen brauchst. Wir arbeiten vollständig remote.

Benefits

  • Ein Team, das dir gehört — und die Freiheit, es zu formen.
  • Klarheit über deinen eigenen Weg: Wir haben eine ausformulierte Level-Matrix. Du siehst schwarz auf weiß, was auf deinem Level erwartet wird und was der nächste Schritt ist.
  • Halbjährliche Entwicklungsgespräche mit echtem Feedback statt Formularen. Gehalt wird bei uns nach System vergeben, nicht nach Verhandlungsgeschick.
  • Führungskräfte-Ausbildung mit einem externen Coach, der Führungsteams bei Meta und in mehreren Scale-ups aufgebaut hat.
  • 100 % remote, überall in Deutschland — plus regelmäßige Team-Offsites und Workations.
  • MacBook, bei Bedarf zusätzliche Hardware.
  • 50 € monatliche Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit.

Sechs Sätze, an denen wir uns messen lassen — auch als Führungskraft:

Be confident.

We don't need all the answers to start, just the grit to find them first.

Be curious.

Let's be obsessed to find the ‚Why‘ to unlock the ‚How‘.

Keep growing.

Treat yourself like brilliant software: ship a new upgrade every month.

Be accountable.

Openness over cosiness. We own our words.

Act entrepreneurial.

Don't just do tasks: own real business impact.

Over-deliver where it matters.

Promise what's possible. Then challenge these boundaries.

jobs.excerpt: Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys.
jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

The Business Planning team is responsible for maximizing the commercial potential of Contentsquare’s product portfolio. The team develops and evolves the company’s business models, pricing, packaging, licensing, and commercial frameworks across products, segments, industries, geographies, and channels.

As a Business Planning Analyst, you will bring analytical rigor and operational discipline to the team’s pricing and packaging work at every stage of the business model lifecycle. This includes:

  • Providing data and market-driven insights and analysis to support business model creation.

  • Translating business requirements to program and engineering teams to facilitate the operationalization of business models in our systems.

  • Supporting sales teams with tools and resources.

  • Building and supporting a data-driven feedback loop that measures business model performance and informs where pricing or packaging changes may support revenue growth.

What you’ll do

  • Support business model creation. Deliver insights based on data and market analysis in support of the business model design and decision making process.

  • Analyze commercial performance. Evaluate commercial metrics (revenue, ARR, churn, pipeline) to spot trends and optimize pricing and packaging via clear executive models and recommendations.

  • Link product usage to revenue. Merge product usage data with commercial metrics to understand retention and value. Partner with Product and Analytics to define key performance drivers.

  • Executive Communication. Maintain dashboards tracking pricing efficacy and lead quarterly business reviews with data-driven leadership summaries.

  • Track competitive market dynamics. Monitor competitor models, pricing, and packaging to sharpen Contentsquare’s market position and commercial strategy.

  • Operationalize business models. Translate pricing decisions into requirements for CPQ, Product, and RevOps, managing SKUs, quoting workflows, and UAT for seamless execution.

  • Enable field tools and resources. Maintain pricing calculators, guides, and an AI support agent to empower field teams, refining assets using ongoing feedback.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Experience: 3+ years in business analysis, commercial analytics, product analytics, strategy, revenue operations, or finance.

  • Analytics Proficiency: Strong hands-on SQL skills, advanced spreadsheet modeling, and proficiency with BI/data visualization tools.

  • Business Insights: Ability to analyze complex commercial metrics, connect data-driven insights to business strategy, and provide practical growth recommendations.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Skilled in cross-functional partnership, managing ambiguity, AI tool fluency, and presenting technical findings to senior stakeholders.

    • Nice to have

  • SaaS & Commercial Strategy: Experience with SaaS pricing, packaging, licensing, monetization, or business model strategy.

  • Systems & Operations: familiarity with Salesforce, CPQ, DealHub, and operationalizing pricing or packaging changes in business systems.

  • Data & Analytics: Experience with product telemetry, usage data, competitive intelligence, and building dashboards or recurring performance reporting.

  • Relevant Background: Experience in strategy consulting, product management, revenue operations, finance, or a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Why you should join Contentsquare

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
Here are a few we want to highlight:
- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

*We are looking for individuals to support the East Coast*

The Regional Branch Administrative Manager will be responsible for leading employee affiliation branch office support staff.
