jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Senior Accountant

Location: Work From Home - California

Division: Ticketmaster North America

Line Manager: Senior Manager, Accounting

Contract Terms: Permanent, 40 Hours per week (full-time)

THE TEAM

The Ticketmaster North America Accounting team is responsible for preparing accounting entries, reconciling general ledger accounts, and supporting balance sheet reporting for Live Nation’s financial reporting process. The team also plays a key role in coordinating and supporting internal and external audits across the division, ensuring compliance and accuracy in all financial activities.

THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior Accountant to support month-end close activities, including journal entry preparation and reconciliation of assigned general ledger accounts across multiple Ticketmaster business lines. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, motivated self-starter with strong Excel skills and a passion for accuracy and continuous improvement.

This is an exciting time to join Ticketmaster as we continue to evolve and innovate within the live entertainment space. As part of a global leader in ticketing and live event experiences, you’ll gain exposure to complex accounting processes while contributing to a fast-paced, high-impact finance team.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Prepare and record month-end journal entries to support accurate and timely financial close.
  • Reconcile assigned general ledger accounts monthly to ensure SOX compliance and financial accuracy.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items by partnering with internal stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Maintain schedules supporting ticketing revenue deferral to ensure accurate revenue recognition.
  • Prepare reports and journal entries related to ticket sales and revenue recognition processes.
  • Maintain amortization and accrual schedules to support financial reporting requirements.
  • Prepare accruals for fulfillment-related activities to ensure completeness of financial records.
  • Support internal and external audits, including quarterly and annual SOX, financial, and sales tax audits.
  • Assist in preparing ad hoc financial analyses and schedules for internal management reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve accounting processes and ensure data integrity.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Ticketmaster strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

jobs.description:
About Parsec

Parsec Automation, LLC (Parsec) is a trailblazing creator and provider of manufacturing operations management software. Consistently recognized by organizations like Gartner and IDC and a winner of numerous awards, including the Data Breakthrough Awards, American Business, and Best in Biz, Parsec exemplifies leadership in the dynamic, fast-paced manufacturing sector. With major companies such as Johnson & Johnson, Merck, Toyota, Proctor & Gamble, Eli Lilly, Hershey, Siemens, and DuPont leveraging its innovative TrakSYS™ platform to tackle even the most complex manufacturing challenges, Parsec’s solutions are actively optimizing efficiency, quality, and compliance at over 11,000 plants in more than 140 countries. Committed to customer success and driven by innovation, Parsec continues to fulfill its mission of making the management of manufacturing operations as simple as possible.

Parsec is backed by BVP Forge, a $780M fund in partnership with the $20B Bessemer platform that has backed industry-defining businesses such as LinkedIn, MindBody, Procore, Shopify, and Toast. BVP Forge combines Bessemer’s front-line industry insights, proven growth IP, and robust executive network with tailored resources for self-sustaining companies and the ForgeEdge™ operational program.

The Role

Parsec is hiring a Senior Director, Technical Services to unify and scale the technical backbone of its Professional Services organization. This role owns three distinct but interdependent workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support. Each currently operates with its own rhythm, skill set, and client touchpoints. The mandate for this role is to bring these workstreams together under one operating model so that clients, SI partners, and internal teams experience a consistent standard of technical excellence, regardless of which workstream is engaged.

This is a build-and-run role. The teams exist today; the person in this seat will professionalize how they operate, scale them as the business grows, and ensure new hires ramp to full productivity on a defined timeline. Success is measured by predictable delivery, fewer escalations, improved resource utilization across workstreams, and a technical organization that partners with Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners as a single, credible voice on TrakSYS.

Role Characteristics

  • Organizational Span: Owns three workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support, all spanning approximately 30–40 FTEs based primarily in the US and Spain, with additional coverage across Europe.
  • Delivery Accountability: Accountable for delivery outcomes across all three workstreams, including quality, timeliness, and client/partner satisfaction.
  • Governance & Control: Establishes shared standards, handoff protocols, and reporting cadence across workstreams (capacity planning, utilization, backlog health, escalation tracking).
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serves as the primary point of contact for workstream health, capacity, and delivery status communications to PS leadership.
  • Collaboration: Works closely with Project Managers (who retain ownership of individual engagements), Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners.
  • Scaling: Builds hiring plans, role profiles, interview standards, and leveling criteria to support growth across all three workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

- Advisory Workstream

  • Own the quality bar for design artifacts produced by Solution Architects and Tech Leads, ensuring consistency across SI partner-led and Parsec-led engagements.
  • Deploy Advisory resources across concurrent engagements, balancing SI support requests against direct delivery needs.
  • Build and maintain design standards, reference architectures, and reusable artifacts that reduce rework across engagements.
  • Serve as the escalation point for design decisions that carry architectural or precedent-setting weight.\

- Delivery Workstream

  • Manage the engineering resource pool as a shared capacity model: intake, prioritization, staffing, and rebalancing across concurrent projects.
  • Partner with assigned Project Managers on scope, timelines, and quality gates without owning the PM function.
  • Set and enforce engineering and QA standards across POC, enhancement, and targeted delivery work.
  • Track velocity and throughput to inform capacity planning and hiring timing.

- Support Workstream

  • Own support SLAs, coverage models, and on-call structures across a 24/7, multi-region team.
  • Ensure upgrade assessments, upgrades, and technical reviews follow a consistent methodology and artifact set.
  • Develop a repeatable mentoring and knowledge-transfer offering for clients and SI partners.
  • Feed recurring support themes and technical debt patterns back into Advisory and Engineering to address root causes.

- Cross-Workstream Responsibilities

  • Establish shared standards and communication norms so clients and SI partners receive a consistent experience across Advisory, Delivery, and Support.
  • Build the metrics, reporting cadence, and operating rhythm that make delivery predictable and visible to leadership (dashboard support provided by the Operations team).
  • Partner with Enablement to define ramp paths and curricula for new hires and ongoing development paths for tenured staff.
  • Report on workstream health, capacity, and delivery metrics to PS leadership, and translate technical delivery performance into terms an executive audience can act on.

- Success Measures

  • Advisory, Delivery, and Support operate against shared standards and a shared reporting model.
  • New hires reach full productivity on a defined, predictable timeline, in partnership with Enablement.
  • Delivery predictability improves, reflected in fewer escalations, tighter SLA adherence, and more accurate capacity forecasting.
  • Clients and partners experience a consistent technical governance model across all three workstreams.
  • Leadership has real-time visibility into workstream health, capacity, and risk.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in technical delivery, professional services, or engineering leadership within enterprise software, industrial software, or MES/manufacturing operations platforms.
  • Multi-Function Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical functions concurrently (e.g., solution architecture/advisory, engineering delivery, and technical support) as a unified organization.
  • Distributed Teams: Experience managing distributed, international teams; direct experience with US/Europe (Spain in particular) team structures is a strong plus.
  • Scaling: Track record of building or scaling a technical delivery function during a growth phase, including hiring plans and ramp/enablement design.
  • Operational Skills: Strong operational instincts in capacity planning, utilization management, SLA and escalation frameworks, and delivery metrics.
  • Range: Comfortable operating at both the strategic level (org design, executive reporting) and the technical level (credible in design and architecture conversations).
  • Partner Ecosystem: Experience working with or alongside System Integrator (SI) and Global SI (GSI) partner ecosystems.
  • Platform Experience: Direct experience with MES, MOM, or industrial automation platforms (TrakSYS or comparable platforms) preferred.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a growing global software company

Location

An overview of this role

As the Senior Renewal Operations at GitLab, you will own the operational engine behind our renewals motion. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Sales & CX Operations, you will be the person the business turns to on anything that touches renewal timing, renewal forecasting, subscription data, or the mechanics of getting a renewal quoted and closed. You will partner closely with Renewals and Customer Success leadership, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Technology to make the renewal motion predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will lead through depth of ownership and influence rather than through direct reports, setting the standard in your domain and driving work that others across the revenue organization depend on.

This is a role for a sharp, curious operator who thrives in ambiguity, connects dots across teams, and moves quickly from problem to solution. You will work in an all-remote, values-driven environment where documentation, iteration, and cross-functional partnership are core to how we work.

What you'll do

  • Own the renewal forecast and the operating cadence around it, including forecast methodology, accuracy tracking, and the reviews that leadership relies on.
  • Run the operational rhythm of the renewal business
  • Safeguard the integrity of renewal and subscription data so that retention reporting is trusted across Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.
  • Define and maintain retention reporting, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into clear problem statements, then drive them to resolution through process, reporting, or systems changes.
  • Partner with Revenue Technology and Revenue Analytics to evolve the systems, data, and reporting that carry the renewal motion, writing the requirements and validating what gets built.
  • Support planning cycles for the renewals organization, including segmentation, coverage models, capacity modeling, and target setting.
  • Build cross-functional alignment with Sales, Finance, and other Revenue Strategy & Operations teams to operationalize go-to-market changes that affect renewals.
  • Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting the process, mentoring others on how the motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives where the renewals perspective is needed.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Renewals Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role.

  • Strong critical thinking and structured problem solving. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear workstreams and move them forward.
  • Strong quantitative and data analysis skills. You are highly proficient in Excel or Sheets and comfortable building a model from scratch and validating your own numbers. SQL is a plus.
  • Systems thinking. You understand how a change in one part of the go-to-market motion ripples through to others, including how the CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.
  • Fluency in the sales process and the customer journey, with a clear view of where renewals sit within it.
  • Bias toward execution. You move from analysis to action quickly and follow through to outcomes that stick.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You build trust with stakeholders at all levels, including field teams and senior leadership, and influence without direct authority.
  • Curiosity and aptitude to pick up new domains, tools, and concepts quickly. We care more about how you think than which specific tools you have used.
  • Comfort operating in a scaling environment where not everything is defined and structure must be created.

The Sales and CX Operations team sits within the Revenue Operations function at GitLab and is responsible for the processes, data standards, and operational programs that enable our Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals teams to operate at scale.

U.S. businesses spend over $100 billion annually on food for employees and customers. We’re seeking an experienced, dynamic and results-driven Strategic Partnerships Sales Executive to join our high-performing sales team and play a key role in expanding our enterprise-level customer base.

As a Senior Strategic Partnerships Sales Executive, you will be responsible for driving the sales of our solutions through high-level strategic partnerships with large enterprises. You will engage with C-suite executives and other key decision-makers to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities that align with the company's growth objectives. Your role will require deep expertise in complex enterprise-level selling, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to nurture long-term relationships that lead to mutually beneficial partnerships.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will:

  • Identify and Prospect Strategic Partners: Identify, prospect, and engage high-value, enterprise-level organizations to create long-term partnerships and opportunities for collaboration.
  • Build and Maintain Relationships: Cultivate strong relationships with senior executives and decision-makers (C-suite, VP-level, etc.) within target organizations, in addition to internal Doordash Executives to support business initiatives and long term team growth.

  • Close Complex Deals: Lead the sales process from initial outreach through to negotiation and closure. Confidently prepare for and execute regular Client business reviews
  • Drive Account Expansion: Identify opportunities within key accounts to unlock incremental revenue opportunities through expanding relationships across regions and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with internal stakeholders (sales, marketing, product, legal) to drive alignment on customer needs and partnership proposals.
  • Develop Partnership Strategies: Collaborate with leadership to design go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and business development initiatives.
  • Manage Sales Pipeline: Maintain accurate forecasts, sales activity, and pipeline management using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.).
  • Stay Updated on Industry Trends: Stay on top of market trends, competitive landscape, and new technologies to identify new business opportunities and maintain a competitive edge.
  • Meet Sales Targets: Achieve or exceed sales quotas and KPIs for enterprise partnerships.

We’re excited about you because you have:

  • You use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar platforms to improve prospecting, account research, outreach preparation, and overall sales productivity.
  • You are comfortable applying AI tools in your day-to-day work to surface customer insights, strengthen decision-making, solve problems faster, and operate more efficiently across the full sales cycle.
  • Experience: 9+ years of enterprise sales experience, with a proven track record of success in selling technology solutions to large enterprises.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. Job Summary

Regional Clinical Faculty (RCF) advise, support, educate, and evaluate students. The RCF supports and collaborates with clinical preceptors in keeping with the policies established by the University to ensure an effective clinical experience for students. The RCF provides leadership in establishing relationships within the nurse-midwifery/ nurse-practitioner community to further the goal of increasing and maintaining access to clinical sites for Frontier Nursing University (FNU) and to ensure the larger goal of increasing access to nurse-midwifery/nurse-practitioner care.The RCF participates in the ongoing development, implementation, and evaluation of the curriculum in their area of advanced practice nursing.

Major Tasks, Duties, and Responsibilities

University Related

  • Promotes the mission and philosophy of FNU.

  • Attends University, department, RCF, and faculty meetings

  • Participates in the annual Fall Faculty Meeting and Commencement as stipulated in their current FNU contract

  • Participates in Clinical and/or Frontier Boundas stipulated in their current FNU contract

  • Effectively collaborates with all departments at FNU to ensure student success and site/ preceptor satisfaction.

  • Provide service to the University through activities such as involvement in FNU shared governance (e.g., committees, workgroups), FNU sponsored activities (e.g., charity drives, community outreach activities), and/or service to the profession (e.g., presentations, professional organization committee work).

  • Adhere to the elements of the Culture of Caring

  • Other duties as assigned.

Course Related

  • Orients students to course expectations.

  • Documents student progress in course work and clinical setting at least every term via the university student retention system ( i.e., Dropout Detective).

  • Maintains currency in areas of expertise through clinical practice, literature review, participation in continuing education programs, etc.

  • Assigns grades and maintains course grade book and student records, meeting timeline requirements for grade submission.

Service

  • Participates in course teams

  • Participates in standing and/or ad hoc committees of FNU

  • Participates in professional organizations; acts as a representative of FNU in furthering nurse-midwifery and/or nurse practitioner education and/or practice.

  • Participates in the mentorship of other faculty members.

  • Provides service to the home community.

Student Involvement – Preclinical period

  • Communicates effectively with students, demonstrating respect and professionalism.

  • Respond to student-initiated contact after Frontier Bound to discuss the role of RCF and general plans for clinical practicum.

  • Works collaboratively with the Clinical Outreach and Placement Unit to support students in the clinical site identification process.

  • Conducts Question & Answer sessions to support students’ clinical plan development.

  • Reviews and approves the student’s Clinical Plan approximately four to six months prior to Clinical Bound and as needed.

  • Works collaboratively with the Clinical Credentialing Department to ensure the clinical site and preceptor quality assurance measures are maintained.

  • Conducts a pre-clinical orientation session prior to the Clinical Bound term to review the clinical course requirements, policies, and processes.

Student Involvement - Clinical period

  • Creates a social, cognitive, and teaching presence during courses through twice-monthly meetings with assigned students.

  • Maintains accessibility to students enrolled in the course through email, forums, phone calls, and other means of communication as outlined in the Faculty Handbook.

  • Reviews and evaluates clinical course assignments, student evaluation tools, and students’ clinical documentation.

  • Completes evaluation of clinical students on-site or virtually.

  • Advises students for course registration for each term following Clinical Bound.

  • Works with students and the Clinical Director to help students maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress.

  • Coordinates and verifies end-of-clinical details.

  • Works with the students and preceptor to identify and find solutions to clinical problems

Clinical Site and Preceptor Evaluation

  • Completes and submits clinical site and preceptor evaluations.

Preceptor Support

  • Provides preceptors with guidance in student interactions.

  • Orients preceptors to FNU clinical policies and processes

  • Provides access to FNU courses and guidebooks for preceptor resources

  • Encourages preceptors to participate in preceptor education and programs related to precepting.

  • Maintains contact with the clinical student’s primary clinical preceptor at least monthly.

Scholarship

  • Participates in scholarly work through publication, grant writing, presentations, Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) project participation, scholarly consultation, and/or other scholarly endeavors.

  • Skilled in communication, problem-solving, computer literacy, management, and organization preferred.

Job Overview

The Senior Medical Director (Hematology/Oncology) is a strategic medical leader who provides scientific, clinical, and operational oversight across global clinical research programs. Acting as Medical Monitor, this role serves as the primary medical interface between IQVIA, sponsors, and investigative sites—ensuring high-quality, compliant, and efficient trial execution.

The role provides hands-on medical oversight, guiding protocol interpretation, eligibility, compliance, and safety, including medical data review and review of critical clinical data (e.g., alert laboratory results) and timely response to urgent medical queries to ensure patient safety and study continuity.

Essential Functions

  • Provides medical and scientific input to clinical research programs including review of new business proposals, preclinical and/or clinical data, study protocols, training materials, informed consent, Investigator Drug Brochures, eCRFs, analysis plan designs, clinical study reports, regulatory approval submissions, serious and non-serious adverse event evaluation and reporting

Clinical Leadership & Study Execution

  • Support site selection, investigator engagement, and patient recruitment/retention strategies
  • Train study teams and investigators on protocol and therapeutic area
  • Develop and oversee medical monitoring plans and serve as the primary medical resource for study teams and sites

Safety & Medical Oversight

  • Ensure medical oversight of patient safety, including ongoing assessment of the study safety profile
  • Review and interpret safety data, including SAEs and critical clinical data, ensuring accuracy and appropriate follow-up
  • Support safety reporting activities and collaborate with sponsors and internal safety teams
  • Manage unblinding procedures when required and contribute to regulatory interactions as needed

Data Review & Reporting

  • Provide medical review of clinical data, including eCRFs, tables, and listings, to ensure accuracy and consistency
  • Contribute to data interpretation and support development of clinical study reports

Business Development & Strategy

  • Support proposal development, feasibility assessments, and client presentations
  • Provide medical expertise to strengthen study design and strategic positioning in new business opportunities

Additional Contributions

  • Support development of internal processes, training, and quality improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to scientific literature review and medical input across projects as needed

Qualifications & Experience

  • MD from an accredited, internationally recognized medical school
  • 5–7+ years of clinical experience as a licensed physician within the relevant specialty (Oncology, Hematology, Surgical Oncology, or Urology with oncologic focus)
  • Board certification or eligibility in the relevant therapeutic area strongly preferred or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience in clinical research (≥3 years) as a study physician/investigator or within Pharma, CRO, or Biotech environments

  • Strong ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary and matrixed global teams, driving alignment and consensus

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

BP6

As our international business continues to expand across Europe and beyond, we are looking for a highly experienced Senior Corporate Counsel, International to help support our growth, navigate complex legal landscapes, and serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders across multiple markets.

Reporting to the Vice President, International Legal, this role will play a critical part in supporting Tandem's continued expansion, including direct market growth internationally , together with our distributor markets.

This remote or home-based position is preferably located in Switzerland. We will also consider candidates based in the United Kingdom, or possibly other European locations who can effectively support Tandem's broader international business.

Our International Legal team partners closely with commercial, marketing, distribution, regulatory, compliance, privacy, HR, and leadership teams across Europe, the Middle East, and other international markets. This is an opportunity to join a growing, highly visible team where your expertise will directly influence business decisions, manage risk, and support sustainable international growth.

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

As Senior Corporate Counsel, International, you will serve as a strategic legal partner supporting a broad range of international commercial and operational matters. You will independently manage complex legal issues while balancing business objectives, patient needs, and regulatory requirements.

  • Draft, review, negotiate, and interpret a wide range of commercial agreements, including distribution, procurement, supplier, sales, marketing, and commercial partnership contracts.

  • Partner with sales, marketing, distribution, and senior business leaders to provide concise, practical, and risk-based legal advice that enables commercial growth.

  • Support a portfolio of direct and distributor markets across Europe, including Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Benelux, France, Spain, and Portugal, as well as Scandinavia, Central Europe, the Middle East, and additional international territories. Exact territory ownership will reflect the successful candidate's profile.

  • Advise on commercial, regulatory, product, contractual, privacy, compliance, and operational matters affecting international markets.

  • Support public procurement and tender opportunities, including NHS and European healthcare purchasing processes, by reviewing contractual terms, assessing risk, and advising commercial leaders on practical implications.

  • Collaborate with US-based legal specialists in regulatory and product law, compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property, employment law, and other specialist areas.

  • Support HR on complex employment and labor-law matters, particularly during workforce expansion into new countries, and manage external counsel where specialist advice is required.

  • Monitor evolving developments in medical device regulation, healthcare reimbursement, digital health, artificial intelligence, data privacy, and related international legal frameworks.

  • Contribute to legal process improvements, training, knowledge sharing, and horizon-scanning initiatives that prepare the business for future legal, regulatory, and compliance risks.

  • Operate independently, prioritize a diverse workload, and help stakeholders distinguish material risks from manageable issues while identifying workable business solutions.

EXTRA AWESOME:

We are excited to meet candidates who bring:

  • A law degree and qualification as a lawyer, solicitor, barrister, or equivalent legal professional in England and Wales, Switzerland, Germany, or another major European jurisdiction.

  • 12+ years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 5 years in an in-house commercial legal role.

  • Significant experience in medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare technology, life sciences, or a closely related regulated industry. Candidates with a pharmaceutical background should also bring relevant MedTech or diagnostics exposure.

  • Strong commercial contract drafting, negotiation, interpretation, and risk management expertise.

  • Experience advising sales, marketing, distribution, procurement, and senior business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions and cultures.

  • Knowledge of medical device regulation, healthcare reimbursement systems, public procurement and tender processes, data privacy, and emerging digital health regulation.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach, sound judgment, high integrity, and the confidence to operate independently with senior stakeholders.

  • Fluent English and German language. French language skills are beneficial but not essential.

  • Some experience with employment law, contentious matters, intellectual property, or healthcare marketing and promotion would be advantageous.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The opportunity to support a rapidly growing international MedTech business at an exciting stage of expansion.

  • High visibility and direct partnership with senior business and legal leaders.

  • A high-tech environment, excellent working conditions, meaningful autonomy, and stimulating work in an innovative field.

  • Exposure to varied legal challenges spanning commercial, regulatory, compliance, digital health, privacy, employment, procurement, and international market development.

  • The ability to influence strategic business decisions across multiple international markets while working with experienced and motivated teams.

  • A flexible remote or home-based working model. Switzerland is the preferred location, with strong consideration for candidates based the United Kingdom, or other European countries.

  • The chance to support healthcare technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives every day.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome!

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Summary:

Goldschmitt & Associates is seeking an Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect to provide senior architecture leadership across Federal Student Aid's enterprise data environment, Common Data Model, customer-service platforms, integrations, analytics, and downstream data consumers.

The Enterprise Data / CRM Architect will help FSA create a coherent architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, operational, and customer-interaction data is defined, governed, shared, and consumed across enterprise systems.

This role operates above individual pipelines or applications. The architect will define how the Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, APIs, integration services, CRM/customer-care platforms, NSLDS, analytics environments, and other FSA systems work together while maintaining consistent data meaning, ownership, security, lineage, quality, and lifecycle controls.

The Enterprise Data/ CRM Architect must combine strong enterprise data architecture with enough application and integration knowledge to understand how data is created and used across business processes. The architect will work closely with the Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Integration Architect, CDM Platform Engineer, Analytics Engineer, product leadership, and FSA enterprise architecture teams.

FSA's modernization requires a governed enterprise data capability that normalizes heterogeneous servicer data, improves quality and timeliness, and supports analytics, integrations, and future borrower-facing capabilities.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Lead enterprise data architecture across FSA's Common Data Model, Business Needs Layer, CRM/customer-service platforms, servicer integrations, NSLDS, analytics environments, and downstream consumers
  • Define the target-state architecture for how borrower, loan, servicing, customer-interaction, and operational data flows through the enterprise
  • Establish architecture principles for authoritative data sources, canonical data structures, shared definitions, data ownership, and system-of-record responsibilities
  • Define relationships between source-system models, the CDM, semantic/business layers, CRM structures, APIs, analytical models, and downstream applications
  • Guide development and evolution of canonical enterprise data models
  • Define approaches for schema versioning, compatibility, data lifecycle management, and controlled evolution of enterprise data structures
  • Review proposed source-to-CDM mappings and ensure transformations preserve business meaning and support enterprise reuse
  • Partner with the Senior Data Engineer on schema design, conformance rules, validation strategies, and complex source-data decisions
  • Define how customer and borrower information should be represented consistently across CRM, servicing, analytical, and digital-service environments
  • Identify duplicate, conflicting, or overlapping data definitions across platforms and recommend a target enterprise model
  • Establish patterns for data mastered in one system but consumed or enriched in another
  • Define architecture for data synchronization, event-driven data exchange, APIs, data products, and other enterprise access patterns
  • Partner with the Enterprise Integration Architect to ensure interface and integration patterns support the enterprise data model
  • Establish requirements for data contracts between producers and consumers
  • Define architecture standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, cataloging, stewardship, and governance
  • Ensure architecture supports traceability from source through transformation to downstream consumption
  • Define appropriate controls for sensitive borrower and financial information, including access, security, privacy, auditability, and least-privilege use
  • Evaluate the architecture impacts of read-only near-real-time servicer integration and future bi-directional exchange
  • Assess the impact of proposed UBP and customer-service capabilities on enterprise data structures and data services without defining out-of-scope UBP features
  • Identify technical debt, redundant data movement, tightly coupled integrations, and other architecture patterns that limit reuse or product agility
  • Develop architecture decision records, reference architectures, data-flow diagrams, data lifecycle plans, interface patterns, and phased modernization roadmaps
  • Evaluate alternative architectures and clearly document tradeoffs involving cost, complexity, scalability, reliability, security, data quality, and maintainability
  • Support architecture reviews and provide independent technical recommendations to FSA leadership
  • Work with product leaders to ensure data architecture decisions support measurable business and borrower outcomes
  • Work with analytics and HCD teams to ensure enterprise data structures are understandable and useful to business consumers
  • Help establish an architecture that allows FSA to evolve data products and services without repeatedly rebuilding point-to-point transformations
  • Mentor engineers and architects on enterprise data architecture practices and promote consistent standards across teams and contractors
Necessary Skills and Knowledge:
  • Significant experience designing enterprise data architectures across multiple applications and organizational domains
  • Strong experience with canonical data models, enterprise data models, or Common Data Models
  • Experience designing data integration patterns across transactional systems, APIs, event streams, analytical platforms, and enterprise applications
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, relational and analytical data structures, schema design, metadata, lineage, and data quality
  • Experience defining systems of record, authoritative data sources, data ownership, and enterprise data domains
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integration architecture, event-driven systems, and distributed application environments
  • Experience with enterprise CRM or customer-service platforms and the customer/borrower data models that support them
  • Experience designing data architecture for complex legacy modernization efforts
  • Ability to understand both logical business models and physical implementation constraints
  • Experience developing architecture roadmaps, reference architectures, architecture decision records, and phased migration strategies
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, access control, and audit requirements for sensitive enterprise data
  • Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and explain architecture decisions to both technical and executive audiences
  • Strong collaboration skills across application, integration, data, cloud, security, analytics, product, and business teams
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Possess at least 12 years of experience in enterprise architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, CRM architecture, or related technical roles
  • Possess the ability to pass a 6C Public Trust investigation, including US citizenship
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Federal Government enterprise architecture experience
  • Department of Education or Federal Student Aid experience
  • Financial services, lending, loan servicing, or other highly regulated transactional data experience
  • Experience with borrower, customer, account, transaction, or servicing data models
  • Experience with Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM, or another large enterprise CRM/customer-service platform
  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or comparable modern data-platform technologies
  • Experience with cloud-based enterprise data architecture
  • Experience with REST APIs, event streaming, API gateways, and data contracts
  • Experience implementing master/reference data management or enterprise data-governance capabilities
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, FISMA, FedRAMP, and federal privacy/security requirements
  • Experience supporting enterprise analytics, semantic layers, data catalogs, and governed self-service data environments

It is intended to describe the general nature and work responsibilities of the position. This job description and the duties of this position are subject to change, modification and addition as deemed necessary by the Company.

Inside Account Manager, Academic and Government

Are you passionate about building strong customer relationships and helping academic and government institutions achieve their research, teaching, and learning goals?

Do you enjoy consultative selling, uncovering customer needs, and delivering solutions that create meaningful impact?

About the Role

As an Inside Account Manager, you will manage a portfolio of academic and government customers, serving as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle. You will be responsible for driving customer engagement, subscription renewals, adoption of Elsevier solutions, and strategic growth opportunities across a defined territory.

Working collaboratively with field account managers, product specialists, customer consultants, and internal business partners, you will develop long-term relationships with library leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and government stakeholders to support their research, teaching, and learning objectives while contributing to Elsevier's business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of academic and government accounts, building long-term relationships with customers and serving as their primary inside sales contact.

  • Drive customer retention by managing subscription renewals, identifying risks, and developing strategies that maximize customer value and long-term partnerships.

  • Conduct proactive customer outreach through phone, email, virtual meetings, and digital engagement to strengthen relationships, increase product adoption, and uncover expansion opportunities.

  • Understand institutional priorities, research initiatives, funding environments, and collection development needs to recommend solutions aligned with customer objectives.

  • Identify opportunities to expand Elsevier's portfolio, including journal subscriptions, eBooks, databases, research intelligence solutions, AI-enabled products, and workflow tools.

  • Develop pricing proposals, renewal strategies, and business cases while negotiating within established pricing and commercial guidelines.

  • Manage the complete sales process from opportunity identification through forecasting, proposal development, contract execution, and post-sale follow-up.

  • Partner closely with Field Account Managers to execute strategic account plans and coordinate customer engagement across complex accounts.

  • Collaborate with Product Specialists, Customer Consultants, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

  • Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity pipelines, forecasts, and customer activity within Salesforce and other CRM systems.

  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, higher education funding, and government research priorities to identify new growth opportunities.

  • Meet or exceed assigned renewal, revenue, and growth objectives while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in account management, inside sales, customer success, or consultative B2B sales.

  • Experience working with academic institutions, libraries, government agencies, research organizations, or other knowledge-based customers is preferred.

  • Strong consultative selling, relationship management, and customer engagement skills.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with librarians, faculty, researchers, procurement professionals, and institutional leaders.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer relationships and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms to manage pipelines, forecasts, and customer engagement.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer usage, trends, and business needs to develop strategic recommendations.

  • Proven ability to negotiate and manage subscription renewals while identifying opportunities for revenue growth.

  • Highly collaborative with the ability to work across cross-functional teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

Kyverna is seeking Medical Science Liaison (MSL)/Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to join the Medical Affairs organization. The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert supporting external engagement with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) focused on autoimmune diseases and cell therapy.

The ideal candidate will bring strong scientific expertise, exceptional relationship-building skills, and experience supporting complex specialty therapies within biotechnology or pharmaceutical environments.     • Act as a primary scientific liaison to investigators interested in clinical research collaborations and investigator‑initiated research discussions, in alignment with company policies.

        • Contribute to efforts aimed at enhancing trial feasibility and enrollment through appropriate scientific engagement with investigators and treatment centers.

About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

The Role:

We are seeking a Lead Salesforce Architect to own both the architecture of our Salesforce platform and the team that builds on it. Salesforce is the system of record for how Datacor sells, services, and renews across a growing portfolio of business units. You will set the architectural direction, define the standards, and make the design decisions that ensure the platform scales with the business and doesn’t constrain.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the VP of IT & CISO. You will lead a team of internal administrators and external partners, growing the internal team as the platform does. This role will partner with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance, and Operations to translate business strategy into a platform roadmap and holding the teams accountable for delivering it. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable defending an architectural decision to an executive audience and reviewing a colleague’s solution design before it ships.

Our platform includes Salesforce CPQ running subscription pricing for enterprise SaaS, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud portals for customers and partners, Agentforce, and a significant body of custom development.

Strategic and Architectural Leadership:

  • Own the architecture and delivery of the migration to Revenue Cloud, including target-state revenue process design, product and pricing model, data migration, and a phasing plan that does not disrupt the business mid-quarter.
  • Own the multi-year Salesforce platform roadmap, aligning platform investment to business outcomes and sequencing work against company strategy.
  • Make and defend build-versus-buy and build-versus-configure recommendations, including the evaluation and selection of AppExchange solutions and implementation partners.
  • Own the integrations and data architecture connecting upstream/downstream systems, including integration patterns, middleware strategy, master data management, and data governance.
  • Lead the architectural onboarding of acquisitions and new business units onto the platform, assessing the acquired environment, defining the target state, and planning the migration, consolidation, and data conversion.
  • Establish and enforce architectural standards, design patterns, and a governance model that keeps decisions consistent as the number of stakeholders grows.
  • Serve as the design authority for significant changes, reviewing solution designs before build and maintaining an explicit, prioritized technical debt backlog.
  • Own the release and DevOps strategy, including source control, environment and sandbox management, and the deployment pipelines.
  • Translate the Salesforce roadmap – new releases, retiring features, and licensing model changes into a plan for the business, and advise leadership on the cost, risk, and opportunity in each.
  • Partner closely with Information Security on platform security architecture, access model design, and audit and compliance requirements.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead, develop, and retain a team of administrators, and make the case for the additional capacity the platform needs as the business grows.
  • Manage the team directly, including regular one-on-ones, goal setting, performance reviews, and individual career development plans.
  • Accountable for reliable operation of the platform: production incidents, integration failure triage, scheduled job and Flow error monitoring, and the lifecycle of certificates, credentials, and Connected Apps.
  • Set the team’s ways of working: intake, prioritization, estimation, documentation, peer review, and definition of done.
  • Own capacity planning and prioritization, negotiating scope and sequencing with stakeholders across departments and making the trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor the team on Salesforce architecture and craft, raising the technical bar through design review and pairing rather than by absorbing the work yourself.
  • Manage relationships with implementation partners, contractors, and Salesforce account and support teams, holding external delivery to the same standards as internal work.
  • Represent the Salesforce team to executive stakeholders, communicating roadmap, progress, risk, and resourcing needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Mathematics, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience on the Salesforce platform, including time in an architecture or lead solution design capacity.
  • Minimum of 2 years of leading a team, managing direct reports, or similar.
  • Experience integrating acquired companies or new business units onto an existing Salesforce instance.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ internals (amendment and renewal logic, subscription pricing, the quote-to-order data model) and with Revenue Cloud (RLM / Revenue Cloud Advanced).
  • Proven experience architecting and administering complex Salesforce environments with multiple integrations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from end user to executive.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials, or demonstrable progress toward them.
  • Experience leading a migration or replatform of an existing quoting, pricing, or revenue system.

jobs.excerpt: About Riot Platforms Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

The Director, Compliance owns the engine that keeps Riot audit-ready year-round: the controls framework, the testing program, the issues and remediation lifecycle, and the GRC platform that ties all of it together. Compliance designs the controls that prove that policies are working — and builds the automation infrastructure that makes proving it sustainable at scale.

This pillar is intentionally scoped to execute, not to govern or audit. Compliance owns the unified control library — design, mapping to ISO 27001 Annex A, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, NIST CSF, and SOX ITGC — along with owner assignment and testing cadences. Compliance owns the testing program across design adequacy and operating effectiveness. Compliance owns the issues and remediation lifecycle. And Compliance owns the GRC platform: selection, implementation, configuration, integrations, and ongoing administration.

You will report to the Senior Director, GRC and partner directly with IT and Security Engineering as the primary technical counterparts for control evidence, cloud configuration reviews, and platform integrations. In critical operations, you will work with mining site and data center teams to ensure operational controls — physical access, environmental monitoring, asset management — are designed, tested, and evidenced to the same standard as enterprise IT controls.

This role has one non-negotiable: you must be an operator, not just a strategist. In Year 1 you will personally administer the GRC platform, configure the control library, build integrations, and drive the automation that eliminates manual audit prep.

What you'll do

  • Design and build the Riot unified controls framework: map the control universe to ISO 27001 Annex A, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, NIST CSF, and SOX ITGC; assign control owners; define testing frequencies; and rationalize overlapping framework requirements into a single, audit-efficient control set.
  • Own the ISO 27001:2022 controls implementation track — designing, implementing, and evidencing all Annex A controls required for certification, on a schedule with no buffer.
  • Execute the control testing program across all in-scope frameworks: design adequacy and operating effectiveness testing, evidence documentation to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audit-quality standards, and a continuous testing calendar that eliminates point-in-time audit scrambles.
  • Lead GRC platform selection, implementation, and administration: evaluate vendors (ServiceNow GRC, Vanta, Drata, Hyperproof, OneTrust, or equivalent), build the business case, drive implementation to production, and own the platform as the system of record for all GRC controls, risks, and evidence.
  • Build and operate the issues and remediation lifecycle: intake all control failures and audit findings from across all pillars, assign ownership, track remediation progress, validate closure, and feed status into the POA&M program in coordination with the Director, Risk Management.
  • Drive compliance automation: identify manual, spreadsheet-based workflows and replace them with automated evidence collection, integrated dashboards, and real-time controls monitoring — integrating the GRC platform with Asana, identity providers, AWS/Azure, and operational source systems.
  • Engage mining site and data center teams to design, implement, test, and evidence operational controls (physical access, environmental monitoring, change management, asset management) to the same standard as enterprise IT controls.

What you'll bring

  • 8–12+ years of progressive GRC, IT audit, controls design, or compliance program experience, with hands-on GRC platform administration (required — not observer-level familiarity).
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification — required. The Director, Compliance owns the controls framework that underpins ISO 27001:2022 certification. A lead-level credential is the baseline, not a preference.
  • Demonstrated experience designing a controls framework mapped simultaneously to multiple standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOX ITGC) and rationalized to a unified, audit-efficient control set.
  • Direct experience executing control testing programs: design adequacy and operating effectiveness testing, evidence documentation to audit-quality standards, and reporting testing results to senior leadership.
  • Proven GRC platform experience as a power user or administrator — control library configuration, evidence mapping, workflow design, and integration with source systems (Asana, identity providers, AWS/Azure).
  • Strong automation and integration mindset: experience building automated evidence pipelines, dashboard reporting, or integrations between GRC platforms and operational systems.
  • Experience managing an issues and remediation lifecycle (POA&M): tracking, owner accountability, escalation, and closure validation across cross-functional control owners.
  • Technical fluency: comfortable evaluating AWS and Azure security configurations as control evidence; familiarity with API-based GRC integrations; light scripting (Python, SQL) or AI-assisted automation is a strong plus.
  • Preferred: CISA certification; experience in critical infrastructure, data center, or digital asset environments; experience with SOC 2 evidence preparation and auditor walkthrough facilitation.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Base range (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Objetivo do cargo

O(a) Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado será responsável por transformar dados internos e externos em inteligência estratégica para apoiar decisões comerciais e de negócio.

Atuará na identificação de tendências, oportunidades e riscos de mercado, combinando informações de mercado, concorrência, clientes, canais, categorias e performance interna, com o objetivo de orientar decisões de crescimento, priorização de oportunidades e estratégia de Go-to-Market.

Será referência técnica em Inteligência de Mercado, sendo responsável por desenvolver análises de maior complexidade, estruturar metodologias e traduzir informações em recomendações acionáveis para a liderança e áreas comerciais.

Principais responsabilidades Inteligência de Mercado e Concorrência

  • Monitorar continuamente o mercado, identificando tendências, mudanças de comportamento, oportunidades e riscos para o negócio.

  • Desenvolver análises de Wallet Share, Market Share e potencial de mercado.

jobs.excerpt: Scope of Work• Review DGE's existing "TranslationHub" inventory (user type, feature, category, description) and the comprehensive Figma user-journey document, and use them as the source material for course scoping.
jobs.description:
Scope of Work

  • Review DGE's existing "TranslationHub" inventory (user type, feature, category, description) and the comprehensive Figma user-journey document, and use them as the source material for course scoping.
  • Break down features and processes into course modules, grouped by workflow ("flow") and by persona, using logical/module-based grouping rather than a strict feature-by-feature structure.
  • Design and build storyboards for each course (in Figma or PowerPoint, per DGE's internal decision).
  • Develop each course as an interactive Articulate course, including:
    • An introduction/welcome segment
    • A conversational Q&A segment that sets the baseline objective
    • A guided, step-by-step process simulation
    • A graded assessment
  • Write the two-person conversational scripts used for each course's intro/Q&A segment for AI voiceover generation.
  • Build guided, click-through process simulations that mimic the live TranslationHub platform screens end to end.
  • Write MCQ-based question banks for each course's assessment.
  • Package finished courses as SCORM-compliant files and hand them over to the CDP platform team for upload. The freelancer/DGE side will not have production upload access.
  • Coordinate with Hashem Adnan Jadan on Arabic localization, terminology alignment, and course QA sign-off.
  • Participate in recurring weekly syncs with the CDP platform team, as well as a technical kickoff/recap call early in the engagement.

Required Skills & Tools

Mandatory

  • Proven, hands-on experience with Articulate (Storyline or equivalent). This is the client's licensed, standard authoring tool, so candidates must already have experience using it.
  • Experience packaging and delivering SCORM-compliant e-learning courses.
  • Instructional design experience for enterprise, process, or system training, particularly software walkthroughs and role-based workflows rather than general knowledge courses.
  • Comfortable designing from a Figma or PowerPoint storyboard and building guided platform simulations (click-through, step-by-step process walkthroughs).
  • Experience designing course assessments, including MCQ question banks, pass thresholds, and section-based question pools.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI voiceover tools (the client's platform team uses ElevenLabs) and writing conversational, two-presenter scripts for voiceover generation.
  • Arabic-language e-learning localization experience, particularly Modern Standard/official Arabic rather than colloquial dialects.
  • Prior experience building courses for a government or public-sector ERP/HR platform, or a similar large-scale enterprise rollout.

About Us

Aptitude 8 is the leading HubSpot solutions consultancy for companies with complex CRM operations, advanced tech stacks, and ambitious growth goals. We design and implement CRM, data, automation, and RevOps solutions that unlock revenue performance and operational excellence. You’ll join a rapidly scaling team of builders and operators who want to experiment, solve hard problems, and deliver outcomes that matter.

At Aptitude 8, you’ll find remote flexibility, 401k, great benefits, meaningful work, growth opportunities, and the chance to shape the future of how companies operate!

About the Role

We’re seeking a performance marketer who can deliver against the strategy and manage the systems behind generating a high-quality pipeline. As our Demand Gen Manager, you’ll lead campaign execution, optimize funnel performance, and use AI to make our systems and reporting smarter and faster as we scale.

This role blends hands-on demand gen work (paid media, email nurtures, webinars) with platform management across HubSpot and all other campaign and funnel reporting. You’ll also build and maintain the AI-enabled infrastructure (think Clay, GTM engineering workflows, and automation) that lets a lean team punch above its weight. You’ll support our Partner, customer, and pipeline marketing initiatives.

A normal day in this role: In the morning, you're reviewing paid ad performance to optimize spend. By noon, you're building a nurture workflow in HubSpot and using Clay to enrich and score inbound leads before they hit Sales. Later, you're prepping a customer campaign to boost G2 reviews and wrapping up an AI-assisted reporting dashboard that surfaces the why behind campaign ROI for the Chief Marketing Officer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across digital, email, and events
  • Manage paid media and conversion optimization
  • Own marketing automation, database health, and lead scoring in HubSpot, layering in AI-enabled enrichment and intent signals where it sharpens targeting
  • Design and build AI-enabled operations workflows (e.g., Clay enrichment, AI-assisted list building, automated lead routing) that cut manual work and speed up execution
  • Own audiences and segmentation
  • Align closely with Sales, and Partnerships to optimize lead handoff and SQL quality
  • Track performance, create AI-assisted dashboards, and analyze campaign ROI, using AI to surface insights faster, not just report numbers

jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.

With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit:

Waabi is leaning into an AI-native strategy — not just in our trucks, but in how we build, ship, and operate every day. Our teams leverage key AI tools to enhance productivity and efficiency, continuously expanding AI integration across our systems and workflows. That's a huge unlock, and it's moving fast. We're looking for someone to make sure it keeps moving fast safely — by establishing the guardrails and collaborating on the implementation of sandboxes and automations that let people adopt AI with confidence instead of second-guessing themselves. You'll join a small, sharp security team and take primary ownership of AI security controls and considerations across the company. If you've got a developer's instincts, a security mindset, and you're genuinely curious about what these tools can and can't be trusted to do, this role is built around you.

You will...

  • Audit how AI tools and MCP integrations are currently used across the company, and map where they touch sensitive systems, data, or credentials for the purpose of defining policy.
  • Design and implement layered guardrails - enterprise-level system prompts, scoped permissions, sandboxing patterns - that constrain AI behavior before it ever reaches a user's request.
  • Maintain an inventory of both MCP servers and AI-to-service connections and their data access controls, with a clear model of what each one can access and why.
  • Partner directly with users across the organization to bake secure-by-default patterns into their AI-assisted workflows so that written policy doesn’t just sit on a shelf.
  • Evaluate new AI tools, plugins, and integration requests, and figure out the secure way to say yes.
  • Continuously test and red-team your own guardrails - assume they'll be pushed on, and find the gaps before someone else does.
  • Document guidance and patterns that a non-security audience can actually follow without needing a security background.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Professional software development experience, with solid fundamentals in how services, APIs, and permissions fit together.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding/productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) in business-critical workflows.
  • Working knowledge of core security concepts — least privilege, sandboxing, trust boundaries, threat modeling basics.
  • Strong communication skills - you work with engineers as a partner.

Bonus:

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-calling/agent-integration frameworks.
  • Exposure to prompt injection, jailbreaking, or other AI/LLM-specific attack techniques.
  • Background in autonomous vehicles, robotics, or other safety-critical systems

This role is responsible for designing, building, and delivering enterprise scale data engineering solutions using the Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric ecosystems. The Solutions Engineer works closely with Solution Engineers, Principal Engineers, Project Managers, and client stakeholders to implement secure, scalable, and compliant data platforms and pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and AI driven use cases.

This role is hands on and delivery focused. Associate Solutions Engineers are expected to execute technical designs, own discrete data engineering workstreams, and contribute directly to successful client outcomes. Initial focus areas include state level public sector and regulated industry projects such as large scale data lakehouse implementations.

This role reflects SHI’s commitment to delivering enterprise-grade data platforms that power analytics, insights, and AI at scale.   • Design, develop, and implement data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and related Azure data services

  • Build and optimize data lakehouse and warehouse solutions in Azure and Microsoft Fabric, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost effectiveness

  • Develop and maintain data models, ETL and ELT processes, and historical data versioning logic to support complex multi source datasets

  • Results Orientation: Can set challenging goals for their team and lead them to achieve these goals, demonstrating a consistent track record of results.
