jobs.excerpt: Ever been the person everyone Slacks who either has the answer, or knows how to track it down?
jobs.description:
Ever been the person everyone Slacks who either has the answer, or knows how to track it down? That’s this job. As a Senior Security Solutions Engineer, you’re the technical brain trust behind Expel’s Customer Success team — the “the buck stops here” expert who makes sure our CSMs, TAMs, and support engineers always have a fast, accurate answer to bring to customers.

When a customer question gets thorny, it lands with you. You untangle it, you document it so it’s answered even faster next time, and you keep the rest of Expel focused on the work only they can do. If you love being deep in security tech and equally love making other people better at their jobs, keep reading.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you broad exposure to the technology, architecture, integrations, and security operations behind an MDR platform
  • Put you close to customers and the technical problems security teams are solving every day
  • Give you the opportunity to become a trusted technical resource across Customer Success, Security, Detection & Response, and Engineering
  • Let you solve complex technical problems while also building documentation and processes that make the entire organization more effective
  • Surround you with curious security practitioners who genuinely enjoy sharing what they know
  • Give you room to mentor others, sharpen your own technical depth, and continuously improve how we support our customers

What you can do for Expel

  • Be the go-to escalation point for CS — responding quickly and accurately to ad-hoc technical questions from CSMs, TAMs, and TSEs so no one’s left waiting.
  • Hop on customer calls when the moment calls for deep technical expertise, backing up the CSM or TAM who owns the relationship.
  • Hunt down knowledge gaps and turn them into great documentation — authoring, reviewing, and continuously sharpening technical and process content.
  • Partner with teams across Security, Detection & Response, and Engineering to pull knowledge into the team and operationalize it.
  • Curate internal and external knowledge repositories and point people to self-service answers when that’s the faster path.
  • Enable other teams — especially CSM, TAM, and Technical Support — so the flood of inbound questions gets smaller over time.
  • Coach and mentor less experienced teammates, and keep clean records of inquiry volume so the team can prioritize what matters.

What you should bring with you

You’ve spent 7+ years in security, at least half of it in a technical, customer-facing role — ideally consultative. You’ve got real depth across three or more security product spaces (EDR, NDR, SIEM, cloud, you name it) and you can reason about the tradeoffs teams make in security operations. Just as important: you’re a genuinely good communicator who can shift from talking shop with a practitioner to briefing a customer’s senior leadership without missing a beat.

You’ll thrive here if you bring:

  • Sharp root-cause analysis and troubleshooting — you diagnose complex technical issues completely and accurately.
  • A firm grasp of the cybersecurity market: the products, the providers, and their real strengths and weaknesses.
  • Fluency in security controls across Windows, Unix/Linux, AWS, GSuite, O365, and network gear.
  • A solid handle on attack vectors, threat tactics, attacker techniques (think ATT&CK), and the attack lifecycle.
  • Strong consultative instincts — active listening, conflict management, negotiation, and knowing when (and how gracefully) to escalate.
  • An intrinsic drive to self-assess and keep getting better.

A bachelor’s degree and/or relevant certifications are a plus, but we care more about what you can do than where you learned it.

The base salary range for this role is between $122,400 USD and $177,500 USD + variable eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $145,000 and $165,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

Our work is essential to helping Nationwide build future capability to serve customer needs. Keeping existing products relevant and marketable and building new products takes research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration. If you enjoy gathering input and information, working independently and on a team and creating innovative solutions for customers, we want to know more about you!

The State Manager creates multi-year state-specific business strategy to drive our Personal Lines Portfolio of products to meet or exceed top and bottom-line performance aligning to enterprise goals and strategy. This position is responsible for driving strategic alignment through the launch and refinement of product offerings (pricing, underwriting appetite and product structure and enhancements) and distribution strategy. This includes developing and implementing plans and processes related to financial planning, rate reviews, market development and communication of state management. Working directly with PL business stakeholders, the State Manager aggressively collaborates in the development, execution and monitoring of operating plans resulting in P&L objectives, including the areas of combined ratio, revenue growth, regulatory management, and legal compliance. The State Manager is responsible for building winning strategies to address complex business issues such as maximizing the opportunity of assigned state markets. Your work will support regional and corporate objectives through ongoing analysis and monitoring of results and communicating results with leadership, distribution and underwriting partners. Keeping existing state strategic direction relevant, competitive, and profitable requires research, critical thinking, practicality and collaboration.

jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $40 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.excerpt: FreedUp is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Founder of a remote-first company building innovative geospatial and open-source software systems.
jobs.description:
FreedUp is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Founder of a remote-first company building innovative geospatial and open-source software systems. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, accountability, and operational clarity — a professional who can turn complex processes into seamless execution without needing heavy hand-holding.

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Executive Assistant to directly support the Founder — helping streamline both business operations and day-to-day logistics so they can stay focused on building and growing the company. Because the team is fully remote and distributed, this EA needs to be comfortable operating async, communicating clearly in writing, and managing priorities independently.

Above all, the Founder is looking for consistency and proactive follow-through. She'd rather have someone who handles a recurring task the same way every time and reports back without being asked, than someone who is occasionally brilliant but unpredictable.

Location: Fully Remote Job Type:
Full-Time Salary: $1,000 - $1,800 per month (based on experience)

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or similar role supporting senior leadership, ideally in a technical or startup environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — with a track record of proactive, consistent communication rather than waiting to be asked for updates.
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable working in digital ecosystems (Slack, Gmail, Google Workspace, CRM/project management tools). Comfortable learning new tools independently and setting up better ways of working with them (e.g., automations), rather than expecting mastery to be handed to you.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization abilities — able to work independently in an async, distributed team.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive information with sound judgment about who should see what, not just tool-level confidentiality.
  • Proactive, self-directed, and thrives in an environment with evolving needs; comfortable operating with minimal oversight.
  • Reliable when it comes to calendar commitments — once something is confirmed, it's honored; changes are communicated and explained rather than simply missed.
  • Comfortable owning deadlines proactively — including spotting dates buried inside documents (like a procurement RFP) rather than waiting for them to be called out.
  • Experience supporting business development, CRM upkeep, or sales pipeline coordination is a plus.
  • Experience coordinating (not necessarily authoring) proposals or bid documents is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of expense reporting, reconciliation, or bookkeeping preferred.
  • Technical Requirements: Reliable high-speed internet and a modern home office setup.

Strong Differentiators (not required, but a plus)

  • Prior experience supporting an executive or leadership team, especially exposure to how executive meeting agendas are structured — useful as the Founder restructures her own this quarter.
  • Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback — willing to flag it if asked to take on too much, or if something was quietly handled solo after being delegated, rather than just executing silently.

Nice to Haves

  • Comfortable navigating dense procurement documents (e.g., project-managing a 100+ page RFP — extracting pricing instructions, page counts, and formatting rules scattered across the document and its amendments).
  • Openness to eventually taking on full email/inbox triage once a high-trust working relationship is established (not expected at launch).
  • Basic comfort with technical writing (e.g., drafting a short passage on a technical topic like an API) — a bonus, not an expectation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Inbox & Communications Management: Maintain Inbox Zero across email and calls/texts. Triage and respond on behalf of the Founder where appropriate, flag priorities, and keep communications moving without letting things fall through the cracks.
  • Calendar Management & Time Protection: Own and optimize the Founder's calendar, protecting focus time, coordinating meeting scheduling, and confirming, preparing, and taking notes for meetings. Once a meeting is confirmed, it's treated as a firm commitment — no missed RSVPs.
  • Business Development Admin & CRM Upkeep: Maintain and update the CRM and BD pipeline, support prospecting of potential clients, and track business development activity end to end.
  • Proposal & Bid Coordination: Coordinate the preparation of proposals and bids (including government bids covering technical and policy topics), managing timelines, formatting, and inputs from relevant contributors — including proactively surfacing deadlines that are buried in the source documents rather than clearly stated.
  • Travel & Event Coordination With Judgment: Plan and manage business travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, and detailed itineraries. Pre-screen the high volume of event/conference invites that come in, flag genuine conflicts (e.g., "you've got three events in two weeks — we think this one, want me to book it?"), and apply the Founder's known personal preferences without needing to ask each time.
  • Expense Reporting & Reconciliation: Handle recurring expense reporting and reconciliation processes, keeping records accurate and organized.
  • Conference Research & Coordination: Research relevant industry conferences and coordinate attendance logistics.
  • Internal Communications & Team Coordination: Serve as a communication link between the Founder and the internal team, keeping updates clear and timely across channels.
  • Personal & Life Admin Support: Manage doctor appointment scheduling and other personal logistics as needed.
  • Reporting: Compile a company scorecard and provide structured, proactive updates on priorities, progress, and deadlines — without being asked.
  • Social Media: Support publishing of social media content as needed.
  • Event Planning (future scope): Support event planning and coordination as this responsibility area develops.

Benefits

  • International experience
  • Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Potential Performance Bonuses
  • PTO
  • HMO after 3 months

jobs.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will design and develop Navy-focused Interactive Multimedia Instruction (IMI) that supports fleet-ready training aligned to NAVEDTRA standards. You will collaborate with highly skilled delivery teams made up of ISDs, Software Engineers, 3D Artists, Graphic Designers, and Technical Leads to analyze, design, develop, test, and deliver Navy training products — and have a great time doing meaningful work that directly supports the warfighter.

Our ideal SME contributes to every phase of the instructional systems design process, validating design decisions with Creative Leadership, the Program Team, and other contributors throughout development. You will ensure accurate implementation of learning objectives, assessments, scenarios, and media elements within Captivate-based IMI, Unity-based simulations, and related digital training solutions.

Our ideal candidate actively participates in weekly design reviews, collaborates with the Creative Operations team, and works closely with engineering and art teams to ensure instructional intent is realized in the final product.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct front-end analysis, including task analysis, gap analysis, learner analysis, and content reviews based on Navy operational requirements.
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards, scripts, branching scenarios, assessments, and IMI design specifications following NAVEDTRA guidelines.
  • Transform complex technical information, manuals into clear, instructionally sound digital learning content.
  • Assist Instructional Designers design, structure, and sequence IMI modules delivered through Captivate, Unity, or other training pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers, Graphic Designers, and 3D Artists to ensure instructional design is accurately implemented in the final product.
  • Develop mockups, flowcharts, and prototypes to communicate instructional concepts to stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment with Navy training standards, course control documents (CCDs), TLO/ELO frameworks, and SCORM/xAPI requirements.
  • Participate in design reviews with Creative Leadership, Program Managers, and Navy customer stakeholders.
  • Evaluate IMI effectiveness and recommend improvements based on learner data, SME feedback, and usability principles.
  • Apply design thinking, questioning techniques, and performance-based instructional strategies where pathways may not be fully defined.
  • Ensure training products meet accessibility, usability, and quality standards during development and testing.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Associate’s Degree. Additional years of relevant experience may substitute for a degree.
  • Understanding of instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, task-based analysis, scenario-based learning).
  • Ability to interpret and apply NAVEDTRA standards and Navy training system requirements.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear instructional strategies.
  • Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to implement instructional content.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense (DOD) Security Clearance.

Preferred Skills (Not Required):

  • Experience developing or supporting Navy or DoD training programs.
  • Experience in the USN serving as a FC, ET, AT, IC, or any other DoD Service Branch/USN Rating with a thorough background in electronics.
  • Familiarity with SCORM, xAPI, and Navy Learning Management Systems.
  • Experience working with software engineers or art teams in multimedia development.
  • Understanding of accessibility standards and user experience principles in digital training.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Captivate, Unity, Storyline, XD, or related design tools.
  • Experience writing or reviewing learning assessments aligned to performance outcomes.
  • Familiarity with TLO/ELO alignment, CCDs, and Navy courseware development processes.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions will require access to U.S. National Security information. Positions that require this access will be required to receive and maintain a U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order to qualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currently possess this National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination and maintain that eligibility throughout their employment. To learn more about the security clearance process please access this link.

EEOC & Know Your Rights

Lyntris companies are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, and local law. We ensure that all employment decisions, including hiring, promotion, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment, are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. For more information about your rights, please review the "Know Your Rights" poster from the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). Know your Rights: EnglishSpanish

Other compensation considerations may include, but are not limited to, job responsibilities, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other applicable factors.

Job Title: Sr. People Operations Specialist
Location: India (Remote)
Shift: 9:30AM - 6:30PM IST
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Sr. People Operations Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for owning key People Operations processes and ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent delivery across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on People Operations experience, is comfortable independently managing complex operational matters, and can identify opportunities to improve processes and employee experience. You are organized, comfortable working with systems and data, and able to collaborate effectively across teams while navigating a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

You will also contribute to improving operational efficiency, adopting automation and AI-enabled solutions, and driving consistent People Operations practices across the team.

What You’ll Be Doing

People Operations

  • Own key employee lifecycle processes including offboarding, role transitions, promotions, transfers, and other internal movements.
  • Manage employee requests and People Operations tickets, independently resolving complex queries and acting as an escalation point for operational issues within assigned areas.
  • Own recurring People Operations activities including leave and attendance management, localized benefits administration, payroll inputs and validations, employee documentation, and employment verification.
  • Support People Operations across India, the US, and EOR populations based on business requirements.
  • Maintain process documentation, SOPs, trackers, and controls to ensure consistent and reliable execution.
  • Own or contribute to People Operations projects and initiatives based on business priorities.

Process Improvement, Automation and Collaboration

  • Review operational data, SLA trends, recurring issues, and process gaps to identify and drive opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve People Operations processes and workflows to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
  • Partner with People Technology on HR system enhancements, integrations, testing, workflow changes, and automation initiatives.
  • Leverage AI and other technology solutions to streamline routine activities and improve operational efficiency while ensuring appropriate handling of employee and confidential data.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Payroll, Finance, IT, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and People Technology to resolve operational dependencies and improve processes.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of new or updated People systems, policies, and processes.

Data Management, Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee data and lifecycle transactions across the HRIS and related People systems.
  • Conduct regular audits and reconciliations, identify data discrepancies or operational risks, and drive timely resolution.
  • Ensure assigned processes are executed in accordance with established SLAs, internal policies, controls, and applicable compliance requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits, compliance reporting, and data requests by providing accurate records and documentation.
  • Prepare and review recurring and ad hoc People Operations reports as required.

Experience / Education / Skills Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5 years of experience in People Operations, Employee Services, or a related HR function.
  • Strong working knowledge of employee lifecycle and core People Operations processes.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as Darwinbox, ADP, or similar systems.
  • Experience supporting India People Operations, along with experience or exposure to US and/or EOR operations.
  • Experience independently handling complex employee and operational matters with sound judgment and appropriate escalation.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements, including the use of systems, automation, or workflow enhancements.
  • Comfortable adopting AI and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against established timelines and SLAs.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions within established policies and frameworks.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications, Google Workspace, and collaboration tools such as Slack.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced SaaS, technology-driven, or globally distributed organization is highly preferred.

Salesforce Solution Architect

Phoenix Team | Remote (U.S.-based) | Full-Time

Overview

The Salesforce Solution Architect supports projects that define requirements and technical solutions for standing up and enhancing Salesforce environments in support of coordinated, multi-product release and regression testing. This role owns the Salesforce side of the solution design — solution architecture, metadata configuration, sandbox strategy, and integration design — spanning both declarative and programmatic (Apex and Lightning Components) Salesforce customization.

The Salesforce Solution Architect works as part of a team to define requirements, produce solution designs, and establish the operating model needed to bring new or updated environments online. Typical activities include determining sandbox type and sizing; defining metadata configuration and environment refresh approaches; sequencing onboarding of in-scope product groups; evaluating and recommending Salesforce integration approaches; and applying Salesforce data sharing and visibility models to the solution design.

The Salesforce Solution Architect will participate in technical discovery sessions with product, testing, and infrastructure stakeholders. Success in this role requires strong, hands-on Salesforce expertise — the ability to work across both flows/configuration and code — along with the ability to take a holistic view of a project's full scope and translate requirements into a solution design that aligns with VA governance, security, and federal compliance standards.

Key Functions

  • Produce the solution design for the Salesforce (and, in coordination with the team, AWS) components of the environment.
  • Determine sandbox type and sizing needed to support regression testing and performance testing requirements.
  • Define the metadata configuration approach for the environment.
  • Define the Salesforce refresh approach through the VA Salesforce governance group (DTC), including how refresh requests against production are structured and executed.
  • Define the onboarding sequence for product groups being brought into a shared environment.
  • Serve as the technical interface with DTC on sandbox provisioning and sandbox control.
  • Support determination of the environment's designation and naming, and how it fits within the broader Salesforce Org.
  • Support determination of the sandbox control model, including whether the environment operates under program control or DTC control.
  • Confirm the test data approach for the environment and the restrictions that apply, including data representativeness, use of production data, and PII handling.
  • Design Salesforce integration approaches for the environment, evaluating the available integration patterns and recommending the appropriate approach for each interface.
  • Apply Salesforce data sharing and visibility models appropriately within the environment design.
  • Troubleshoot Salesforce performance issues and metadata conflicts, and resolve them as part of the solution design.
  • Support development of Salesforce test data factories and updates to automated test cases needed to support the environment.
  • Take a holistic view of the full scope of the effort, including downstream and cross-product impacts, when designing new sandbox functionality.
  • Maintain compliance with VA security standards and federal requirements, including differences between commercial and GovCloud/FedRAMP configurations.
  • Maintain positive working relationships with federal clients, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders while supporting mission-critical systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 6 years of relevant experience.
  • An additional 2 years of experience (8 years total) with an Associate's Degree in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • An additional 4 years of experience (10 years total) with a High School Diploma in lieu of a Bachelor's Degree.
  • Hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex and other programmatic customizations, in addition to declarative (flows, configuration) experience.
  • Experience producing Salesforce solution designs, including metadata configuration and sandbox strategy.
  • Experience evaluating and recommending Salesforce integration approaches from among multiple available patterns.
  • Experience with Salesforce data sharing and visibility models.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce performance issues and resolving metadata conflicts.
  • Experience building or maintaining Salesforce test data factories and updating automated test cases to support environment or release changes.
  • Understanding of federal compliance considerations affecting Salesforce solutions, including differences between commercial and GovCloud/FedRAMP environments.
  • Ability to take a holistic view of a project's full scope, including downstream and cross-product impacts, when designing solutions.
  • Strong, hands-on orientation — able to directly configure, build, and troubleshoot rather than operate in a purely advisory capacity.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical and operational teams.
  • Ability to shift focus between competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications or Skills

  • Salesforce certification(s) such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Platform Developer II.
  • Experience supporting multi-product Salesforce Orgs where multiple teams release independently.
  • Experience supporting federal government Salesforce implementations, including FedRAMP or GovCloud environments.
  • Experience supporting regression testing or performance testing environment design.
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Experience coordinating sandbox refresh processes through a third-party governance or release management function.

Position Details

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Group Director, Core is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for a portfolio of primarily small business, founder-led clients. Your clients are often making their first serious investment in outside marketing help — the founder is usually the client, the budget is real money out of their own pocket, and a single underperforming month can feel existential in a way it rarely does at the enterprise level. You manage a higher-volume portfolio than almost any other Group Director role, and you run it the way a disciplined fund manager runs a broad, diversified book: fewer swings for the fences on any single account, more rigor in the system that keeps every account healthy. You are the executive a founder calls directly — there's no committee and no VP layer between you and the person who built the business — and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

At Power, retention is the floor, not the job. You are commercially driven first: you personally own executive relationships and expansion revenue for the top of your portfolio, and you hold your team to the same standard. In Core, that means running a scalable, standardized system — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and efficient triage — rather than bespoke strategy for every account, because the portfolio is wider and the margin for one-off customization is thinner than at any other tier. You coach Account Directors and their teams to operate as AI-Native Growth Directors — faster, sharper, and less buried in manual work than the role has ever required before. You decide which AI tools and workflows the division adopts. Your influence runs beyond Client Experience: you shape your Division's go-to-market position, you're a thought partner to your Managing Director and VP, and you represent Power Digital in market on how small, founder-led businesses can grow with limited resources.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion MRR for the division; treat expansion as the primary commercial lever of the role and own the division's monthly service expansion target
  • Personally own executive relationships across the top 10-20% of the portfolio by MRR — direct relationship, not delegated
  • Run quarterly, relationship-focused executive check-ins with top-tier accounts and 1x1 check-ins with every priority account
  • Maintain an accurate, self-owned retention forecast on a weekly basis — accountable for the accuracy of the division's retention data
  • Track vertical-specific signal such as founder engagement and responsiveness, service package utilization, and time-to-first-win on foundational packages, since a disengaged founder or a stalled quick win is often the earliest warning sign of churn at this tier
  • Diagnose risk early and install fixes, not just responses; lead or co-lead quarterly plans for the top 10% of the portfolio, weighted toward strategic outcomes over metrics recaps
  • Partner with Account Directors to build value-based, consultative business cases — expansion should drive value, not be sold
  • Identify and lead common Core expansion paths, including upsell from foundational packages into additional service lines, and efficient, template-driven expansion offers built for speed rather than custom-built proposals
  • Work with Account Directors to keep the Salesforce pipeline current and accurate — stages, forecast, and next steps updated weekly
  • Serve as the frontline for product and vertical innovation, feeding client signal into Power Circuit
  • Build and evolve vertical-relevant reporting frameworks for Core, including metrics such as time-to-first-win, founder engagement/response rate, and package-level utilization, built to work at scale across a high-volume portfolio
  • Play a key leadership role in final-round pitches for prospective clients where support is needed
  • Bring vertical point of view and executive credibility to new business
  • Partner with Sales to sharpen positioning, collateral, and win rate for the division's go-to-market
  • Directly manage Account Directors and oversee the pod that supports them
  • Coach every direct report to operate as an AI-Native Growth Director, not a task manager — faster diagnosis, more client-facing time, less manual reporting
  • Evaluate the team on Pulse sentiment, health scores, and expansion weekly — not just activity
  • Raise the floor on AI adoption — no one on the team operates the old way
  • Own hiring, staffing, capacity, and career pathing for the division; facilitate DAPs and career progression conversations
  • Practice radical candor; deliver timely, actionable feedback that accelerates careers
  • Identify and develop key talent for future Sr. Account Director & Group Director roles
  • Lead training on vertical-specific and AI-native tools, processes, and strategies
  • Vibe-codes prototypes to automate repeatable tasks, surface better insights, and test hypotheses quickly
  • Designs AI workflows for the team — builds the system, not just uses the tools; models AI-forward behavior
  • Runs Omega and Iris across the full portfolio and acts on the patterns they surface
  • Decides which AI tools and workflows get adopted, when, and how across the division
  • Owns division-level AI quality tradeoffs — where AI accelerates output, and where it must never touch client-facing work unreviewed
  • Builds and evolves Power Circuit solutions specific to the division with AI-assisted research; runs a monthly audit to confirm adoption
  • Collaborates with the innovation team on enhancements and optimizations that better serve the division's clients
  • Consulted on the division P&L and accountable for the profitability of the portfolio
  • Forecast the four pillars — Churn, Service Expansion, New Business, Efficiency — in partnership with the MD and VP
  • Use the P&L and strategic growth bets to build the business case for headcount and investment; drive efficiency through technology, AI, and process improvement
  • Own resolution of every escalation in the direct portfolio
  • Partner with Data Intelligence, Media Planning, and Activation teams to keep strategy and execution connected
  • Represent Power Digital in market — speaking, content, and client-facing points of view
  • Become the internal knowledge hub other leaders turn to for vertical and division expertise

Role Requirements

  • Department leadership and management experience required — has led Account Directors or senior marketers as direct reports
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in a digital marketing agency, with small business or founder-led client work at the AD level or above
  • Experience managing a P&L for profitable growth
  • Deep marketing fluency across a high-volume, standardized-service portfolio — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and time-to-value; understands where a scaled service model breaks down for an individual account and how to fix it without abandoning the system
  • Channel and program strategy expertise across a standardized service catalog — has built or overseen scalable, template-driven marketing programs, not bespoke enterprise strategy, without sacrificing quality
  • Measurement expertise: keeping reporting simple, fast, and founder-legible — time-to-value and quick-win ROI — and how to translate marketing performance into terms a first-time marketing buyer can act on, without over-engineering the analysis
  • Familiarity with the realities of founder-led decision-making — budget sensitivity tied to personal cash flow, fast decision cycles, and low tolerance for jargon or delay
  • Has presented to and pushed back on a founder or owner when the data supported it — can hold a direct, plain-language conversation about performance and expectations without an intermediary layer
  • Expertise in contract negotiation, client retention, and client growth
  • Proven track record delivering high NPS and retention metrics across a high-volume portfolio
  • Extensive knowledge of owned, earned, and paid marketing channels appropriate for small business budgets — content, SEO, paid search, paid social, and programmatic
  • Familiarity with Core-specific platforms and tools: standardized reporting and dashboarding tools built for scale, CRM systems, and lightweight marketing automation suited to small business budgets
  • Operational discipline — able to run a consistent, efficient system across many accounts rather than reinventing the approach for each one
  • Entrepreneurial spirit — energized by building, not just operating; contributes to product and go-to-market strategy, not just client management

  • 100% MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) Growth target achievement (set annually)
  • $125K in monthly service expansion pipeline creation across the division
  • +90% employee retention rate
  • Portfolio NPS at or above 8 (trailing 12 months)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Division Business & Team Leadership
  • New Business & Service Expansion Leadership
  • Product Quality, AI & Systems Development
  • Client Portfolio Ownership

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance

Please note: This role is contingent upon a contract award. While it is not an immediate opening, we are actively conducting interviews and extending offers in anticipation of the award.

The Work:

ICF is seeking an experienced Systems Engineer to support the design, implementation, operation, and maintenance of enterprise network infrastructure supporting critical federal programs. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and security of network hardware, operating systems, and communication infrastructure. This role requires strong technical expertise in network engineering, systems administration, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization within complex enterprise environments.

Job Location:

This position is remote and requires that the job be performed in the United States. If you accept this position, you should note that ICF monitors employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections.

  • Our core work hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, with flexibility to start earlier or work later depending on your time zone. Please note that project meetings may occasionally begin before 10:00 AM Eastern to accommodate client requirements.

  • Limited travel may be required for customer meetings, infrastructure deployments, or team collaboration.

What You Will Do:

The selected candidate will support the administration, maintenance, and enhancement of enterprise network infrastructure while ensuring high availability and operational performance. The Systems Engineer will perform systems engineering activities across network hardware, operating systems, and communication technologies while providing technical support, troubleshooting complex issues, and assisting with infrastructure modernization initiatives. This individual will work closely with network engineers, system administrators, cybersecurity personnel, and project leadership to maintain secure and reliable IT operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise, coordinate, and perform additions, upgrades, and changes to enterprise network hardware, operating systems, and connected devices.

  • Investigate, analyze, recommend, configure, install, and test new network hardware, software, and infrastructure components.

  • Provide day-to-day operational support for enterprise network infrastructure and operating systems.

  • Monitor system utilization, network performance, and response times to ensure optimal system availability.

  • Diagnose and resolve complex network, communications, and infrastructure issues.

  • Troubleshoot network connectivity at both the physical and logical layers using network measurement tools and diagnostic software.

  • Perform hardware testing, configuration validation, and communication protocol analysis.

  • Participate in the planning, design, technical review, implementation, and deployment of new network infrastructure and operating systems.

  • Support voice and data communication networks, ensuring reliable and secure network services.

  • Maintain network infrastructure standards, configurations, and documentation.

  • Configure, monitor, and support TCP/IP networking and other enterprise communication protocols.

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, systems administration, and engineering teams to ensure secure network operations.

  • Provide technical consultation, mentoring, training, and operational support to IT staff as directed.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, standard operating procedures, and system configurations.

  • Support infrastructure modernization, performance optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure and systems engineering.

  • US citizenship is required by government agency.

  • Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the required government security clearance.

  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

What We Would Like You to Bring with You:

  • Experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting network hardware and operating systems.

  • Experience supporting enterprise voice and data communication networks.

  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching, and network communication protocols.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure and communication issues.

  • Experience supporting infrastructure implementation, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • Enterprise network infrastructure design and administration

    • TCP/IP networking and communication protocols

    • Routing and switching technologies

    • Windows Server and Linux operating systems

    • Network monitoring and performance management tools

    • Network diagnostic and troubleshooting tools

    • DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall technologies

    • Virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, or similar)

    • Cloud networking (AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform)

    • Infrastructure automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar)

    • Network security best practices and system hardening

  • Experience supporting Federal Government IT infrastructure is preferred.

  • Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft, VMware, or equivalent certifications are highly desirable.

  • Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical enterprise environments.

  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and infrastructure lifecycle management.

  • Experience participating in disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience planning.

Professional Skills:

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support critical operational environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams.

  • Commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing enterprise infrastructure.

  • Recruits, develops, motivates, directs and provides leadership and performance management to professional staff

  • Initiates disciplinary action when performance does not meet expectations
  • Leads by example by promoting team work, recognition, and leadership while demonstrating company values

  • Coordinates special projects as needed

  • Masters’ degree in Business, Communications or related field; or additional years of equivalent experience in lieu of Master’s degree
  • 10 or more years of professional experience
  • 7 years’ healthcare experience

  • Public relations, interpersonal, and presentation skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Management and organization skills
  • Excellent MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills
  • Problem solving and analytical skills
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation skills
  • Ability to read and comprehend technical documents
  • Ability to define, lead, and manage projects

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or related field
  • 10 years’ healthcare experience
  • 8 years’ management experience
  • 6 years’ specified experience for which the account in which they are leading
  • Experience leading technology projects and teams, preferably in a state or federal public healthcare environment
  • Customer service experience
  • Experience with contracting – terms and negotiations
  • Performance management of subcontractors

Environment and Cognitive/Physical Demands

  • Requires prolonged sitting and telephone use
  • Requires the use of office equipment such as computer, telephones, copiers and printers

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Business Development Representative (BDR) / Appointment Setter to generate qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting and appointment setting.

This is a hands-on outbound sales role focused on cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, lead qualification, follow-up, and meeting generation.

You’ll research prospective companies and decision-makers, start conversations with potential customers, communicate the company’s value proposition, qualify interest, handle objections, and book qualified meetings for the sales team.

If you’re comfortable with outbound outreach, motivated by targets, and enjoy turning cold prospects into sales conversations, this role is a strong fit.

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

Cold Calling & Prospect Engagement

Performance & KPI Management

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer (freelance)
jobs.excerpt: In shortIf you're a backend engineer who doesn't just build what's asked, but shapes how it's built, we want to talk.
jobs.description:
In short

If you're a backend engineer who doesn't just build what's asked, but shapes how it's built, we want to talk. We're looking for someone who can own the technical direction of a project end to end: architecture, infrastructure, trade-offs, and the conversations that come with them. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. Full capacity from the start. The first three months are about figuring out if we're a good match. When things work out, and that depends on the work itself, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to our core team with a permanent contract and full benefits.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. We use AI every day, in actual work, not just in company decks. Our backend isn't generic CRUD: it's the cloud spine of physical devices, the layer where firmware meets data pipelines, and where one bad architectural call shows up in a sensor reading six months later.

Who this role is NOT for

If your comfort zone is a well-defined Jira board, clear specs, and someone else making the architectural calls, this isn't going to work. We're not hiring a senior developer who executes well. We're hiring someone who decides what gets built, how it gets built, and why. Someone who walks into a room full of ambiguity and starts creating structure, not waiting for it. If you need a ticket to start moving, if "that's not in the requirements" is a sentence you use often, or if you'd rather not be the one explaining a technical trade-off to a client, we're probably not your people. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI tools as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve the backend architecture for IoT projects: data ingestion pipelines, API design, infrastructure decisions

  • Make technical trade-off calls and defend them clearly to the team and to clients

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Timestream, S3) with production-grade reliability

  • Lead technical discussions: RFCs, architecture reviews, post-mortems, because you see the need, not because someone asked

  • Mentor other backend engineers, raise the bar on code quality, and set patterns others can follow

  • Work side by side with firmware engineers, mobile developers, QA, PMs, and clients

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

  • Challenge product and technical assumptions when something doesn't add up, even when it means a harder conversation

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the Mobile chapter (which covers backend/cloud too) for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 90-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects

  • When the first 3 months work out, and that depends on the work, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to a permanent contract with a fixed monthly salary, 26 days paid leave, 10 sick days, Saltus medical care, and a training budget

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if the project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a technical buddy and tackle progressively bigger tasks, so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. If it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the technical team

  4. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share something you've built that made you proud, ideally something where the architecture mattered.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development, with a meaningful chunk spent leading technical direction, not just writing code

  • Strong Node.js skills in production systems at scale (not "I followed a tutorial once")

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise: EKS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Timestream, S3

  • Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and Terraform: you've built and maintained real infrastructure, not just clicked through the console

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data pipelines

  • Experience with MQTT or similar IoT messaging protocols

  • CI/CD pipelines you've designed yourself (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)

  • English at B2+, written and spoken: you'll be in rooms with US-based clients and you need to hold your own

  • The ability to translate business needs into technical decisions and explain those decisions to non-technical stakeholders

  • Strong opinions, loosely held: you propose direction, you defend it, and you change your mind when the evidence says you should

Nice to have

  • Previous IoT or connected device projects, especially anything involving telemetry at scale

  • Golang in production (we're adding it alongside Node.js)

  • Observability stack experience: tracing, metrics, structured logging

  • Security mindset for cloud-connected devices: secrets, mTLS, OTA updates

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices your backend talks to, not just the cloud side of the story

What we're looking for is operational rigor: relentless follow through, quick learning, and the judgment to keep a cross functional team on track and moving efficiently, no matter how complex the surface area gets.

HOW YOU OPERATE

  • Find the biggest bottleneck in a function, fix it, then move to the next one. You'll be judged on how many you clear, not how many you document.
  • Remove unnecessary steps before adding new ones.
  • Use AI daily in your own work. You should be one of the heaviest AI users in the company.

Own New Product Launches, End to End

  • Lead new product launches from kickoff to the point where they run on their own, without you day to day.
  • Translate product strategy into clear specifications for pricing, data, and engineering, so requirements don't get lost or reinterpreted.
  • Set the build order with engineering and data, and hold that order when priorities compete.

Turn Expert Judgment Into Systems

  • Build a simple way for underwriting and pricing experts to enter their own rules and judgment into our systems, so they don't need to route through you.
  • Keep terminology consistent across every system, model, and team, and update it as the business grows.
  • Set up fast, accurate feedback from policies, claims, and lost deals, so we know quickly what's working and what needs to change.

Own Change Control and Quality

  • Create and run one clear process for any change to what we sell (coverage, rules, pricing), so changes don't happen ad hoc.
  • Catch problems in testing before they reach a customer.
  • Move existing programs onto shared infrastructure instead of maintaining separate one off setups.

YOU HAVE

  • 7+ years solving complex problems through process and product development, or a clear track record of taking on more scope and responsibility over time.
  • A systems thinker who obsesses over problems and builds solutions that scale, rather than one off fixes.
  • Exceptional project management and documentation skills, with the ability to run multiple workstreams at once without dropping detail.
  • A self starter mindset: comfortable rolling up your sleeves in a lean, fast moving environment.
  • Real, daily comfort working with AI agents (delegating to them, checking their work, improving them). You automate a task the second time you do it, not the tenth.
  • Evidence of grit: something you've pushed through more than once, even when it would have been easier to stop.
  • Insurance background is a plus, not a requirement. If you have exposure to policy forms, rate and rule filings, or systems like SERFF, that's a bonus, not a prerequisite.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:

  • Tobias Schuler, Chief Underwriting Officer: After becoming a Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society & working as a consultant actuary at EY for several years, Tobias went on to drive the actuarial data & systems teams at QBE. He further leveraged his deep insurance & technical expertise at Munich Re Digital Partners in North America, where he headed data & analytics & oversaw the data infrastructure behind some of their largest programs.
  • Dave Lin, Head of Product and Engineering: Dave has built and scaled B2B platforms at Yext, Apple, Amazon, and Hookit. He received his MS and BS in Electrical Engineering from University of California, San Diego
  • Stanley Wang, Senior Director, Pricing Analytics: Before joining Counterpart, Stanley worked as an actuary within the pricing solutions and methods team at USAA to combine actuarial pricing with data science models. Before that, he was a leading data scientist for Digital Partners, a Munich Re Company where he specialized in building data science models and insights for leading insurtech companies. He has had many other relevant roles such as capital modeling, risk management etc. He lives in New York with his growing family.
  • Chris Shafer, Chief of Staff: Chris is a published scientific author, having studied the neural correlates of gratitude at the lauded Brain and Creativity Institute. He has since helped to launch numerous businesses in which he held a variety of critical roles from product management to business operations to strategic partnerships. Chris received his bachelor’s degree in Biological Sciences from the University of Southern California.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
  • Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
  • Stock Options
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Parental Leave
  • Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
  • Book stipend
  • Wellness stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
  • Charitable Contribution Matching

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don’t cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren’t being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal.
  • Practice Omotenashi (“selfless hospitality”) - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely.Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering physician-led, evidence-based care for obesity and related cardiometabolic conditions. Obesity affects more than 40% of U.S. adults, and as GLP-1 medications reshape the field, Obesity and Cardiometabolic Medicine is in a period of rapid growth and opportunity. Form Health is at the forefront of that shift, building a clinical model that combines rigorous, personalized medical care with the technology to make it accessible at scale.

Every Form Health patient works closely with a dedicated multidisciplinary Care Team, including board-certified physicians (many ABOM-certified, and endocrinologists), advanced practice providers, and Registered Dietitians who together deliver comprehensive, one-on-one treatment that includes nutrition, behavioral health, physical activity, and FDA-approved medication, if appropriate. Through our mobile app, patients engage in regular video visits along with text messaging, photo journaling, and personalized educational content. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed, mission-driven company partnering with leading employers and health plans to expand access to high-quality, guideline-based obesity and cardiometabolic care nationwide. We're deeply invested in our core value of putting patients first, and equally committed to building a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and grow together.

About the Role:

The Care Delivery team builds the tools that let our clinical team run a high-performing virtual practice — from prescribing and prior authorizations to the day-to-day workflows clinicians rely on to do their best work with patients. This role is highly visible within Form Health: the tools you ship directly shape how our clinical team practices and, downstream, how our patients experience care. We're looking for someone who's genuinely energized by hard, regulated, multi-stakeholder problems — with clinical, patient, payer, and operational constraints — as well as someone who uses AI as a real part of supercharging their work, rather than a buzzword on a resume.

This role will report to our Lead Product Manager for Care Delivery, with significant ownership from day one and plenty of room to help shape how the practice scales as the team grows. This role is fully remote and can be located anywhere in the U.S. (Note: while not required, it is beneficial to be in or close to the Eastern Time zone given frequent collaboration with our Boston-based clinical and operations leaders)

What You Will Do:

  • Deeply understand Form Health's clinical and business needs: identify and prioritize jobs-to-be-done using research and user feedback
  • Own key care delivery capabilities end-to-end — e.g., prescribing, prior authorizations, virtual visit workflows
  • Partner with clinical leadership to triage and prioritize incoming product requests, balancing clinical needs against broader roadmap priorities
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements, including user stories, use cases, and functional specs
  • Partner with engineering, design, operations, and clinical teams to ship best-in-class tools for our clinical practice
  • Track key program and product metrics for your area, and report on progress and health to Form Health's leadership team
  • Facilitate sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and shipping
  • Partner with clinical education and enablement to roll out new features smoothly — change management, communications, and training
  • Identify where AI and automation can responsibly reduce clinical or administrative burden (e.g., documentation, prior-auth workflows, care coordination), and partner with engineering to evaluate and ship those capabilities thoughtfully

About You:

  • 5+ years building enterprise experiences with complex workflows
  • Comfortable diving into technical problems — APIs, workflows spanning homegrown and third-party systems
  • Clear communicator cross-functionally in a remote-first environment
  • A track record that includes:
    • Evaluating third-party vendors and driving coordination across multiple systems
    • Defining where a product should go, rallying a team behind it, and delivering results iteratively
    • Owning a product area end-to-end — strategy and prioritization through rollout and adoption
  • Fluent in using AI as part of your own PM craft — drafting specs, synthesizing research, prototyping — and curious about where AI can responsibly augment clinical operations
  • Proactive ownership over your area of responsibility, with a strong sense of accountability and an execution-oriented mindset — comfortable applying structure to ambiguous situations in a fast-growing startup
  • Genuinely excited to make compassionate, evidence-based healthcare accessible — and energized, not deterred, by the complexity of a regulated, high-stakes domain

Preferred:

  • Understanding of healthcare, virtual care delivery, or health insurance
  • Experience shipping AI-powered features, ideally within a tech-enabled services organization
  • Prior experience in a startup and/or high growth environment

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

The Senior Security Analyst helps protect Coalition policyholders from cyber loss by assessing security risk, investigating incidents and claims, and translating technical findings into practical recommendations. The role sits within Coalition’s Security team, working across threat intelligence, cyber risk management, and defensive security controls.
