50% travel internationally is required

Meet the Team

Cisco Security Business Group (SBG) is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer in a customer-facing role that focuses on technical leadership, two-way advocacy, and expertise across our Security Service Edge (SSE) portfolio.

This role combines deep SWG/SSE, networking and security expertise with the opportunity to influence product direction, solve critically important customer challenges, and serve as the technical link between product, engineering and our most strategic enterprise customers.

Cisco SSE offers a comprehensive end-to-end zero trust access security portfolio including VPN, zero trust access, web inspection in the cloud, firewall as a service, CASB, DLP and more. Cisco SSE deployment flexibility allows customers to select solutions tailored to their needs and transition seamlessly as requirements evolve.

You work globally across regions and time zones in support of our largest and most strategic SSE customers, coordinating with globally distributed engineering teams! Expect participation in a follow-the-sun escalation model and significant travel to customer sites and engineering hubs.

Your Impact

Serve as the technical liaison between Cisco SSE product management and engineering and our largest, most strategic enterprise SSE customers! Represent the product organization to customers by clearly recommending deployment best practices, issue findings, root causes, workarounds, product constraints, and delivery timelines. Represent the customer within the product organization by bringing production context, business impact, operational constraints, and technical requirements into build and prioritization discussions. Own sophisticated escalations, balancing realistic customer expectations with accurate, reproducible technical evidence while advocating for outcomes that protect customer environments. Translate requirements, RCAs, and technical decisions between customer and engineering contexts without losing fidelity on either side.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead the technical relationship on a named set of large and/or strategic SSE accounts, including critical issues end to end.

  • Drive proactive account health by improving deployment and rollout planning, configuration and policy consistency.

  • Build clean escalations for engineering - timeline, impact, repro, logs, pcaps, redacted configs - and translate outcomes back to the customer.

  • Feed recurring customer patterns back into product and engineering roadmaps as concrete requirements.

  • Build and support the CX-driven runbooks and documentation from lessons learned and for future SSE deployments.

  • Script (Bash/Python) for diagnostics, health checks, automations, and lab reproduction.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field with 10+ years of professional experience in networking, security, or cloud infrastructure; or a Master's degree with 7+ years of experience.

  • 7+ years in networking/security with direct customer ownership.

  • Experience with DNS, routing, IPsec tunnels, TLS, SAML, SWG/Web Proxy, and cloud networking.

  • Experience across zero trust access, VPN, web inspection in the cloud, CASB, DLP, and firewall policy.

  • 5+ years of experience with identity and SSO integrations (SAML/OIDC, SCIM) in enterprise deployments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience handling on-premises and cloud security/networking products in production customer environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence customer expectations and recommend successful SaaS deployment and adoption strategies.

  • Experience supporting large multinational enterprise accounts with global SSE or SASE rollouts.

  • Ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures in a distributed engineering organization.

  • Coding experience with Bash, Python, or similar.

  • Ability to advocate for both viewpoints—customer urgency and engineering feasibility—without distorting either.

  • Ability to communicate engineering updates to executive and technical customer audiences, and customer context to engineering.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action.
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action. This role is the operational engine that keeps jobs moving, keeps the team informed, and keeps the insurance process on track.

A significant portion of this role involves direct communication with insurance companies — calling adjusters, following up on claims, tracking appraisal status, and pushing for updates that allow the team to move forward. This is not a passive role. You flag stalled jobs, escalate when needed, and take initiative to get answers without being asked. If you are organized, persistent, and comfortable on the phone with insurance representatives, this role is built for you.

How the Job Pipeline Works

Understanding the full workflow is essential to succeeding in this role:

  • A new job comes in — you verify it meets the intake requirements and track it in the system
  • You ping the sales representative to confirm the inspection date has been set
  • Once the inspection date is confirmed, the job moves to the next stage and a claim number is assigned
  • You monitor all active jobs — if a job has been sitting without progress for too long, you bring it to the Operations Manager's attention immediately
  • You contact the insurance company by phone and email to obtain required claim documents, following up weekly until received
  • Field technicians go out, take photos, and capture data — that data is entered into the platform to generate the inspection report
  • You use the report to write the estimate and submit it to the insurance company
  • Once submitted, you follow up with the insurance company on the appraisal status — calling and emailing until you have an update
  • You communicate appraisal updates clearly to the internal team
  • Once approved, the information is sent to invoicing and the job moves forward to completion

Key Responsibilities

Job Intake & Pipeline Tracking

  • Receive and log incoming jobs, verifying they meet the required criteria before moving them into the active pipeline
  • Track all active jobs through each stage of the process — from intake through inspection, claim submission, appraisal, and invoice
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date job tracker so the team always knows exactly where each job stands
  • Proactively identify jobs that have stalled or been sitting without progress and escalate them to the Operations Manager before delays become problems

Sales Team Coordination

  • Ping sales representatives to confirm inspection dates have been scheduled for new incoming jobs
  • Follow up consistently until confirmation is received — do not wait for the information to come to you
  • Move jobs through the pipeline stages as milestones are hit and document each transition

Insurance Company Communication — High Volume

This is one of the most critical and time-intensive parts of the role.

  • Contact insurance companies by phone and email to request and obtain claim documents, adjuster assignments, and claim numbers
  • Follow up with insurance representatives weekly — or more frequently when deadlines are approaching — until all required documents and approvals are received
  • Track the status of submitted estimates and appraisals, calling the insurance company to check on progress and push for updates
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with adjusters — you know how to be persistent without being difficult
  • Document all insurance communications including contact names, dates, outcomes, and promised follow-up timelines

Inspection Report & Estimate Support

  • Coordinate with field technicians to ensure photo and data capture from job sites is submitted in a timely manner
  • Enter field data into the platform to generate the inspection report
  • Use the completed inspection report to write the estimate and prepare it for submission to the insurance company
  • Ensure all estimate submissions are complete, accurate, and sent to the correct insurance contact

Appraisal Process Management

  • Track all submitted estimates through the appraisal process — logging submission dates and expected response windows
  • Follow up with the insurance company on the status of submitted appraisals — making calls to confirm receipt, ask for timelines, and request updates
  • Provide clear, timely appraisal status updates to the internal team so everyone knows where each job stands
  • Once appraisal decisions are received, communicate the outcome and relevant details to the operations and invoicing team so the job can move forward

Invoicing Handoff

  • Upon appraisal approval, compile and send the required information to the invoicing team
  • Ensure all documentation needed to close the job is organized, complete, and transmitted without delay

Required Qualifications

  • Prior experience in operations coordination, claims coordination, or a similar role in construction, restoration, roofing, or insurance-related services
  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to insurance companies, adjusters, and internal team members
  • Persistent and proactive by nature — you follow up without being asked and escalate before things become urgent
  • Highly organized with the ability to track multiple active jobs at different stages simultaneously without losing detail
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — your phone calls are professional and your documentation is clear
  • Reliable in a remote environment with a quiet workspace and high-speed internet

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with insurance claims, adjusters, or the property damage restoration process
  • Familiarity with construction or restoration job management platforms and reporting tools
  • Background in roofing, storm damage restoration, or property insurance claims coordination
  • Experience writing estimates or supporting the estimating process in a construction or restoration context

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You look at the job tracker every morning and immediately know what needs to move today — without anyone telling you
  • Insurance companies hear from you on a regular, consistent schedule — not whenever you happen to remember
  • No job sits in your pipeline without a status, a next action, and a follow-up date
  • You escalate stalled jobs before the Operations Manager has to ask about them
  • You are the reason jobs move forward — the team counts on you to keep the pipeline flowing from the first call to the final invoice

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $6/hr

100% Remote

jobs.description:
Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Business Operations Coordinator to keep the firm running well and to own the operating processes behind our executive team, our partner program and our business development data.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Business Operations Coordinator to keep the firm running well and to own the operating processes behind our executive team, our partner program and our business development data.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. You will support the Managing Partner and other leaders, but you will also own areas of the business end to end. We want someone who notices what needs attention, closes the loop without being reminded, improves recurring processes and puts spare capacity to productive use.

What you will own

Executive scheduling and firm coordination

  • Manage calendars for the Managing Partner and other members of leadership, anticipate conflicts and propose solutions.

  • Arrange travel, expenses submission and in-person logistics for the Managing Partner and other leaders.

  • Coordinate internal, client, prospect and software-partner meetings across multiple calendars, including client calendars when authorized.

  • Schedule interviews for candidates advancing through our ATS and make the candidate experience responsive and professional.

  • Set up Zoom and Teams meetings, prep sessions and materials. Book in-office days and meeting space through Regus or similar providers.

  • Run regular check-ins with leadership, maintain action lists and follow up with owners so commitments do not disappear after a meeting.

Partner program operations

  • Maintain the operating record for each software partner agreement: deal registrations, referral submissions, commission and referral revenue tracking, certification requirements and renewal dates.

  • Maintain relationship maps of partner sales and alliance contacts, including the accounts and territories each covers.

  • Flag to leadership when representatives from different partners are working the same target account.

  • Coordinate partner-facing logistics: portal access, co-marketing assets, joint meeting scheduling and follow-up.

Salesforce and business development data

  • Own Salesforce data quality: keep account and contact records current, find and fix stale or inconsistent data, and drive the right person to supply missing information.

  • Enrich accounts and contacts from conversations, public sources and partner intelligence so that account history and context live in one place.

  • Perform account and contact research and build target lists in support of the SDR and leadership.

  • Set up and maintain outreach lists and sequences in Mailshake for the SDR and produce simple outreach activity reporting.

  • Maintain the firm's purchased and subscribed data sources and recommend additions or corrections.

  • Build productive working relationships with executive assistants at clients, prospects and partners.

Onboarding, offboarding and systems

  • Own administrative onboarding for new employees and associates: first-month schedule with the manager, introductions, accounts, licenses, access and basic firm information.

  • Be the first point of contact for new people during their initial weeks.

  • Administer licenses and user access across Google Workspace, Zoom, Lucid, Salesforce, our ATS, Mailshake and other SaaS tools; identify unused licenses; coordinate AWS and Amazon Business account administration with the responsible engineer.

  • Maintain the firm's access and credential inventory in the approved password manager, enforce MFA on administrative accounts, and remove access within one business day of a departure or role change.

  • Manage Zoom cloud recordings and verify storage and delete redundant copies.

  • Maintain naming conventions, folder structures and short written procedures so records can be found by anyone.

LinkedIn, website and external providers

  • Publish LinkedIn posts from content supplied by leadership and marketing, and keep the company page consistent and professional.

  • Make routine WordPress updates to the website and coordinate larger changes with outside resources.

  • Coordinate external marketing, graphics, content and legal providers: hand off assignments clearly, track open work and route completed deliverables to the right person.

Presentations, spreadsheets and meeting support

  • Build and format client-ready PowerPoint presentations from content supplied by leadership and subject-matter experts.

  • Build and maintain Excel trackers, lists and basic analyses using formulas, filters, lookups and pivot tables.

  • Prepare agendas for key internal meetings; attend selected meetings, capture decisions and actions, and file them in the right system.

Continuous improvement and learning

  • Continuously evaluate recurring work and implement better ways to do it, including standardization, automation and appropriate use of GenAI tools within the firm's data-handling rules.

  • Build working knowledge of the firm's data management and consulting business so that your context and judgment improve over time.

  • When core administrative work is under control, move capacity to partner operations, CRM enrichment, research and process improvement without waiting to be asked.

What we are looking for

  • Several years of experience in business operations, executive support, professional-services administration, sales operations or a similarly broad coordination role, with a track record of staying long enough in prior roles to take real ownership.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars and follow-up for executives or senior professionals.

  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail; high responsiveness; a strong instinct to close the loop.

  • A proactive operating style: you identify additional work, risks and improvements rather than wait to be assigned every task.

  • Sound judgment about when to act, when to recommend and when a question genuinely needs an answer first.

  • High integrity and discretion with confidential company, client, employee, partner and system information.

  • A courteous, professional communication style, written and spoken, that sets a constructive tone with colleagues, candidates, clients, partners and providers.

  • Solid PowerPoint and Excel skills.

  • Experience with Salesforce or another CRM and a real appreciation for data quality and disciplined capture.

  • Experience with Google Workspace and comfort learning and administering SaaS tools.

  • Effective in a fully remote environment across countries and time zones, collaborating over Zoom, Teams and email.

  • Curiosity, an interest in learning the data and consulting space, and a desire to become highly capable with GenAI tools.

  • Comfortable with occasional travel or in-person meetings when there is a business reason.

Helpful but not required

  • Experience in consulting, professional services, technology, data management, legal, accounting or another client-service environment.

  • Experience with ATS, WordPress, Zoom administration, LinkedIn company-page administration, Mailshake or similar tools.

  • Experience supporting a software partner or channel program, or coordinating external vendors.

  • Experience with prospect and account research.

DataCatalyst is an equal opportunity employer. Employment is contingent on a background check conducted in accordance with applicable law.

What Sets Us Apart

At DataCatalyst, you’re not a cog in a machine—you’re a trusted partner. Our culture is defined by:

  • Impact-driven work: Your insights and execution shape client strategy and operational clarity.

  • Collaborative excellence: We value respectful disagreement, diverse perspectives, and direct communication built for speed and precision.

  • Entrepreneurial, low-bureaucracy environment: We move fast, make decisions with limited information, and rely on resourcefulness and clarity.

  • Accelerated growth: By working alongside veteran consultants on focused, high-impact projects, you'll sharpen expertise swiftly—taking ownership and growing as a revenue-driving member of the team.

  • Quality of Life: With our fully remote, low-travel model, you can do challenging, high-impact work without sacrificing personal priorities. We believe great consulting doesn’t require endless flights or late nights—it requires focus, autonomy, and sustainable balance.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re detail-obsessed, client-centric, and excited by the idea of crafting data clarity from chaos, we’d love to talk. Come help us bring trusted, high-impact data solutions to enterprises across the globe—without sacrificing balance, autonomy, or growth.

At DataCatalyst, we enable enterprises to transcend data disorder and gain clarity—fostering smarter, faster decision-making. Our veteran team of data management, governance, and monetization specialists brings, on average, 15 years of experience to each engagement, and we're proud of our 100% project success rate.

We take a hands-on, pragmatic approach—eschewing large junior consultant rosters and sales layers in favor of lean, deeply skilled teams focused on generating real business value. Using our proprietary Accelerate methodology, we swiftly deploy high-quality data strategies, governance structures, and MDM implementations across industries like financial services, healthcare, manufacturing & distribution, retail, energy, and more.

We embrace a fully remote, low-travel model, enabling sustainable work-life balance across time zones without compromising client delivery. With a flat organizational structure, open collaboration, and software engineering-inspired rigor—particularly strong documentation and technical discipline—we cultivate an environment where each individual makes a direct and visible impact.

jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod
  • Assign and balance workloads across the team
  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards
  • Ensure case managers understand priorities and case progression expectations
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager
  • Escalate friction points between case managers and the attorney to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

  • Own MRI rates, advanced treatment rates, and ensure diagnostics are properly tracked and attended
  • Monitor and drive case velocity — ensuring cases move efficiently through each pre-litigation phase
  • Ensure settlements meet expected value targets relative to policy limits
  • Identify roadblocks to case progression and proactively clear them
  • Flag systemic medical management issues to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

3. Case Investigation & Documentation Oversight

  • Monitor progress of medical record collection and documentation gathering
  • Ensure case files contain required documentation and supporting evidence
  • Confirm liability and damages documentation is organized and complete
  • Review case files for completeness prior to escalation to the attorney
  • Maintain strong case file organization and documentation discipline

4. Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Actively use dashboards and reporting tools to evaluate team KPIs and identify underperformance
  • Identify process changes and efficiency improvements through direct case experience and data analysis
  • Surface operational gaps and improvement ideas to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager
  • Be comfortable building or pulling reports independently — data literacy is a core expectation of this role, not optional

5. Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding and training for new case managers joining the pod
  • Provide informal coaching and identify skill gaps requiring additional training
  • Promote consistency in case handling practices and ownership mentality across the team
  • Model best practices in case management, documentation, client communication, and ownership through personal caseload performance

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters
  • Be held to a higher performance standard than case managers given the complexity and value of the assigned caseload
  • Balance personal case execution responsibilities alongside team supervision duties
  • Demonstrate full ownership over cases — regardless of what other departments (medical records, CV specialists, settlement, etc.) have or haven't done, the Case Manager Lead is accountable for outcomes on their cases
  • Identify workflow challenges or process gaps through direct case experience and escalate operational improvements when needed

What You Bring

Required:

  • 6-8 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in multiple states or the state of North Carolina
  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of case managers, directing case strategy and workflow to efficiently drive files through each phase and toward timely settlement
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor’s degree or Paralegal Certificate (not required)
  • Proven experience managing and developing a team within a legal environment
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-growing law firms
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

jobs.description:
Job Description: Chief Controls Officer (CCO – Controls)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

Job Summary

The Chief Controls Officer (CCO – Controls) is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's internal control framework to ensure effective risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, and operational integrity. This role ensures that controls across financial, operational, and compliance processes are robust, consistent, and aligned with organizational risk appetite.

The CCO (Controls) plays a critical role in strengthening governance, preventing control failures, and enhancing transparency across all business functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Controls Framework

Develop and maintain enterprise-wide internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO)

Ensure controls are effectively designed, documented, and implemented

Standardize control practices across business units

Continuously improve control effectiveness and maturity

2. Control Monitoring & Testing

Oversee control testing, monitoring, and validation processes

Implement continuous control monitoring systems

Identify control gaps and weaknesses

Ensure timely remediation of control deficiencies

3. Risk & Compliance Integration

Align internal controls with enterprise risk management (ERM) frameworks

Collaborate with risk, compliance, and audit teams

Ensure controls support regulatory compliance requirements

Monitor emerging risks and adapt control frameworks accordingly

4. Financial & Operational Controls

Oversee financial controls, including reporting, reconciliation, and revenue controls

Ensure operational controls across processes, systems, and workflows

Strengthen fraud prevention and detection mechanisms

Ensure consistency in control execution

5. Governance & Policy Management

Develop and maintain control-related policies and procedures

Ensure documentation, audit trails, and governance standards are maintained

Support governance committees and reporting requirements

Enhance transparency and accountability

6. Technology & Controls Automation

Leverage technology and automation to enhance control effectiveness

Implement control tools, dashboards, and monitoring systems

Collaborate with IT on system controls and cybersecurity frameworks

Drive digital transformation in control environments

7. Stakeholder Engagement

Provide control insights and reporting to executive leadership and Board

Collaborate with regulators, auditors, and external stakeholders

Support internal and external audits

Promote awareness of control responsibilities across the organization

8. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop internal controls and governance teams

Establish performance standards and accountability

Foster a culture of control awareness and discipline

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in internal controls, audit, risk, or compliance roles

Proven experience in senior leadership roles (e.g., Chief Controls Officer, Head of Internal Controls)

Strong background in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO)

Strong understanding of risk management and regulatory compliance

Expertise in financial and operational controls

Analytical and problem-solving skills

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High attention to detail and governance mindset

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Effectiveness of internal control framework

Number and severity of control deficiencies

Timeliness of remediation actions

Compliance with regulatory and audit requirements

Reduction in control failures and operational risks

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Exposure to IT controls, cybersecurity, and automation tools

Strong collaboration with risk, compliance, and audit functions

Ability to lead enterprise-wide control transformation initiatives

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

jobs.description:
Career Category

Information Systems

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr. Digital Product Manager, Catalysts

What you will do

The Senior Digital Product Manager, Catalysts will embed with individual product teams to help accelerate Amgen’s adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), strengthen the product management capability, and help teams shift from output to outcome mindsets. Reporting to the Director, Product Management Catalysts, this individual contributor role will serve as a hands-on player-coach, partnering directly with digital product managers, business leads, technology leads, business analysts, design, data, and engineering team members to improve how products are defined, prioritized, measured and delivered.

This role will primarily embed at the individual product level, though may support multiple product teams when needed. The Senior Digital Product Manager, Catalysts will apply product judgment within each engagement, independently diagnosing product challenges, shaping recommendations and directly leading product work where needed, while developing the assigned DPM’s capability to sustain that ownership over time and helping the broader cross-functional team adopt DPOM practices.

The Senior Digital Product Manager, Catalysts will help DPMs and cross-functional teams clarify business and user problems, define measurable outcomes, strengthen product strategy, improve roadmaps, establish OKRs and KPIs, support discovery, improve prioritization, and connect delivery work to measurable value. This role will also capture learnings from embedded engagements and contribute insights back to the Product Management Hub to improve DPOM playbooks, tools, standards and enterprise adoption approaches.

Responsibilities

Embedded Product Leadership and Coaching

  • Embed with individual product teams to help improve product management practices and accelerate DPOM adoption.
  • Serve as a hands-on player-coach to Digital Product Managers and cross-functional team members.
  • Coach assigned DPMs on core product management skills, including problem definition, discovery, product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and value measurement.
  • When no DPM is assigned, temporarily perform product management responsibilities directly, including shaping product direction, aligning stakeholders, defining outcomes, and supporting roadmap and prioritization decisions.
  • Help teams move from stakeholder-request and feature-based delivery toward empowered, outcome-driven product management.

DPOM Adoption and Team Enablement

  • Help cross-functional teams understand and apply DPOM practices in the flow of real product work.
  • Partner with business leads, technology leads, product owners, business analysts, design, data and engineering team members, and other stakeholders to strengthen product ways of working.
  • Help teams clarify roles, decision rights, operating rhythms, success measures, and expectations within the Digital Product Operating Model.
  • Identify product management capability gaps, adoption barriers, and recurring anti-patterns within embedded teams.
  • Support teams in building durable product habits that continue after the Catalyst engagement ends.

Product Strategy, Outcomes, and Prioritization

  • Help teams understand business context, constraints and material risks while defining the business and user problems they are solving and connecting product work to measurable outcomes.
  • Shape and strengthen development of product vision, strategy, roadmaps, OKRs, KPIs, and value realization plans.
  • Apply independent product judgment to help teams evaluate and make trade-off recommendations based on user needs, business value, feasibility, risk, and enterprise priorities.
  • Support discovery, validation, experience evaluation, and learning practices that help teams make better product decisions.
  • Help DPMs integrate technical feasibility, data and measurement requirements, dependencies, and appropriate AI opportunities and risks into product decisions.
  • Help teams evaluate investment, capacity and prioritization trade-offs based on user needs, expected business value, evidence, feasibility, risk and enterprise priorities.
  • Help teams improve roadmap quality by shifting from output lists to outcome-oriented plans.

Catalyst Model Execution and Continuous Improvement

  • Execute the Catalyst engagement model, including product/team assessment, engagement planning, embedded coaching, adoption measurement, transition planning, and learning capture.
  • Contribute to refinement of the Catalyst model based on practical learnings from embedded engagements.
  • Define and track success measures for each engagement, including DPM capability growth, cross-functional team adoption, product maturity, and DPOM adoption outcomes.
  • Surface insights, risks, and recommendations to the Director, Product Management Catalysts and Product Management Hub leadership.
  • Translate lessons from embedded work into reusable examples, practices, templates, and playbook improvements.

Stakeholder Partnership and Influence

  • Build trusted relationships with DPMs, business stakeholders, technology leaders, and cross-functional team members.
  • Influence without formal authority in complex product and enterprise environments.
  • Communicate clearly with team-level and senior stakeholders on product direction, adoption progress, risks, and decisions needed.
  • Operate with high autonomy, strong judgment, and a bias toward practical progress.
  • Escalate major blockers, trade-offs, or alignment issues to the Director, Product Management Catalysts when needed.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Senior Digital Product Manager we seek is a strong product practitioner and coach with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 2 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • Master’s degree and 6 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience
  • Associates degree and 10 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience or
  • High school diploma/GED and 12 years of Digital Product, Product Management, Product Leadership, Digital Transformation, Technology Strategy, or related experience
  • In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 year experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, including product strategy, discovery, roadmapping, prioritization, delivery, and outcome measurement.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, or upskill product managers, product owners, business partners, or cross-functional team members.
  • Strong product management craft, including user and customer problem definition, product discovery, roadmap development, OKRs, KPIs, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and value realization.
  • Experience working directly with cross-functional product teams, including business, technology, design, data, and agile delivery partners.
  • Ability to operate as a hands-on player-coach, balancing direct product work with coaching and capability building.
  • Proven ability to help teams shift from output-oriented delivery to outcome-oriented product management.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, diagnosing team needs, and creating practical paths forward.
  • Experience contributing to product playbooks, standards, templates, training, or operating model improvements preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, biotechnology, or other regulated industries preferred; candidates from high-tech, digital, consulting, or product-led organizations are also encouraged to apply.
  • Familiarity with AI-native product development, generative AI workflows, responsible AI principles, and the evolving role of AI in product management preferred.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

Every time you pay with a card online, tell an AI agent to book your flight, or trust an app with your data, something has to make that safe - invisibly, instantly, at scale. That’s VGS.

As a payments infrastructure platform powering enterprise merchants and agentic commerce, we enable high-growth enterprises to collect, tokenize and send sensitive data - including PII and Payment Data - while offloading the associated risk. Very Good Security (VGS) is the global leader in payment tokenization - securing over 8 billion payment tokens and powering over 80 billion API calls annually. Our modern tokenization platform operates as the silent backbone for critical transactions and elite brands, allowing our clients to innovate without constraint. We partner with the world’s largest card payment networks and cloud providers. And power some of the most recognizable AI companies, payment wallets, and enterprise retailers in the world.

We’re a rapidly growing Series C company, backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, Goldman Sachs, and Vertex Ventures.

Role Overview
The Director, Strategic Partnerships – Payments & Product will lead the expansion of VGS's strategic partner ecosystem - building relationships with card networks, investors, cloud providers, and emerging payments infrastructure players that directly shape our product strategy and platform capabilities.

This role blends external partner engagement with internal product collaboration. You’ll help shape our product roadmap by bringing ecosystem insights and partnership-led opportunities to life - whether through expanding our card network services, accelerating agentic tokens, or other innovative initiatives.

What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...

  • Lead and develop a team of Strategic Partnerships professionals, including direct reports, setting clear priorities, coaching performance, and building the team’s capabilities as VGS’s partnership portfolio and strategic mandate expand.

  • Own and grow a portfolio of VGS’s most strategic partnerships across payments and commerce technology, including card networks, investors, cloud and infrastructure providers, AI platforms, wallets, processors, and other ecosystem partners.

  • Develop and execute partnership strategies that advance VGS’s company and product priorities, identifying where external partners can accelerate growth, strengthen product differentiation, or open new markets and distribution channels.

  • Lead complex, product-oriented partnerships that require deep coordination across Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership, translating strategic opportunities into executable commercial and technical plans.

  • Source, evaluate, prioritize, and develop new strategic partnerships, with a focus on opportunities that can materially influence VGS’s product roadmap, competitive positioning, or long-term growth.

  • Lead negotiations for strategic commercial and product agreements, including defining partnership structures, economics, go-to-market models, technical commitments, and mutual success criteria.

  • Drive partnerships from initial strategy and business case through negotiation, launch, commercialization, and ongoing relationship management.

  • Build senior-level relationships with partner executives and serve as a trusted strategic counterpart, identifying opportunities to expand the partnership and proactively addressing risks or areas of misalignment.

  • Establish clear goals, operating rhythms, and success metrics for key partnerships, holding both VGS and partners accountable for execution and measurable outcomes.

  • Act as the voice of strategic partners within VGS, bringing external market insights, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into product and company decision-making.

  • Influence VGS’s broader corporate and product strategy by developing a point of view on the evolution of tokenization, payments infrastructure, agentic commerce, AI, and next-generation commerce technologies.

  • Identify emerging ecosystem shifts and translate them into actionable recommendations for VGS, including potential new products, partnerships, distribution models, and strategic initiatives.

  • Represent VGS externally with senior leaders across the payments and technology ecosystem, strengthening VGS’s position as a strategic infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.

What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, fintech BD, product strategy, or payments consulting

  • Understanding of the payments ecosystem—issuers, processors, card networks, wallets, and commerce platforms

  • Ability to connect technical product functionality with partner and market needs

  • Demonstrated success managing complex partnerships and cross-functional projects

  • Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and emerging technologies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a strategic mindset and a bias toward execution

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience working closely with product or engineering teams in a platform company or fintech infrastructure provider, especially in an innovative and fast paced startup environment

  • Familiarity with tokenization, payment flows, reconciliation processes, or data compliance frameworks

  • Technical literacy (e.g., comfortable discussing APIs, SDKs, and integration workflows)

• Competitive health benefits
• VGS stock options

• Life & disability insurance
• Pre-tax flexible spending accounts, dependent and healthcare FSA (available only for US employees)

That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you’ll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time—because we know there’s real value in coming together.

Beckman Coulter Life Sciences’ mission is to empower those seeking answers to life’s most important scientific and healthcare questions. With a legacy spanning 80+ years, we have long been a trusted partner to our customers, who are working to transform science and healthcare with the next groundbreaking discovery. As part of our team of more than 2,900 associates across 130 countries, you’ll help drive our vision of accelerating answers—and our commitment to excellence.

Beckman Coulter Life Sciences is one of 10 Life Sciences companies of Danaher. Together, we accelerate the discovery, development and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health.

About this role

We are seeking a Field Applications Specialist to serve as the primary scientific and applications expert for our cell analysis and bioprocess analytics portfolio across the Eastern United States. This is a field-based, customer-facing role in which you will be the trusted scientific voice for customers in biopharma, cell line development, and process development—partnering closely with the Sales team while guiding customers to get the most reliable, reproducible results from their workflows.

At its core, this role is about scientific problem-solving. Every customer arrives with a different system—different cell types, different molecules, different objectives—and your job is to understand that system, identify the factors driving variability, and optimize a solution that works for them. Success depends as much on your ability to communicate complex science clearly, to audiences ranging from bench scientists to senior leadership, as on your technical depth. This is a remote role and can be performed from any location within the Eastern U.S. territory.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Serving as the primary applications and scientific resource for customers — Solve challenges and get the most from their instruments and assays, understand the customer’s specific cell types, samples, and goals; diagnosing the many sample- and instrument-level factors that can lead to variable or inconsistent results; and optimizing the workflow to deliver accurate, reproducible outcomes.
  • Supporting antibody and protein quantification applications by understanding customers’ specific molecules—including antibody structure and conformation—and how those characteristics can influence results, then guiding customers toward reliable, optimized measurements.
  • Delivering product demonstrations, on-site trainings, and applications support, both in the field and via web-based platforms.
  • Working cross-functionally as the connective point between the customer and the wider organization: knowing who to engage and when, and collaborating across Sales, Product Management, and R&D to resolve issues and advance opportunities.
  • Capturing Voice of Customer from the field and relaying it to Product Management and R&D, helping to shape future product iterations and ensure the portfolio continues to perform and hold up over time.

The required qualifications for the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, or a related life science; advanced degree (M.S. or Ph.D.) a plus.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant life sciences experience in a field applications, technical support, or laboratory/bioprocess environment; a combination of hands-on lab experience with customer-facing experience is ideal.

  • Willingness and ability to travel throughout the Eastern U.S. territory (up to 85%), with a valid driver’s license and the ability to work independently from a home office.

It would be a plus if you also possess:

  • Cell line development (CLD) experience and hands-on familiarity with antibody / monoclonal (IgG) production — highly desired for supporting bioprocess and titer-related applications.
  • An understanding of antibody structure and conformation and how a molecule’s characteristics can affect its quantification and behavior in an assay.
  • Process development or drug manufacturing experience in a biopharma/biotech setting (e.g., upstream/bioreactor, scale-up/scale-down, or GMP environments).
  • Hands-on experience with multimode microplate readers, particularly those with fluorescence polarization (FP) detection capability.
  • Understanding of B2B and QC/QA/R&D customer requirements and of validation processes in the pharma/biopharma industry (e.g., GMP, IQ, OQ).

jobs.excerpt: About BraavoBraavo Capital has financed mobile app growth for more than ten years.
jobs.description:
About Braavo

Braavo Capital has financed mobile app growth for more than ten years. We’ve deployed billions of dollars to hundreds of app companies through revenue-based products — App Store advance payouts, revenue-based financing, and large credit facilities — underwritten on our own direct integrations with the app stores, ad networks, payment processors, MMPs, and everything in between.

We’re in a phase of rapid expansion, with multiple lines of business and several new product rollouts coming through 2026 and early 2027. We’re hiring for a handful of mission-critical roles to support it, and the Head of Originations is at the top of the list.

The Role

You own origination end to end — from the first conversation to a signed term sheet: building demand in a market that’s still emerging, working out what a company actually needs, negotiating the terms, and carrying the deal through documentation without losing context.

Most capital providers in the mobile ecosystem sell one product and spend their time convincing companies to want it. We don’t. Our range runs from working capital against app store receivables through to large credit facilities, and the job is figuring out which combination fits a company’s economics, timing, and capital structure. It’s a consultative sale rather than a pitch.

You’ll be building this role from the ground up, so there isn’t an established playbook — we need someone entrepreneurial enough to figure things out on the fly. That said, you’ll be working directly with our founder & CEO, so you’ll have the institutional knowledge and experience on hand to learn quickly, adapt, and succeed.

What You’ll Own

Market engagement

  • Build and run Braavo’s origination motion — outbound, inbound, referral, event-driven — and own the top-of-funnel number.

  • Represent Braavo in the market: industry events, podcasts, social channels, written content, and the private communities where app finance leaders actually talk to each other.

  • Build referral relationships that produce recurring flow — agencies, platforms, VCs and venture debt funds whose portfolios need capital they don’t provide, advisors and fractional CFOs.

Diagnosis and structuring

  • Run first-pass diligence yourself. Read a company’s revenue, cohorts, payout timing, and cash cycle well enough to know what it can support.

  • Match the situation to the right structure — or tell them we’re not it. Saying “not yet” well matters; plenty of those companies are fundable two quarters later.

  • Own the term sheet: sizing, pricing, advance rates, thresholds, reporting, exclusivity. Negotiate directly with founders, CFOs, and their counsel.

  • Stay on the deal through documentation and close, advocating for it to land while balancing what the customer needs against what we need.

  • Bring back what’s costing us deals — pricing, speed, structure, competitor behavior. You’ll be closer to the market than anyone here, and a real voice in what we change.

What Success Looks Like

  • Months 1–3. Fluent in our products and the underwriting behind them, with first qualified conversations underway and first term sheets out.

  • By month 12. A repeatable origination motion with measurable conversion, multiple closed deals you sourced yourself, and referral relationships producing flow without you pushing each one.

Who We’re Looking For

Someone who can meet a founder or CFO at their level on both halves of the conversation — how their business actually makes money, and how the financing works. That usually comes from equity investing or investment banking in gaming and consumer apps, corporate development at a scaled publisher, an origination seat at a specialty finance or venture debt fund, or growth leadership with real finance depth.

Requirements

The Master of Professional Studies (MPS) in Game Design at the Maryland Institute College of Art (MICA) is a 30-credit, fully online graduate degree that prepares emerging creative professionals to design, prototype, and launch innovative games across platforms and genres. The program integrates artistic vision, interactive systems design, gamification, leadership, and production management.

MICA’s learning environment mirrors real-world collaborative ecosystems—where data scientists, designers, educators, and technologists work together. We position game creation as a critical, interdisciplinary art form, balancing technical competency with the critical literacy to understand play as a cultural and social phenomenon.

General Purpose

To provide high-quality asynchronous instruction for graduate students in the MPS in Game Design, conveying professional expertise in game theory, mechanics, narrative, and production. Faculty serve as mentors, guiding students as they translate artistic intent into production reality within a rigorous, studio-based online environment.

jobs.excerpt: Craft Your Career with BrassCraft Manufacturing Company!
jobs.description:
Craft Your Career with BrassCraft Manufacturing Company!

BrassCraft is seeking a strategic, commercially focused Business Development Manager to lead growth across the Home Builder and National Repair & Remodel contractor segments. In this role, you will help shape and execute the long-term growth strategy for these channels, secure new business, expand strategic customer relationships, and position BrassCraft as a preferred partner across the residential construction and remodeling market. You will work closely with builders, remodelers, contractors, wholesale channel partners, and key decision-makers to grow profitable revenue, increase market share, influence product specification, and deliver customer-focused solutions that create long-term value.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and execute the national growth strategy for the Home Builder and National Repair & Remodel contractor segments.

  • Identify, qualify, and secure new business with national and regional builders, remodeling companies, and specialty contractors.

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that expand customer penetration, revenue, profitability, and market share.

  • Build relationships with executive leaders and key decision-makers across strategic customer organizations.

  • Drive product specification opportunities and strengthen brand preference throughout the construction and remodeling lifecycle.

  • Lead national agreement, rebate program, promotional, and strategic partnership negotiations.

  • Interpret customer, competitive, channel, and market developments to recommend commercial strategies and business solutions.

  • Collaborate with distributors, manufacturers’ representatives, and cross-functional teams to execute growth initiatives.

  • Represent BrassCraft at industry events, builder conferences, contractor meetings, and trade shows.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Construction Management, or a related field.

  • 8+ years of sales, business development, national account management, or channel management experience.

  • Experience working with home builders, remodeling contractors, general contractors, or within the residential construction industry.

  • Demonstrated success developing strategic customer relationships and achieving sales and profitability objectives.

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, business planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and sales analytics tools.

  • Ability to work remotely and travel approximately 40–60%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing national or regional builder accounts.

  • Knowledge of residential construction, plumbing, heating and cooling, building products, or related categories.

  • Familiarity with major home builders, multifamily developers, and remodeling organizations.

  • Experience working through wholesale distribution channels and manufacturers’ representative networks.

Why Join BrassCraft?

Join a trusted, market-leading company with well-known brands, strong channel partnerships, and a clear growth opportunity in the builder and contractor market.

In this role, you’ll have national scope, meaningful customer exposure, and the opportunity to shape how BrassCraft partners with builders, contractors, distributors, and industry partners to drive market expansion and profitable growth.

Hiring Range: $125,000-$150,000

Actual compensation may vary based on various factors including experience, education, geographic location, and/or skills.

ABOUT US

BrassCraft Manufacturing Company is a leading manufacturer and distributor of high-quality water and gas flow control products, and plumbing service and repair parts for the new construction and repair/remodel markets. Headquartered in Novi, Michigan, BrassCraft supports a wide array of channel partners including wholesalers, retailers, and specialty dealers, who serve residential and commercial markets across the Americas. BrassCraft has set the plumbing standard for 80 years, with industry-leading brands including BrassCraft® and Plumbshop®.

Full time

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Job Overview

The Project Manager – Quality and Regulatory will lead and coordinate projects aimed at Quality Management System (QMS) enhancement initiatives. The project manager will serve as the primary driver of project(s) execution across a group of QMS workstreams, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring delivery against defined milestones. Key deliverables include the development of project timelines, project team assembly, managing the schedule and maintaining effective communication through the project. This position is defined term for approximately 12 months. While the role is remote, candidates should reside in Eastern Standard Time.

Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties:

  • Serve as project manager, owning an integrated schedule, milestone tracking, and status reporting across all QMS workstreams.
  • Apply formal PMI-based project management methodology including scope, schedule, risk, issue, and change management disciplines.
  • Develop and maintain project-level RAID logs, status dashboards, and executive-level reporting cadence.
  • Facilitate reviews and workstream-level working sessions with Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Lead project coordination across the following QMS enhancement areas: Product Development Process, Receiving Inspection, Complaints & Vigilance, Validation, Device History Records (DHRs), Inspection & In-Process Controls, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), and Training.
  • Support SOP development, gap closure documentation, and audit-readiness activities within scope.
  • Develop and present structured status reports to project teams and senior leadership on a defined cadence.
  • Escalate risk and issues proactively; recommend resolution paths with supporting analysis.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of PMO tools, templates, and governance processes within Healthmark’s program management function.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities within the QMS implementation approach and recommend enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to ensure all project deliverables meet FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR and ISO 13485:2016 requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Project and/or equivalent project scheduling tools (Smartsheet, Monday.com); strong Microsoft 365 skills (Teams, SharePoint, Excel).

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Expert-level working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), including its incorporation of ISO 13485:2016 effective February 2026.
  • Strong applied understanding of ISO 13485:2016 QMS requirements throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with the following QMS process areas: Product Development Process / Design Controls, Receiving Inspection, Complaints & Vigilance / MDR reporting, Validation (IQ/OQ/PQ), Device History Records, Inspection and In-Process Controls, CAPA, and Training.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14971 risk management principles and FDA 510(k) / Class II submission processes is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-workstream projects within a formal project management framework (PMI PMBOK preferred).
  • Proven ability to develop and manage integrated project schedules, RAID logs, status reports, and steering committee materials.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams in a matrixed organizational environment without direct line authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex regulatory and project information clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence, align, and lead cross-functional stakeholders without direct supervisory authority.
  • Strong organizational skills; detail-oriented with a track record of delivering on schedule in regulated environments.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • Master’s degree or advanced technical credential a plus.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project or program management roles within the medical device industry.
  • Minimum 3 years of direct, hands-on experience implementing or managing QMS projects under FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and/or ISO 13485 in a regulated medical device environment.
  • Experience in supporting or leading QMS projects for companies undergoing FDA Class I and/or Class II classification transitions or regulatory remediation projects is strongly preferred.
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is highly desired.

Quality Requirements:

Build Quality into all aspects of their work by maintaining compliance to all quality requirements.

  • Ensure compliance to all FDA and Worldwide Quality & Compliance regulations (As applicable to the job function).
  • Must have the education and experience to understand and comply with U.S. and Worldwide medical device regulations (As applicable to your job function).
  • Attend all required Quality & Compliance training at the specified interval.
  • Adopt the “Beyond Compliance Quality Culture” in the work environment; always meet and exceed requirements.

Environmental/Safety/Physical Work Conditions:

  • Primarily office/hybrid environment; use of computer, telephone, and related office accessories to complete assignments.
  • May work extended hours during peak milestones or audit preparation cycles.
  • Occasional domestic travel may be required (estimated up to 20-25% depending on site-based activities).
  • Physical requirements: ability to sit/stand at a workstation for extended periods; occasional lifting up to 20 lbs.

The physical demands described here are a representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The salary range for this position is between $120,160 to $150,000 per year depending on experience and location.

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

This role requires a deep understanding of telecom network infrastructure and the ability to translate technical network architecture into actionable solution designs. You’ll act as trusted technical voice during implementation phases, working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Solutions, and Engineering.

Network Discovery and Architecture:

  • Conduct deep discovery sessions to understand customers’ existing network environments, including CPE, access, transport, core, and OSS/BSS layers.

  • Help customers and internal stakeholders understand trade-offs and priorities when designing around a mix of new and legacy infrastructure and business operations.

In addition to test automation, the role contributes to modern software delivery practices by integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, supporting release automation, and helping teams improve feedback cycles, deployment reliability, and overall delivery efficiency. This position is not a pure DevOps role, but requires solid DevOps skills to ensure that quality automation becomes an integrated part of the end-to-end delivery process.

Test Design and Implementation

  • Plan test phases and design test concepts.
  • Design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and SAP GUI testing.
  • Select appropriate automation frameworks and tools based on product needs.
  • Ensure test automation code follows clean coding, maintainability, and reusability principles.
  • Identify automation opportunities across the test pyramid.
  • Continuously improve test coverage, stability, and reliability.

Quality Assurance and Validation

  • Collaborate with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to define test strategies and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyze requirements and identify quality risks early in the development lifecycle.
  • Support teams in applying suitable testing methodologies and quality engineering practices.
  • Ensure automated tests are integrated early and continuously into the software development lifecycle.

CI/CD and DevOps Support

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast and stable feedback cycles.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of build, test, and deployment pipelines.
  • Contribute to the implementation of quality gates within CI/CD processes.
  • Support release and deployment automation where required.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to improve delivery stability and reduce manual effort.
  • Help teams adopt modern testing and DevOps practices without shifting the role into a full DevOps engineering position.

Defect Analysis and Reporting

  • Provide transparent quality metrics and reporting to development teams and stakeholders.

Environment and Tooling Support

  • Support the reliable execution of automated tests across different environments.

  • Quality-driven mindset with a pragmatic approach to automation.
  • Willingness to support teams in adopting modern engineering, testing, and DevOps practices.

Impact and Contribution
