About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Procurement Department

The Procurement team is responsible for securing the equipment Vantage’s data centers require to function. The team leads these efforts from conception through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, New Site Development, and Engineering along the way. Procurement also works closely with vendor partners to come up with a vertically integrated design, and we manage these partners to deliver the projects on schedule and budget. Vantage is unique in that our technical staff is given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. Our internal team can align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

The Sr. Director, Strategic Program Reporting & Executive Delivery Coordination supports the Chief Procurement Officer by gathering, validating, and consolidating information on enterprise procurement initiatives, data center infrastructure programs, financial commitments, and customer-facing deliverables across global functions.

The role maintains integrated plans, milestone schedules, dependencies, action logs, and progress-to-plan reporting across functional and customer teams. It does not govern the underlying work, own functional decisions, or replace accountable business leaders; it provides the reporting discipline, visibility, follow-through, and executive synthesis required to keep priorities on trajectory.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical understanding of data center infrastructure, capital projects, power systems, supply chain operations, procurement technologies, and financial reporting with exceptional skills in information gathering, schedule integration, data quality, and concise communication for the CEO and executive leadership.

Essential Job Functions

  • Serve as the central coordination and reporting partner to the Chief Procurement Officer for priority commitments and executive deliverables.

  • Gather timely updates from procurement, operations, engineering, finance, construction, supply chain, and customer-facing teams.

  • Maintain integrated milestone plans, deliverable trackers, decision logs, dependencies, risks, and follow-up actions.

  • Maintain the consolidated portfolio view for strategic initiatives, transformation programs, and cross-functional customer deliverables.

  • Integrate functional plans into a common timeline showing key deliverables, critical path milestones, dependencies, assumptions, and accountable owners.

  • Collect and reconcile status inputs across teams, challenge inconsistencies, and maintain a reliable reporting baseline.

  • Develop standardized dashboards, executive scorecards, and reporting templates that show progress to plan.

  • Surface emerging schedule, dependency, resource, scope, and financial risks to the appropriate accountable leaders for action.

  • Track agreed recovery actions and forecast changes while leaving decisions, execution, and outcomes with the responsible functions.

  • Gather and consolidate delivery updates for data center development, operations, infrastructure, and customer-driven programs.

  • Coordinate reporting inputs from Engineering, Construction, Operations, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and customer-facing teams.

  • Maintain sufficient working knowledge of power generation, electrical distribution, medium- and high-voltage equipment, UPS and backup generation, cooling and mechanical systems, capacity planning, fuel supply, alternative energy, and asset lifecycle management to test reporting completeness and translate technical issues for executives.

  • Track design, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, site-readiness, commissioning, readiness-for-service, and customer-commitment milestones across integrated schedules.

  • Identify timing gaps, interdependencies, late inputs, and changes that may affect delivery trajectory; route them to accountable owners and record agreed actions.

  • Support business cases and investment reviews by organizing technical, schedule, commercial, customer, and risk inputs from functional owners.

  • Gather, reconcile, and synthesize financial information supplied by Procurement, Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, and project teams.

  • Maintain executive reporting across capital and operating expenditures, budget performance, forecasts, cash flow, supplier spend, working capital, inventory liability, tariffs, tax implications, and risk-adjusted exposure.

  • Track reporting deadlines, assumptions, source owners, reconciliations, and unresolved data gaps.

  • Coordinate monthly, quarterly, annual, investment, and supplier-business-case reporting cycles.

  • Escalate material variances, missing inputs, and inconsistent forecasts to the accountable finance or business leader for resolution.

  • Formulate CEO, executive leadership, Board, audit, investment, and steering-committee materials from validated functional inputs.

  • Maintain consistent definitions, status criteria, version control, and source traceability across reporting packages.

  • Tailor the level of detail and narrative to the audience while preserving accuracy and accountability.

  • Ensure executive reporting reflects the positions of accountable functions and does not create implied ownership by this role.

  • Consolidate KPIs defined and owned by the relevant functions into a consistent executive view.

  • Monitor trends across cost, supplier performance, quality, inventory, delivery, project execution, cash flow, capital deployment, sustainability, and operational SLAs.

  • Maintain metric definitions, reporting cadence, source ownership, and data-quality exceptions.

  • Highlight movement against plan, forecast, and prior-period performance without setting functional targets or governing performance.

  • Build detailed reporting packages and decision-support views from source data provided by accountable teams.

  • Maintain dashboards and management reports using Power BI, ERP systems, procurement platforms, financial reporting tools, and data warehouse environments.

  • Coordinate data validation, reconcile conflicting submissions, and document assumptions and limitations.

  • Improve reporting efficiency through standardized templates, automated refreshes, and disciplined data collection.

  • Translate complex technical, commercial, customer, and financial information into clear executive-level insights.

  • Lead analysts, reporting resources, and project coordinators supporting data collection, schedule maintenance, and executive reporting.

  • Set clear standards for accuracy, timeliness, traceability, and concise communication.

  • Foster disciplined follow-through and service to accountable business and customer-facing functions.

Job Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in program reporting, PMO coordination, executive operations, portfolio analytics, consulting, or strategy roles.

  • Experience supporting C-suite executives and developing CEO- and Board-ready progress reporting.

  • Exceptional information gathering, synthesis, executive communication, and presentation skills.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

jobs.description:
Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.

At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. We are in relentless pursuit of an equitable and inspiring workplace that is respectful of all, reflects and represents the world in which we live, and fosters trust, collaboration and belonging.

Overview


Edelman AI is seeking a Product Designer, Mid Level, to help shape clear, consistent experiences across our internal platform that brings together insights, content creation, and proprietary AI tools into one shared environment for teams.


This is an end-to-end product design role, not a UI-only role. You will independently own design workstreams from Discovery through Evaluation, including lightweight research, problem framing, ideation, end-to-end flows, high-fidelity UI, design system execution, delivery partnership, and UX QA.

You will partner closely with Product Owners, engineers, and stakeholders to translate complex capabilities into human-centered experiences that are usable, accessible, and scalable across teams. You will work within an established Design System and an AI-assisted development workflow, and your job is to execute within them with precision while flagging gaps and contributing documentation that keeps the system healthy.

What success looks like


  • You can take an ambiguous problem and drive it from framing to shipped solution, proactively aligning with the UX Lead at key decision moments
  • You reduce rework by surfacing risks early and designing complete end-to-end flows, including edge cases and states, not just happy paths
  • You keep consistency across squads by defaulting to existing patterns and contributing improvements
  • You collaborate smoothly with engineers and Product Owners, keeping decisions crisp and documented
  • You follow through after release, validating outcomes and feeding learnings back into future work

Responsibilities


Insight-Led Product Development

  • Drive problem framing with Product Owners, including primary users, jobs to be done, constraints, assumptions, and risks
  • Plan and run lightweight research activities when needed, such as quick interviews, concept checks, and usability tests
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations that influence solution direction
  • Define success signals during Discovery and support evaluation after release by comparing outcomes to those signals

Rapid Concepting and Holistic Experience Design

  • Generate multiple solution directions quickly and articulate tradeoffs in plain language
  • Prototype at the right fidelity, starting with quick and lightweight concepts, to align stakeholders and reduce risk before build
  • Deliver end-to-end flows that include key states and edge cases
  • Ensure usability best practices are applied consistently across the experience

Design System-Led Craft

  • Design polished high-fidelity UI aligned with brand guidelines and our Design System
  • Default to existing patterns and reuse components consistently across squads
  • When a clear gap exists, document it with variants, states, and usage guidance and raise it with the UX Lead for review before extending the system
  • Ensure responsive behavior and accessibility basics are included from the start

Embedded Engineering Partnership

  • Collaborate early with engineers on feasibility, scope, and technical constraints before designs are considered final
  • Specify behaviors precisely, including interactions, content requirements, states, and responsive rules
  • Keep handoff current during build and communicate changes clearly to the rest of the squad
  • Support implementation by answering questions quickly and helping unblock delivery

Quality Ownership from Design to Release

  • Verify the built experience across key screens, browsers, and breakpoints
  • Write clean bug reports with clear repro steps and expected versus actual behavior, including screenshots
  • Capture learnings post-release and feed improvements back into patterns and future work

Requirements


  • 3 to 5 years of Product Design experience, including owning work from Discovery through Delivery
  • Portfolio demonstrating problem framing, research-informed decisions, multiple options explored, and at least one end-to-end shipped workflow
  • Strong knowledge of Design Systems, including applying and evolving component libraries, documenting usage guidelines, and collaborating on governance so patterns stay consistent across squads
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, including component creation, variants, auto layout, and clean file structure
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted design and development workflows, including tools like Claude, and an understanding of how design decisions are consumed by AI agents in the build process
  • Proven ability to operate with ambiguity, take ownership, and deliver while proactively aligning with the UX Lead at key milestones
  • Familiarity with Mixpanel or similar analytics tools, and ability to combine quantitative signals with qualitative research insights to guide decisions
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with Product and Engineering
  • High attention to detail and strong follow-through to ensure quality in the shipped experience

Nice to have


Understanding of communications and PR agency workflows, and how firms like Edelman operate across clients, teams, and delivery models

We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Our assets focus on the patients seeking help, the practitioners and clinicians delivering it, the researchers and regulators shaping the field, and the companies and organizations building the industry.

Our mission is to destigmatize and expand access to progressive mental health solutions, from advanced therapies to holistic practices. We work for people with clinical conditions such as depression, anxiety, or PTSD, and for people who want to strengthen their overall mental well-being. We combine scientific rigor and evidence-based standards with clear, accessible communication.

The Role

A Fractional CFO designs and runs the financial architecture of the group: how the entities are structured across jurisdictions, how capital moves between them, how cash is held and controlled, and how the founders see the numbers. You will work directly with the founders and alongside external legal and tax counsel. Bookkeeping stays with external accountants.

The priority is corporate structuring, source of funds and compliance readiness, treasury, and management reporting. Financial modeling and budgeting are part of the mandate, however operationally covered by the current Financial Manager - who will be a dotted line report to a fractional CFO role.

Responsibilities: What You Will Drive

Corporate structure and tax architecture (together with legal)

  • Architecting holding-company setups spanning 2-4 jurisdictions (EU + APAC) and selecting optimal domiciles for operating companies, holdings, and investment platforms;
  • Performing BEPS / ATAD / CRS impact reviews and producing transfer-pricing documentation;
  • Aligning dividend, royalty, and interest flows to keep the effective group tax rate in the desired range;
  • Coordinating with external legal and tax counsel to build compliant and cost-efficient structures, and pushing back on advice that is over-engineered or over-priced;
  • Maintaining a current map of entities, ownership, directorships, substance requirements, and filing calendars.

Source of funds and compliance readiness

  • Building and maintaining source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation to a standard that holds up under bank, EMI, and investor review;
  • Owning KYC and AML files across jurisdictions and refreshing them ahead of periodic reviews;
  • Preparing the financial part of due-diligence packs for investors, banking partners, and counterparties;
  • Structuring inter-company funding through equity, loans, and capital contributions, with matching documentation and substance;
  • Flagging jurisdictional, sanctions, and sector risk in regulated wellness, telemedicine, and adjacent categories before it turns into a banking problem.

Treasury and cash control

  • Setting up and maintaining banking and EMI relationships across the group, including account opening in new jurisdictions;
  • Deciding where cash sits, in which currencies, under whose signature, and at what approval thresholds;
  • Managing FX exposure, liquidity, and runway across entities and projects;
  • Owning payment rails and payment authority, including who can initiate payments, who approves them, and what is never automated;
  • Producing a reliable rolling cash-flow view for the founders.

Management reporting and financial policies

  • Introducing management accounting (FP&A), cost control, and payment workflows across the group;
  • Building KPI dashboards and unit-economics frameworks covering operating expenses, marketing spend, payroll, and project costs;
  • Setting the reporting cadence and formats, including what the founders receive and by when;
  • Setting up policies and systems for procurement, marketing, licensing, and IP contracts;
  • Defining approval limits, segregation of duties, and audit trail at a scale that fits a small team.

Experience: What You Bring

Structuring and tax

  • Hands-on experience architecting multi-jurisdiction holding structures, ideally across both EU and APAC;
  • Working command of BEPS, ATAD, CRS, substance requirements, and transfer pricing, at a level that lets you direct advisors instead of relying on them;
  • Track record of aligning intra-group flows to a target effective tax rate without building structures that fail bank or investor review.

Capital, banking, and compliance

  • Proven experience opening and holding banking and EMI relationships for cross-border groups, including in sectors under heavier scrutiny;
  • Fluency in source-of-funds and KYC / AML documentation from the applicant side;
  • Experience preparing financial due-diligence materials for investors or acquirers.

Operating finance

  • Experience building an FP&A and management-reporting function from scratch;
  • Comfort with unit economics and project-level P&Ls in early-stage or multi-project environments;
  • Financial modeling capability sufficient to build and own the models;
  • Venture builder, family office, fund, or multi-entity group background is a strong advantage.

Working style

  • Able to deliver senior output part-time and remotely, without a team underneath you;
  • Precise with documentation, approvals, and anything that moves money;
  • Direct with founders when a structure, a spend, or a timeline does not work;
  • Comfortable building the first version of a process.

What We Don’t Expect

  • Day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll processing, or statutory filings;
  • Acting as legal counsel, which stays with external lawyers;
  • Leading fundraising or investor relations as a primary mandate;
  • Implementing an enterprise ERP or a corporate-scale finance stack;
  • Full-time availability.

Engagement Format

  • Fractional and remote, with a monthly time commitment agreed at the start;
  • European time zone preferred, with occasional travel for banking, notarial, or advisor meetings;
  • Direct reporting line to the founders.

Job Title: Executive Commercial Leader SEI+Intelerad, USCAN

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

Job Description

GE HealthCare is seeking an experienced and transformational Executive Commercial Partner, US & Canada – SEI + Intelerad to lead the US & Canada commercial organization across both Solutions for Enterprise Imaging (SEI) and the recently acquired Intelerad business.

This executive will have end-to-end commercial accountability across the combined SEI + Intelerad portfolio, spanning enterprise imaging, cloud, workflow, AI, image exchange, advanced visualization and related digital solutions serving large health systems, hospitals, outpatient and ambulatory imaging centers, radiology groups and other care settings.

The Executive Commercial Partner will inherit two businesses with complementary portfolios, market positions, customer segments and commercial capabilities. This leader will be responsible not simply for bringing the two commercial organizations together, but for translating that combination into a differentiated growth engine for GE HealthCare.

The mandate includes protecting and growing both installed bases, accelerating cross-portfolio selling, expanding into new customer segments, unlocking the commercial value of the Intelerad acquisition, and progressively creating a unified customer experience and go-to-market model across SEI + Intelerad.

This leader will also play a critical role in building the commercial model required for the next phase of the business—shifting from traditional product selling toward cloud-first, AI-enabled, platform and SaaS-oriented solutions while maintaining relentless focus on near-term commercial performance.

Core Responsibilities:

Own USCAN Commercial Performance Across SEI + Intelerad

  • Own US & Canada orders, revenue, growth, retention and overall commercial performance across the SEI + Intelerad businesses.

  • Develop and execute an integrated USCAN commercial strategy in partnership with Global Commercial, Product, Engineering, Services and GE HealthCare regional leadership.

  • Establish clear market, segment and account priorities across both businesses and translate them into disciplined pipeline and execution plans.

  • Drive forecasting accuracy, pipeline management, pricing discipline, deal governance and operating rigor.

  • Personally engage in the most strategic and complex customer opportunities, serving as an executive sponsor and escalation point.

  • Build a culture of accountability for outcomes, not activity, across the commercial organization.

Lead SEI + Intelerad Commercial Integration & Unlock Acquisition Value

  • Lead the USCAN commercial integration of SEI + Intelerad, protecting the strengths, customer relationships and commercial momentum of both businesses while progressively creating a more integrated commercial organization.

  • Translate the strategic rationale of the Intelerad acquisition into measurable commercial outcomes, including cross-sell, new-logo acquisition, improved retention and expansion into adjacent customer segments.

  • Establish clear account ownership, rules of engagement and opportunity governance across the SEI and Intelerad commercial teams during the transition.

  • Lead the progression from co-marketing to co-selling and ultimately converged selling, ensuring customers experience increasing simplicity rather than the complexity of two legacy organizations.

  • Partner across Product, Services, Finance, Legal and Commercial Operations to remove barriers to cross-portfolio selling and accelerate realization of revenue synergies.

  • Identify and mitigate customer and revenue risks throughout the integration, with particular focus on protecting both installed bases and reducing attrition.

Expand the Market & Accelerate Growth

  • Capitalize on the complementary strengths of SEI + Intelerad to expand GE HealthCare's presence across:

  • Large health systems and academic medical centers

  • Community and mid-sized hospitals

  • Outpatient and ambulatory imaging centers

  • Radiology and reading groups

  • Emerging cloud-based and distributed care models

  • Drive new-logo acquisition while increasing share of wallet across the combined installed base.

  • Build repeatable cross-sell motions across the SEI + Intelerad portfolios, including enterprise imaging, image exchange, advanced visualization, cardiology, AI/orchestration and adjacent digital capabilities.

  • Build strategic relationships with senior healthcare executives, including CIOs, CTOs, CMIOs, clinical leaders and health system executives.

Transform the Commercial Model for SaaS & Platform Selling

  • Lead the evolution from traditional product and perpetual-license selling toward enterprise solutions, cloud, subscription and SaaS-based commercial models.

  • Develop a commercial organization capable of selling customer, clinical and business outcomes rather than individual technologies.

  • Build the competencies required for complex platform selling, including value articulation, executive engagement, enterprise contracting, recurring-revenue economics and long-term customer expansion.

  • Partner with Product leadership to bring market and customer insights into portfolio prioritization, packaging and roadmap decisions.

  • Develop pricing, packaging and incentive approaches that reinforce strategic growth priorities, cross-portfolio collaboration and recurring-revenue expansion.

Create a Unified SEI + Intelerad Customer Experience

  • Establish a customer-first commercial model across SEI + Intelerad, ensuring customers experience an increasingly coordinated GE HealthCare team regardless of legacy organizational boundaries.

  • Partner closely with Services and Customer Success to create effective handoffs across the customer lifecycle—from opportunity development and contracting through implementation, adoption, renewal and expansion.

  • Strengthen executive sponsorship and strategic account management for the region's largest and most complex customers.

  • Use customer feedback, competitive intelligence and market trends to continuously refine commercial strategy.

Build the Future Commercial Organization

  • Assess the combined SEI + Intelerad commercial organization and define the capabilities, structure and talent required for the future.

  • Preserve and leverage the entrepreneurial speed, software expertise and customer intimacy of Intelerad while bringing the scale, market reach and capabilities of GE HealthCare and SEI.

  • Develop a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline capable of supporting a significantly larger software business.

  • Attract, develop and retain high-performing software commercial talent.

  • Create a high-accountability culture that encourages collaboration across legacy organizational boundaries and rewards winning as one team.

Drive Commercial Excellence

  • Establish a rigorous operating cadence across pipeline, orders, revenue, retention, win/loss, pricing and sales productivity.

  • Apply GE HealthCare's Heartbeat and lean principles to improve commercial execution, problem solving and decision velocity.

  • Use data and market intelligence to continuously optimize territory coverage, resource deployment, sales productivity and investment.

  • Partner with Finance to ensure commercial investments generate appropriate returns and support profitable growth.

Experience Requirements

  • 15+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience, with significant experience in enterprise software, healthcare technology, SaaS, cloud or digital solutions.

  • Demonstrated success leading a large, complex commercial organization with accountability for significant revenue and growth targets.

  • Strong experience selling mission-critical enterprise software and platforms into complex healthcare organizations or similarly sophisticated enterprise customers.

  • Demonstrated experience leading organizations through significant transformation, including M&A integration, SaaS transformation, product-to-solution selling, commercial organization redesign and/or entry into new customer segments.

  • Proven track record of delivering against ambitious sales targets while simultaneously transforming an organization.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, strategic account management, contracting, pricing and complex solution selling.

  • Experience building executive-level customer relationships and navigating multi-stakeholder buying environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Services, Finance and other functions.

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen with understanding of recurring revenue, ARR, retention and SaaS economics.

  • Lean mindset with demonstrated ability to create operational rigor without sacrificing speed or entrepreneurial thinking.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be:

  • A growth leader who sees the combination of SEI + Intelerad as an opportunity to expand the market rather than simply combine two sales organizations.

  • A software commercial leader who understands how SaaS, cloud and platform economics change both the customer relationship and commercial model.

  • An integrator who can bring together teams with different histories, cultures and ways of working while retaining the strengths of each.

  • A customer executive comfortable operating with CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, clinical executives and other senior healthcare leaders.

  • A talent builder capable of assessing an organization objectively, making difficult talent decisions and building the commercial organization required for the future.

  • An operator who brings rigor to pipeline, forecasting and execution while maintaining speed.

  • A change leader comfortable making decisions amid ambiguity and leading visibly through significant transformation.

Measures of Success

  • USCAN orders, revenue and profitable growth across SEI + Intelerad

  • Net-new logo acquisition and strategic enterprise wins

  • Customer retention and reduction in attrition across both installed bases

  • Cross-portfolio revenue and Intelerad acquisition synergy realization

  • Expansion of cloud, SaaS and recurring-revenue business

  • Pipeline quality, conversion and forecast accuracy

  • Successful progression from co-market to co-sell toward a more unified commercial model

  • Customer experience and strategic account health

  • Commercial productivity and organizational effectiveness

  • Retention and development of critical commercial talent

Additional Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.

  • Ability to travel extensively throughout the United States and Canada.

  • Demonstrated track record of achieving ambitious commercial targets.

  • Executive-level relationship management capabilities.

  • Strong business, financial and strategic acumen.

Resolve to Save Lives seeks a Backend Engineer to help build and maintain digital tools that support public health programs focused on cardiovascular health, hypertension, and diabetes control. Our digital tools help Ministries of Health and implementing partners manage large-scale health programs, improve data quality, and support healthcare workers who serve millions of patients. The engineering team works across open-source products and integrations, including Simple, DHIS2, and the HEARTS360 toolkit.

This role is ideal for a software engineer with professional experience developing backend applications who is looking for an opportunity to grow their technical skills while contributing to meaningful global health impact. You will work closely with engineers, program teams, and external partners to develop reliable software, support system integrations, and improve the quality and scalability of our digital platforms.

While much of our integration and data-processing work is Python-based, the role also supports applications built in Ruby on Rails and integrations with Java-based systems. We are looking for engineers who are excited to learn new technologies and work across a diverse technical environment.

Length of engagement: 12 months fixed-term employment with possibility of renewal based on funding and mutual interest.

Location: This is a remote position open to candidates based in India, Nigeria or Ethiopia

What You Will Work On

Simple

Simple is a free, open-source application and dashboard, written in Ruby, that healthcare workers use to manage patients with high blood pressure.

DHIS2

DHIS2 is an open-source health information platform written in Java and maintained by the University of Oslo. We're collaborating closely with the University of Oslo to adapt DHIS2 into a strong alternative to Simple for countries already using it for other health information needs.

HEARTS360 Toolkit (H360TK)

H360TK is a lightweight, self-hostable toolkit built by our team for standing up hypertension and diabetes program dashboards with limited infrastructure. It integrates with electronic health record systems, ingests patient line-list data, loads it into PostgreSQL through Python pipelines, and surfaces it through Grafana dashboards.

As a member of the team, you will contribute to open-source software projects that support public health programs. Your work will help keep these tools reliable, secure, and useful for the teams and partners who depend on them.

Core responsibilities

The Backend Engineer will support the development, maintenance, and reliability of our backend systems and integrations.

Simple

  • Help maintain the Simple application, addressing bugs and security vulnerabilities as they come up.
  • Collaborate with the CVH leadership and country teams to develop new features.
  • Build your understanding of how healthcare workers use the tool day-to-day to inform new features and fixes.

DHIS2

  • Build expertise in DHIS2 over time.
  • Support the integration, monitoring, reporting, and configuration of DHIS2.
  • Help identify, define, and implement changes to DHIS2.

H360TK

  • Build expertise in H360TK and take ownership of parts of the toolkit.
  • Write and maintain Python integration scripts.
  • Help extend H360TK to new use cases and areas of work.

AI/Machine Learning

  • RTSL is exploring machine learning to help predict patient behavior and improve retention in our programs. This is a chance to build applied ML/MLOps skills alongside the team.

Support

  • Help tend production environments for Simple and DHIS2, including investigating issues and communicating clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

We are seeking a candidate with strong software development skills, preferably in the language our software is written in. However, we value motivation and a willingness to learn missing skills just as much.

Technical skills

  • Python and related frameworks for integration, data management and machine learning
  • SQL (performance investigation, execution plan analysis, etc.)
  • Ruby (Rails, ActiveRecord) is a plus
  • Docker and Kubernetes.
  • AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Grafana, Prometheus, or application monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented principles
  • Exposure to CI/CD methodology
  • Familiarity with APIs and user-facing components

Experience

  • Typically 2–4 years of professional experience writing production Python code.
  • Experience building and supporting backend applications in a production environment.
  • Experience launching and maintaining apps at scale
  • Experience with modern cloud infrastructure
  • Experience supporting apps that are growing quickly
  • Knowledge of caching implementation

Abilities

  • Ability and willingness to learn new programming languages
  • Interest in working with a diverse and distributed Engineering team
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Java-based applications or integrations
  • Open-source software development.
  • Health information systems, DHIS2, electronic health records, or digital health platforms.
  • Machine learning, analytics, or MLOps concepts.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success.

The salary for this role is competitive and set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate’s skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role.

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including:

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents
  • Contributions toward retirement
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits
  • Up-to-date computer equipment

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. Resolve to Save Lives complies with all applicable US EEO laws.

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At Coinme, we’re redefining access to financial services in a digital world.
jobs.description:
At Coinme, we’re redefining access to financial services in a digital world. By combining the cutting-edge power of blockchain technology with everyday simplicity, we make digital currencies accessible and usable for all.

As the world's largest network of cryptocurrency kiosks with over 40,000 locations nationwide, we're breaking down barriers to crypto adoption through our seamless mobile app, secure digital wallet, and DeFi integrations. Beyond our consumer offerings, we're also the infrastructure powering the crypto revolution for businesses.

Through our enterprise Crypto-as-a-Service (CaaS) platform, we enable businesses to launch crypto capabilities in weeks, not months. Our modular, API-first infrastructure provides everything from KYC and payment processing to liquidity and custody solutions—all fully licensed and compliant.

We’re big enough to lead the charge in decentralized finance but small enough that your ideas will make waves. Every role at Coinme contributes to building a financial future where everyone has the tools to thrive. At Coinme, your growth fuels our mission. Together, we RISE.

About the Role

Coinme is part of Polygon Labs, and together we're putting out a stablecoin payments stack: our fiat on and off ramps, Sequence wallets, and settlement on Polygon. Fintechs and financial institutions are integrating it now, and the documentation hasn't caught up. Partners are asking questions that should have been answered in a doc six months ago, and those questions land on engineers who need to be building.

This role fixes that. You'll own our API docs and the integration path, help BD answer technical questions during deals, and take signed partners from kickoff through go-live. Most of the job is figuring out how the stack actually works, then writing it down well enough that the next person doesn't have to ask. If a developer with an AI coding assistant can't integrate us without a call, that's the problem you're solving.

What You'll Do

  • Own the API and integration docs. Rewrite what's wrong, fill what's missing, keep it current as the stack changes
  • Build the quickstarts, sample code, and reference architectures that get a developer from nothing to a working integration
  • Answer technical questions from partners during sales conversations and during builds, and resolve them yourself rather than passing them to engineering
  • Take signed partners live: requirements intake, provisioning once KYB and KYC clear, sandbox testing, webhooks, go-live checks
  • Work with the integration program manager on timelines so partners know what's coming and when
  • Learn the stack deeply: CaaS ramps, Sequence wallets, Trails, OMSX, bank rails, custodial and non-custodial flows, virtual accounts, deposit addresses, webhooks
  • Build demos and sample apps that BD can use to show what the products do
  • Push what you learn back into Product and Engineering. You'll see every rough edge in the API before anyone else does
  • Automate the repetitive parts of onboarding and provisioning, and use AI tools to move faster on docs and support

Who You Are

We're open to two different backgrounds here, and you only need one:

You've run API integrations for customers at a payments or fintech company, taking them from kickoff to production. Or you've owned docs, SDKs, or developer support at an API-first company and want to go deeper into payments.

Either way, you should have:

  • Real hands-on API skills. You can read logs, debug a broken webhook, reason about auth, and work in Postman or Bruno and Datadog. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you do need to solve problems instead of routing them
  • Strong technical writing. You can take a messy system and document it so a stranger can follow it
  • Patience for ambiguity. The stack changes weekly, the docs are thin, and nobody is going to hand you a plan
  • Comfort using AI tools in your daily work, and an eye for how to make our docs work well for developers who are using them too

Payments fundamentals (fund flows, settlement, reconciliation) will help, but we can teach that to the right person.

Nice to have: crypto or web3 background, especially stablecoins and wallets. Enough coding to build a demo app. Experience with a docs platform like Mintlify. Exposure to KYB and KYC tooling.

Check out our AI Usage Guidelines to understand how we approach AI tools during the hiring process.

jobs.excerpt: En Imagemaker estamos buscando nuestro próximo Desarrollador Fullstack Java/React.
jobs.description:
En Imagemaker estamos buscando nuestro próximo Desarrollador Fullstack Java/React. El cargo existe para apoyar la migración tecnológica completa de un portal de ventas heredado tras la compra de Security por parte de BICE. Esta iniciativa forma parte de la adopción del nuevo stack tecnológico y de los lineamientos de arquitectura impulsados actualmente por BICE Vida.

El problema concreto que deberá resolver la persona es comprender las lógicas de negocio existentes en una aplicación desarrollada en .NET 6 con Angular y trasladarlas a una nueva solución basada en Java, Quarkus, MuleSoft y Hasura para el backend y las integraciones, y React para el frontend. La migración comprenderá el 100% de la aplicación y se ejecutará gradualmente, migrando, probando y validando los servicios de manera sucesiva.

Se espera una persona full stack con mayor fortaleza en backend, pero que también cuente con conocimientos de React para trabajar en el frontend y consumir los servicios desarrollados durante la migración. Debe ser capaz de leer y comprender el código existente en .NET, trabajar con autonomía en las tareas de programación e implementar la arquitectura y los patrones ya definidos por el equipo. No deberá mantener la solución actual ni diseñar una nueva arquitectura.

Key Responsibilities

Responsabilidades operativas

  • Migrar: serás responsable de trasladar la totalidad de las lógicas de negocio desde .NET 6 al nuevo stack tecnológico.
  • Implementar: serás responsable de desarrollar los servicios backend con Java y Quarkus bajo la arquitectura hexagonal definida.
  • Integrar: serás responsable de conectar Quarkus, MuleSoft y Hasura mediante GraphQL y API REST.
  • Desarrollar: serás responsable de adaptar el frontend en React para consumir correctamente los servicios migrados.
  • Garantizar: serás responsable de entregar cada servicio migrado, probado y funcionando antes de avanzar al siguiente componente.
  • Conectar: serás responsable de integrar la solución con las funciones AWS Lambda existentes y AWS Secrets Manager.

Responsabilidad de coordinación técnica

  • Coordinar: serás responsable de gestionar los cambios mediante Git, evitando conflictos con el equipo que mantiene activa la aplicación actual.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Imprescindibles — Must-have

  • Java y Quarkus: experiencia sólida desarrollando servicios backend con Java y Quarkus.
  • MuleSoft y Hasura: experiencia trabajando con ambas tecnologías dentro de una capa de integración.
  • React: experiencia desarrollando frontend y consumiendo los servicios creados durante la migración.
  • Desarrollo backend: aproximadamente cinco años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
  • .NET 6: capacidad para leer y comprender código, estructuras por capas, tipos de objetos e inyección de dependencias; no se requiere dominio avanzado.
  • GraphQL: experiencia implementando integraciones y exponiendo o consumiendo servicios mediante GraphQL.
  • Microservicios y API REST: experiencia desarrollando microservicios y su comunicación mediante API REST.
  • Arquitectura hexagonal: conocimiento suficiente para implementar una arquitectura previamente definida bajo este enfoque.
  • AWS Lambda: experiencia integrando servicios con funciones Lambda existentes; no se requiere crearlas ni mantenerlas.
  • AWS Secrets Manager: experiencia implementando conexiones con este servicio.
  • Git: experiencia trabajando con repositorios, ramas y equipos que realizan modificaciones simultáneas sobre una misma solución.
  • Autonomía técnica: capacidad para navegar por código heredado y resolver de manera autónoma dudas de programación, estructura, objetos e inyección de dependencias.

Deseables — Nice-to-have

  • Migraciones tecnológicas: experiencia previa migrando aplicaciones desde .NET hacia Java o Quarkus.
  • Spring Boot: experiencia senior en Java con Spring Boot cuando no se cuente con experiencia directa en Quarkus.
  • GitHub Copilot: experiencia utilizando la herramienta para apoyar tareas de desarrollo.
  • Coordinación técnica: para el perfil senior, capacidad para organizar el trabajo del equipo y apoyar la resolución de dudas técnicas.

Beneficios

Tenemos muy buenos beneficios para ti!

🏖️ Don’t worry, be happy: 3 días libres al año adicionales a tus vacaciones.
✨ Permiso sin goce de sueldo para cumplir tus sueños.
⚖️ Programa de bienestar enfocado a equilibrar el trabajo y la vida personal.

🤓 ¡Programas de formación, clases de inglés y mucho más!
🎂 Día libre para tu cumpleaños y medio día para los cumpleaños de tus hijos.
💰 Bonificaciones que dan respiros: Fiestas patrias, navidad, matrimonio/AUC, nacimiento/adopción de hijos, etc.
💳 Convenios y precios preferenciales con bancos.
👶🏻 3 Días adicionales para padres por nacimiento o adopción de hijo/a.
🐶 Convenio de seguro para tus mascotas!
🌿 Nuestra cultura es horizontal, de innovación, desafiante y sobre todo, se respira mucha buena onda!

jobs.description:
Buscamos um(a) Especialista Salesforce, com forte experiência em Sales Cloud, para atuar como referência técnica na arquitetura, implementação e evolução de soluções Salesforce em ambientes corporativos complexos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e integradas ao ecossistema da organização, garantindo o uso adequado da plataforma, a qualidade das implementações e a evolução contínua da arquitetura.

Além da atuação hands-on, o profissional deverá exercer liderança técnica, apoiar decisões de arquitetura, orientar desenvolvedores e parceiros, promover boas práticas e garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, aos padrões corporativos e aos requisitos de segurança e governança.

A estrutura desta vaga foi adaptada a partir de uma descrição originalmente voltada para Especialista Backend com foco em arquitetura, liderança técnica, segurança, observabilidade e ownership de ponta a ponta, substituindo o eixo .NET/GCP por Salesforce Sales Cloud e mantendo Android como conhecimento desejável.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Desenhar arquiteturas Salesforce escaláveis, resilientes, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em Salesforce Sales Cloud, apoiando decisões de arquitetura, modelagem de dados e desenho de soluções.
  • Liderar a implementação e evolução de funcionalidades relacionadas a contas, contatos, leads, oportunidades, produtos, cotações, pedidos, forecast e gestão do ciclo comercial.
  • Definir estratégias de configuração, customização e desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, priorizando soluções declarativas quando adequadas.
  • Desenvolver e revisar soluções em Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura Components, SOQL e integrações com sistemas corporativos.
  • Projetar integrações entre Salesforce e sistemas internos ou externos utilizando REST APIs, SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Outbound Messages e Middleware.
  • Definir padrões de integração, tratamento de erros, monitoramento, rastreabilidade, retry, idempotência e segurança na comunicação entre sistemas.
  • Avaliar e aplicar recursos da plataforma, como Flow, Process Automation, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Reports, Dashboards e Permission Set Groups.
  • Garantir a qualidade da arquitetura de dados, incluindo modelagem de objetos, relacionamentos, regras de compartilhamento, hierarquia de acesso e governança de dados.
  • Definir estratégias de segurança utilizando Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules, Organization-Wide Defaults e políticas de acesso.
  • Apoiar a adequação da solução aos requisitos de segurança, privacidade e LGPD, considerando o tratamento de dados pessoais e sensíveis.
  • Estruturar e otimizar processos de deployment entre ambientes utilizando Salesforce DX, Salesforce CLI, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Promover boas práticas de versionamento, revisão de código, testes automatizados e controle de qualidade das entregas.
  • Definir estratégias de testes unitários, testes de integração, testes de regressão, testes de performance e validação de releases.
  • Realizar code reviews e solution reviews, garantindo aderência aos padrões técnicos e arquiteturais definidos.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz em incidentes, problemas de performance, falhas de integração e indisponibilidades.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, diagramas de arquitetura, decisões arquiteturais, manuais operacionais e runbooks.
  • Apoiar a definição de roadmap técnico, identificação de débitos técnicos e priorização de melhorias na plataforma.
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de Produto, Negócio, Segurança, Arquitetura, Dados, Infraestrutura e fornecedores.
  • Orientar profissionais desenvolvedores, administradores, analistas funcionais e consultorias parceiras.

JadeClass Education Singapore provides enrichment education to bright students who already have a good command of the English language and plan on continuing their education abroad. We are a group of talented teachers who develop and deliver in-person and online classes in English and STEM. Our students range from 6–16 years old and are carefully screened for English level, behavior, and motivation. Strategic Leadership & Technology Roadmap

  • Define and execute a comprehensive IT architecture strategy aligned with business, clinical, and operational goals.

  • Guide Systems Architecture development, ensuring robust design, security, and integration of core business and healthcare applications, including EHR/EMR (Epic).

  • Act as the primary liaison between IT architecture teams and IT leadership, translating business needs into technology strategies.

  • Establish KPIs and performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of IT architecture initiatives.

  • Identify and mitigate risks related to network vulnerabilities, cloud security, and system failures.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. You have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

jobs.excerpt: About Velixo Velixo builds Excel-native reporting, planning, and automation for finance teams running Acumatica, Sage Intacct, Business Central, and MYOB.
jobs.description:
About Velixo
Velixo builds Excel-native reporting, planning, and automation for finance teams running Acumatica, Sage Intacct, Business Central, and MYOB. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Montreal, we serve finance and accounting teams who live in spreadsheets and need their ERP data to be live, trustworthy, and writable.

Velixo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This is a fully remote position. While we welcome applications from across Canada, we are giving priority to candidates located in Quebec at this time.

The role
You will own how well Velixo Intelligence works and what it costs us to run. That means building the evaluation infrastructure that tells us whether a model change made our product better or worse, and driving down the cost per action without degrading quality.

This is a measurement-first engineering role. Today we ship AI features and form opinions about quality from anecdotes. You will replace that with evidence.

About Velixo Intelligence

Velixo Intelligence is our MCP-based gateway that lets finance teams query their ERP in natural language and perform governed writebacks from Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot. Reads run through GIQL, our query language. Writes go through the ERP's own screen APIs so that every permission, validation, and audit rule still applies.

It launched in public preview this year. Usage is growing, the surface area is expanding, and our understanding of the unit economics has not kept pace. That gap is the reason this role exists.

What you will own

Evaluation

  • Build and maintain regression suites for GIQL query generation, writeback correctness, and tool selection

  • Define what "good" means for each action type and make it measurable

  • Run structured evaluations before every model upgrade or prompt change, and produce a clear ship or no-ship recommendation

  • Track quality over time so we notice degradation before customers do

Cost engineering

  • Instrument every Gateway action for tokens, cache behavior, model, latency, and tenant

  • Establish and maintain the cost-per-action baseline that the rest of the company plans against

  • Reduce cost through prompt compression, prompt caching, context pruning, and routing work to smaller models where evaluation shows quality holds

  • Identify the expensive tail: which customers, which query shapes, which failure and retry loops

Model strategy

  • Track new model releases across providers and evaluate them against our workloads rather than published benchmarks

  • Maintain a current view of the price and performance frontier for what we do

  • Recommend when to migrate, when to wait, and when to run models in parallel

Partnership with Finance

  • Supply the unit cost data behind our credit pricing and plan allowances

  • Model the margin impact of proposed pricing changes alongside our VP Finance

  • Flag when product decisions will move the cost curve before they ship

You will not own pricing decisions. You will own the numbers those decisions depend on.

First 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Full instrumentation of the Gateway. A dashboard showing cost per action type, per tenant, and per model that the exec team checks weekly.

  • Days 31 to 60: A working evaluation suite covering our highest-volume action types, with a documented baseline.

  • Days 61 to 90: A prioritized cost reduction roadmap with sized estimates, and at least one shipped optimization with measured before-and-after quality.

What we are looking for

  • Substantial experience building on LLM APIs in production, not in demos or notebooks

  • You have built an eval harness before and can explain why the naive version of it misleads you

  • Hands-on with the current tooling landscape: tracing and observability platforms such as Langfuse, eval frameworks such as promptfoo. You have opinions about which of these earn their keep and which add ceremony without adding signal.

  • Comfortable with token accounting, context window management, and caching strategies

  • Strong analytical instincts and fluency with data. You reach for a query or a notebook before you reach for an opinion.

  • Able to write clearly about tradeoffs for a non-technical audience, because your conclusions will land in board decks and pricing meetings

  • Python or TypeScript proficiency

Nice to have

  • Experience with MCP or other tool-calling frameworks

  • Background in ERP, accounting, or financial systems

  • Prior exposure to usage-based or credit-based pricing models

  • Experience at a small company where you set your own priorities

Why this role is interesting

Most companies bolt a chat box onto their product and hope. We are building governed, auditable write access to financial systems of record, where a wrong answer has real consequences and a hallucinated journal entry is unacceptable. The evaluation problem here is genuinely hard and genuinely matters.

You will also have unusual visibility. The numbers you produce will directly shape what we charge and what we build.

jobs.excerpt: About ECP ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents.
jobs.description:
About ECP

ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.

Senior living is deeply under-penetrated with software and ECP is one of the largest and fastest-growing software companies in the industry. We recently raised a growth round of equity to reinvest in our product, technology, and go-to-market. Our mission is to build world-class software that improves the quality of life for seniors and improves clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.

The Role

Every delivery team at ECP depends on a set of shared components that none of them own. The authentication and identity layer every user passes through, the shared data services at the core of the product, and the messaging infrastructure connecting the platform are three of them, and they are not the only ones. When any of these has undocumented behavior, a reliability gap, or needs a coordinated change, the work falls to whichever team happens to be closest to it that sprint. We're standing up a platform organization to close that gap, and you'd be one of its first engineers.

ECP Intelligence sits here too. It's a set of role-based agents meant to get our users out of the software and back to their communities. Today it's a strategy. Nothing has been designed or written yet. Our data warehouse, which this team also owns, will give an agent what it can see. You own what it can do. An agent that only reads is a demo. One that acts has to act as a specific user, inside that user's permissions, through the same identity and domain services every other client of the platform goes through. That is your first mandate.

This is a builder role on a team of four senior engineers, reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering. You'll write the code these capabilities are made of, with a loud voice in how they get designed.

The stack. New code is Node and TypeScript. We're migrating off a ColdFusion legacy platform, and the two will coexist for a while. SQL Server and PostgreSQL, a mix of monolith and services, adopting domain-driven design and an event-driven architecture, all on AWS. This is a multi-tenant HIPAA product. You won't write ColdFusion, but you will design against it, because what you write has to serve both platforms at once.

What You'll Build

ECP Intelligence. You'll build the tool surface an agent acts through, the retrieval and context layer that grounds it in the right clinical and operational data, the serving path product teams call to reach a model, and the evaluation that catches a regression before a customer does. You'll also build the first agent workflows that run on it. This is clinical software, so you have to be able to prove what an agent cannot do.

The shared components. Which ones we take on first is an open question, and you'd help answer it. The shape of the work is the same either way. These are systems already in production that every team depends on, with behavior nobody wrote down and boundaries nobody drew on purpose. You'll take them over, give them interfaces worth depending on, and make the seams between the legacy platform and the newer services explicit.

The messaging backbone. The event bus works, but it's only partly adopted and nobody owns it. You'd take it the rest of the way, add contract testing so a service can be verified on its own, and support it as something the other teams can build on.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Required

  • You've built shared components or platform services that other teams depended on, and you stayed accountable for them afterward. This is not a first platform role.
  • Real depth in domain-driven design and event-driven architecture. You can explain why a bounded context sits where it does, what an anti-corruption layer bought you, and which flavor of event-driven you were actually doing.
  • You've built the production systems behind an AI feature, against data that was messy, governed, and inconveniently shaped. The model itself is someone else's problem.
  • You've carried a pager for a system other teams depended on.
  • Breadth across more than one language and paradigm, with real depth in at least one. Tell us about a time you had to get productive in an unfamiliar stack fast, and what that took.
  • Data modeling and query performance under real load. Some of our shared components sit on the hot path for every request.
  • AI-augmented development is already how you work, and you know where it holds up and where it needs a human check.

Preferred

  • Experience shipping meaningful customer-facing AI features (more than just a chatbot)
  • PHI or other regulated data in an AI or analytics path
  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale, with tenant isolation as a data-layer concern
  • Node and TypeScript, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, AWS
  • Building alongside a legacy platform mid-migration, without the luxury of waiting for it to finish
  • Contract testing or service virtualization in an event-driven system
  • Mentoring engineers, or wanting to grow into it

What Success Looks Like

At six months, the AI foundation is real and at least one ECP Intelligence agent workflow is running in front of customers, taking work off a caregiver's plate that they used to do by hand.

The shared components and the messaging backbone are a longer job, and that work starts once the agent foundation is in place. The measure there is that teams build on these components without having to think about them, and spend their time on their own roadmaps instead.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Foundation Model Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $200,000–$230,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an Foundation Model Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • 10 or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.
  • Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.
  • Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications at top-tier ML venues.
  • Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.
  • Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.
  • Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.

At TreviPay, we believe loyalty begins at the payment. As a Senior Decision Science Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of data, risk, and business strategy. You'll use analytics and predictive modeling to uncover insights, evaluate portfolio performance, and guide critical credit, fraud, and pricing decisions. Partnering with teams across the organization, you'll help solve complex business challenges, influence strategic initiatives, and deliver data-driven solutions that support growth while managing risk.

Responsibilities

• Deliver and communicate high quality data-driven analyses to key stakeholders and senior management that provide key insights leading to actionable results.
• Access, cleanse, and analyze relevant internal and external data to support the creation, monitoring, and improvement of effective B2B credit risk management and pricing strategy techniques across for existing account management.
• Conduct data exploration, data validation, and data audits to identify and address data quality issues and recommend improvements.
• Support Engineering and Product teams with resolution of roadblocks and interdependencies.
• Analyze risk and pricing strategies, including the predictive models built for those strategies in Credit and Fraud.
• Monitor the results of risk and pricing strategies by evaluating performance relative to expectations.
• Develop monitoring tools to evaluate continued performance of both generic and custom models
• Support the development (or build yourself) of statistical models and other types of predictive models as appropriate to improve our Credit and Fraud risk position, for both application and portfolio risk.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s Degree Required

• Minimum 6 years of proven work experience in a highly analytical environment performing complex business analyses, generating data-driven insights and presenting findings to leadership and other stakeholders.
• Strong knowledge of B2B credit and/or Business Banking credit risk, pricing, and profitability principles
• Ability to deal with ambiguity and be flexible enough to shift workload in accordance with changing priorities.
• Ability to extract, cleanse, merge and analyze data from varied internal and external sources.
• Strong analytical and data simulation skills including SAS and/or Python, MS Excel, Enterprise Reporting BI tools, or similar analytical and reporting/data visualization packages.
• Strong presentation skills and proficiency in MS Word and PowerPoint
• Experience in analyzing segments of data or utilizing tools to identify and explain patterns, trends and/or process improvements

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics or similar quantitative field of study
• Strong knowledge of B2B and/or Business Banking credit product pricing and profitability principles
• Statistical modeling experience (logistic regression, machine learning, SVM, and more)

• Prior leadership experience
